izzyondroid:com.afwsamples.testdpc.description:
Please note that this app is for development purposes only. It is NOT intended for production usages. The app should never be used with real data.
 Test DPC is a sample device policy controller for use with Android Enterprise. It gives developers the ability to see how their app will behave in a managed context such as device owner or within a managed profile. This is the lite version of Traffic Light and it exists to provide a minimal experience without any features that depend on the internet and Shizuku permissions.
 Traffic Light is an open-source tool for tracking your network usage while ensuring total privacy. Inspired by Internet Speed Meter and GlassWire.

 Free and open source

 Uses less battery
 No tracking
 Beautiful UI
 Fast and modern

izzyondroid:com.shub39.dharmik.online.name: Dharmik: Bhagavad Gita Reader
izzyondroid:com.shub39.dharmik.online.summary: Read the Bhagavad Gita offline with audio, translations & commentaries.
izzyondroid:com.shub39.dharmik.online.description:
Dharmik is a clean, ad-free reader for the Bhagavad Gita. All 18 chapters and 701 verses are bundled in the app, so you can read and listen anywhere — no connection required.
 Read and understand the Gita
 All 18 chapters and 701 verses, available offline
 Read verses in Sanskrit, Hindi or English — switch language at any time
 8 authentic translations, including Sri Harikrishnadas Goenka, Swami Ramsukhdas, Swami Tejomayananda and Swami Sivananda
 20 commentaries from Shankaracharya, Ramanuja, Madhavacharya, Neelkanth, Sridhara Swami and more
 Full Devanagari (Hindi) and Sanskrit text for every verse
 Adjustable verse font size for comfortable reading
 Light, dark and system themes
 Listen to every verse
 Audio for all three tracks: Sanskrit (mool sloka), English and Hindi recitations
 Autoplay plays the next verse automatically
 Download the complete audio collection for offline listening, with progress and the option to delete it again
 Find what matters
 Bookmark your last position and jump back to it anytime
 Mark verses as favourites and browse them from the home screen
 Copy any verse, translation or commentary to the clipboard
 Built to be simple and respectful
 Dharmik was built for readers who want the text itself, without ads, trackers or unnecessary features. The full text is sourced from Dharmic Data by bhavyakhatri, and the recitations from Gita Supersite by IIT Kanpur. Both are credited in the app.
 Available in English. Open source, licensed under GPL-3.0.

izzyondroid:com.wardellbagby.lyricistant.name: Lyricistant
izzyondroid:com.wardellbagby.lyricistant.summary: A helpful writing assistant for lyricists!
izzyondroid:com.wardellbagby.lyricistant.description:
Lyricistant is a writing app geared toward helping you write lyrics, poetry, or anything else you desire!
 Unlike other apps with a focus on rhyming, Lyricistant is first and foremost a writing app. It's made for you to use to write your lyrics, while offering helpful features to keep you in the writing zone.
Its features include:
 Showing the amount of syllables per line.
 Contextually displaying rhymes as you type or select words.
 Easily saving and reopening lyrics that you've made.
 Showing you the history of your file.
 Both a light and dark theme that it can automatically switch between.
 Total offline support.
 What's up with the name? It's a combination of two words:
Lyricist
Assistant
Lyricistant!

izzyondroid:id.thony.android.quranlite.name: Qur'an Lite
izzyondroid:id.thony.android.quranlite.summary: read the Qur’an on your Android device
izzyondroid:id.thony.android.quranlite.description:
With Qur’an Lite you can read the Qur’an on your Android smartphone or tablet. App size is kept as small as possible without sacrificing functionality, content is fetched by the app after install.
 The app offers a Light and Dark theme and prefetches all the contents. More features are planned and will become available with new versions, like searching for a Surah or bookmark your last reading page.

izzyondroid:v4lpt.vpt.f036.esw.name: Ease The Waiting
izzyondroid:v4lpt.vpt.f036.esw.summary: A mix between a calendar and a clock that makes you wait faster.
izzyondroid:v4lpt.vpt.f036.esw.description:
Welcome to Ease The Waiting. This app is designed to ease the waiting for scheduled events in the future, such as special holidays, your birthday, or anything else. 🎉🎂🌴 It displays the number of days until the event and (optionally) a personal background image for each event.
 How it works: 
 Just tap the big red button ("Add Event") to add your first event.
 In the next screen: Enter title and date
 Optionally, choose a custom background image for this event by tapping the preview field beneath title and date. 📝🗓️🖼️
 Save event by tapping the big red button that says "Save".
 You will now be back on the main screen and see your event
 To add more events, either tap the "+" sign in the bottom left, or scroll to the bottom of the event list and tap the "Add New Event" button.
 For a visually appealing experience like in the screenshots, use attractive images!
 Features: 
 🔤 2 visual presets - Switch between big and small text modes by tapping the A, resp. B button next to the "+" button in the bottom line.
 ✏️ Edit existing events - Tap on an event to modify its details.
 🔴 Live preview - See how your event will look as you add or edit it.
 🚀 Simple introduction - The app provides clear instructions if no events are added.
 Created with ❤️ by Valentin.

fdroid:ch.tiim.markdown_widget.name: Markdown Widget
fdroid:ch.tiim.markdown_widget.summary: Display markdown files as widgets on the home screen
fdroid:ch.tiim.markdown_widget.description: Add a minimalistic widget with the content of a markdown file to your home screen. This app is intended for users of Obsidian, but the widget will display any markdown file on your phone. The app supports all commonmark features, as well as some extensions.

fdroid:com.app.dailylog.name: DailyLog
fdroid:com.app.dailylog.summary: A quick-logging notes app with customizable shortcut buttons.
fdroid:com.app.dailylog.description:
dailyLog is a distraction-free notepad with customizable shortcut buttons.
Tired of trying to log workouts on your phone? Want to build a custom habit tracker? Do you follow a template for every journal entry? dailyLog can help.
dailyLog works by accessing a single text file of your choosing: keeping your data on your device and accessible in any app you choose. But unlike a blank text file, dailyLog lets you define custom shortcut buttons. Imagine a workout log where tapping the "chest" button pastes "chest press: reps, lbs", allowing you to log your workouts with ease. Or imagine a journal where the "📝" button pastes a list of questions you want to answer every day.
Initially designed as a rapid logging system for journaling, dailyLog allows you to quickly add info to a text file with customizable button shortcuts. See the detailed walkthrough with screenshots on the project homepage.

fdroid:com.celzero.bravedns.name: Rethink: DNS + Firewall + VPN
fdroid:com.celzero.bravedns.summary: Firewall apps, use WireGuard VPN, monitor network, block malware, change DNS.
fdroid:com.celzero.bravedns.description:
Say hello to a safer, transparent, and secure Android.
VPN: Connects to multiple WireGuard VPNs of your choice.
Safe: Reveals network activity of installed apps and lets you disable, uninstall, or firewall them.
Secure: First line of defense against spyware, ransomware, and malware that steal personal information and takeover accounts. Protects from DNS manipulation typically employed to censor websites, social media, and messaging apps.
Fast: DNS Servers deployed to 300+ locations world-wide to ensure your internet is as fast and highly available as it can be.
Open: Open source and free of any trackers.
***Features***
Firewall: Prevent apps from connecting to the Internet. Block spyware, malware, ransomware and more.
A firewall blocks any app connecting to the Internet over WiFi or Mobile data. Since most forms of surveillance require the data to be sent the network to a server, firewalling them effectively mitigates the threat (File Managers, Alarm Clock, Calculator are few such examples of apps that do not require any Internet access to function). The firewall feature uses Accessibility Service to detect and firewall background applications.
Monitoring: Keep tabs on incoming and outgoing Internet traffic. 
If enabled, the connectivity logs are collected and analyzed. Automated reports flag previously unknown or suspicious connections, and reveal the extent of attempt to steal data by spyware networks. In our tests, around 60% of the traffic is flagged and reported as being initiated by known spyware. Logs generated are made available in near-real time to the user for their own analysis.
WireGuard: Secure outgoing Internet traffic.
The app uses fast, modern, light-weight, and secure WireGuard protocol to encrypt outgoing connections to any compatible VPN provider of your choice.
Anti-censorship: 
The app encrypts your internet connection to Domain Name System (DNS) server run by Rethink with presence in our 300+ locations world-wide. DNS servers are the address book of the internet: A DNS server provides the exact addresses you need to visit a website or open an app.
Data Monitor: Track per-app and per-connection Mobile or WiFi data usage.
fdroid:com.celzero.bravedns.category: Connectivity, DNS & Hosts, Firewall, Internet, Network Analyzer, Security, VPN & Proxy

fdroid:com.danefinlay.ttsutil.description:
TTS Util is a utility Android app for synthesising text into audible speech.
 Features:
 Read or create wave files from input text, clipboard text or text files using text-to-speech.
 Configure app-specific text-to-speech settings: engine, voice, pitch and speech rate.
 Custom silence for line endings, sentences, exclamations and questions.
 Text filters for omitting certain text elements from the audio.
 A playback-on-input mode for reading letters and words as they are typed.
 Buttons for retrieving commonly read text.
 Share menu entries and shortcuts for sharing input text to the app.
 Requirements:
 A device running Android version 4.0.3 or higher.
 A separate Android text-to-speech engine app.

fdroid:com.flasskamp.subz.name: Subz
fdroid:com.flasskamp.subz.summary: Subscription and contract management with notification function.
fdroid:com.flasskamp.subz.description:
Keep and eye on your subscriptions and contracts. Let you remind of cancelation periods.
 Add subscriptions and details like costs, billing interval, contract durations and cancelation period
 Show all subscriptions and their costs
 Show days until next billing
 Switch subscription cost overview to daily, weekly, monthly and yearly
 Modify and delete subscriptions
 Search for specific subscriptions
 Sort subscriptions by name, costs, etc.

fdroid:com.haringeymobile.ukweather.name: World Weather
fdroid:com.haringeymobile.ukweather.description:
Displays current weather and forecasts from OpenWeatherMap. Two kinds of
forecast are available: 14-day daily weather and 5-day three-hourly weather. You
can select any of the 200,000 cities supported by OpenWeatherMap.
 NonFreeNet: OpenWeatherMap service is not open.

fdroid:com.mablanco.pricegrab.name: PriceGrab
fdroid:com.mablanco.pricegrab.summary: Compare two supermarket prices and find the cheaper one per unit.
fdroid:com.mablanco.pricegrab.description:
PriceGrab answers one supermarket question: which of these two products is cheaper per unit? 
Type the price and quantity of offer A and offer B and the app instantly tells you which is the better deal, by how much you save per unit, and how big the relative discount is.
 Designed for the aisle, not for the lab 
• Material Design 3 with full dynamic-color theming on Android 12+ and a hand-tuned WCAG-AA palette on older devices.
• Locale-aware decimal input: comma in Spanish, dot in English. No more "is the period a thousands separator?" surprises.
• Inputs and result survive screen rotation and language changes.
 Accessibility-first 
• Every field has a localized content description that TalkBack reads.
• The result card is a polite live region: as soon as both offers parse, the screen reader announces who wins and how much you save.
• Non-color cue (a check icon) accompanies the winning offer so the design works in grayscale or for color-vision-deficient users.
 Privacy by design 
• 100% offline. The app declares no INTERNET permission.
• No analytics, no tracking, no ads, no accounts.
• No data ever leaves the device.
 Open source 
• MIT licensed.
• Reproducible Android build, no proprietary dependencies — F-Droid friendly.
• Source code: https://github.com/mablanco/pricegrab

fdroid:com.paranoid.privacylock.name: Paranoid's Pal - Privacy Lock
fdroid:com.paranoid.privacylock.description:
These days, maintaining privacy on our devices has become increasingly challenging. With so much of our personal information stored on our phones, it’s essential to ensure it stays protected, whether from accidental access or malicious intent. Imagine situations where someone unlocks your phone while you're unaware or a scammer forces access. These scenarios are all too real in today's world.
That’s why I developed Paranoid's Pal - Privacy Lock It’s designed to offer an extra layer of security on top of Android’s built-in features. Here’s what makes Paranoid's Pal stand out:
* Instant Lock with Shake: In urgent situations, just shake your phone, and it locks immediately, ensuring quick protection when you need it.
* Automatic Screen Lock: Your phone locks automatically once the screen turns off, ensuring it's secure even when you're not actively using it.
 Features: 
* Quick Tile Settings . Quick Settings are tiles displayed in the Quick Settings panel, representing actions, that users can tap to quickly complete instant lock.
* Shortcuts . Helps your quickly start common or recommended tasks within your app.
* Modern UI . Enjoy a visually appealing and modern interface, following the principles of the Material You design.
* Works offline and respects your privacy . Paranoid's Pal operates independently without needing an internet connection or online account registration. Your confidential data always remains on your device. Neither the developers nor any third parties can access your information.
* Adopted for Android 12 SplashScreen, Edge to Edge, Predictive Back navigation, enhancing modern Android UI experience.

fdroid:com.rascarlo.power.button.tile.name: Power Button Tile
fdroid:com.rascarlo.power.button.tile.summary: Add up to 3 quick settings tiles to the quick settings layout
fdroid:com.rascarlo.power.button.tile.description:
Simple application to add up to 3 quick settings tiles to the quick settings layout.

- Tile 
- TileService

fdroid:com.sweak.qralarm.summary: Disable alarms with a QR scanner

fdroid:com.upbad.apps.autonotify.name: AutoNotify
fdroid:com.upbad.apps.autonotify.summary: Relay notifications of any apps to Android Auto
fdroid:com.upbad.apps.autonotify.description:
Monitors notifications from user-selected apps and sends them to Android Auto.
Root is optional, solely used to list apps of other users (profiles) to obtain their info conveniently. However, no root is needed to monitor notifications for any app, including those of other users. To add an app of other users without root, use the "enter app info" button to enter its package name and user id manually.

fdroid:com.utyf.pmetro.name: pMetro
fdroid:com.utyf.pmetro.summary: Calculate shortest metro routes in Russia
fdroid:com.utyf.pmetro.description:
You can load ~200 metro maps of (mostly russian) cities available from the
 pMetro project . After that you can build shortest route and
calculate trip time using subway and other city transports. There is additional
information for stations and 2D schemas (double tap for show).

fdroid:dummydomain.yetanothercallblocker.name: Yet Another Call Blocker
fdroid:dummydomain.yetanothercallblocker.description:
A simple call blocking application that will help you avoid answering unwanted calls
using a crowdsourced phone number database.
 Features: 
* Uses offline database.
* Blocks calls with negative rating automatically (option).
* Local blacklist with wildcard support.
* Displays a notification with phone number summary (rating, reviews count, category) during incoming calls (option).
* Automatic incremental/delta database updates (option).
* You can view online reviews for caller's number (provided by 3rd party service).
* "Advanced call blocking mode" for blocking calls on Android 7+ before the phone starts ringing (needs to be manually enabled in app Settings).
 How to use: 
* Install and launch the app.
* The option to show caller info notifications is enabled by default, so the app will ask for phone-related permissions.
* At first start, the app will suggest to download main database which is required for most of the functions. Simply confirm the download.
* Check the "Auto-update database" checkbox in the menu (recommended) to automatically receive daily DB updates (these are incremental/delta updates, so they consume very little traffic).
* Check the "Block by rating" checkbox to block calls with negative rating automatically.
* You can also check the "Use contacts" checkbox if you want your contacts not to be treated as unknown callers.
* After these steps everything should just work (but you can always find more options in Settings). Enjoy!
See frequently asked questions to learn more.
The main phone number database is downloaded from a gitlab repository .
 Database updates and detailed review queries are performed using 3rd-party servers. 
No user-identifiable information is sent (except for the phone number
the detailed reviews are loaded for).
Yet Another Call Blocker is still under development. Any help is welcome.
''NonFreeNet:'' the 3rd-party service is not open source.

fdroid:io.github.acidefluorhydrique.voic.name: Voice Memos
fdroid:io.github.acidefluorhydrique.voic.summary: A voice recorder with an inline player and a trim editor, no ads, no network
fdroid:io.github.acidefluorhydrique.voic.description:
A voice recorder that gets out of the way. Every recording lives in one list, a tap unfolds the player right inside the row, and the red button at the bottom starts a new one.
Voice Memos has no ads, no trackers, no analytics and no network access whatsoever. It does not even ask for the internet permission. Your recordings stay on your device, in your own audio folder.
 Recording 
* A live waveform and a timer down to hundredths of a second
* Keeps recording in the background when you leave the app
* Pause and resume, or discard a take you do not want
* AAC (M4A), AMR-NB, AMR-WB and Opus, in three quality levels
* Stereo recording, skip silence and Bluetooth microphone support
* Optionally pauses on an incoming call
 Playback 
* Scrub along the waveform
* Skip back and forward 15 seconds
* Playback speed of 0.5x, 1x, 1.5x or 2x
* Media notification controls
 Trim editor 
Drag the yellow handles over the waveform to pick a section, then trim to keep it or delete to remove it. Edits are previewed before anything is written, and the result is always saved as a new recording, so the original is never touched.
 Organise 
* Search, rename, favourite and share recordings
* Swipe a row for quick actions
* Recently Deleted keeps removed recordings for 30 days so they can be recovered
* Home screen widgets for your latest recordings and a one tap record button
* Light, dark or automatic appearance
 Permissions 
* Microphone, to record
* Audio files, to list and play your recordings
* Notifications, for the recording and playback controls
* Phone state, optional, to pause during a call
* Approximate location, optional, to tag M4A recordings with where they were made. It uses the location built into Android, not Google Play Services
 Free software 
Released under the MIT licence. Built on the RecorderApp engine by tuuhin, with an interface redrawn to follow the interaction patterns of the iOS Voice Memos app. This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple.
Interface in English, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese.

fdroid:io.github.h3yk0.cryo.name: Cryo
fdroid:io.github.h3yk0.cryo.summary: Personal finance by voice: forecast, cards, debts, budgets and goals
fdroid:io.github.h3yk0.cryo.description:
Cryo is a simple yet complete personal finance app. It tracks income, expenses, credit cards, debts, investments and savings goals, and shows everything in one clear overview.
 Log money the way you talk 
Type or say a phrase like "lunch 32.50 on debit" or "tv 1200 in 10 installments on credit card". Cryo understands the amount, category, account, date and even installments. You just check and save. It also learns from your corrections.
 Features 
 Overview: account balances, net worth, and what came in and went out this month
 On-device financial engine: end-of-month forecast with a range, recurring payments found automatically, balance for the next 12 months, unusual charges, financial health score, debt payoff plan and real investment returns
 Spending heatmap calendar: each day is colored by how much you spent
 Money flow chart: where your money came from and where it went
 Bank statement import (OFX, CSV, XLSX spreadsheet or PDF): review the list before anything is added, and entries already in the app are left out
 Credit cards: statements, available credit and installment purchases
 Debts: loans, financing, payment plans and money you owe someone, with installments, overdue alerts, what is left and when you will be debt-free
 Recurring bills and income, with due-date reminders
 Budgets per category, with alerts at 80% and when exceeded
 Savings goals that tell you how much to save per month, with an archive for finished ones
 Investments: contributions, withdrawals and returns
 Transfers between accounts
 Real privacy 
 Your data stays on your phone. The app has no internet permission
 No account, no ads, no tracking
 Lock with fingerprint, face or your device PIN
 Option to hide amounts on screen
 Automatic backup to a folder on your phone or to your cloud (Google Drive, Nextcloud and others): the cloud app does the uploading
 Password-protected backups (AES-256), with the key kept in Android's secure keystore
 File backup and spreadsheet (CSV) export
 Material You design 
Colors follow your wallpaper (Android 12+), with light and dark themes.
Voice entry uses the speech recognizer installed on your device. Typing the phrase always works.
Available in 10 languages (Portuguese, English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese and Hindi), in the currency you choose.

fdroid:io.github.muntashirakon.unapkm.name: UnApkm - Convert APKM to APKS
fdroid:io.github.muntashirakon.unapkm.summary: Decrypt Apk Mirror's APKM files and save them as APKS
fdroid:io.github.muntashirakon.unapkm.description:
Apk Mirror's APKM is an encrypted bundled app format which can only be installed using their own installer. UnApkm is a small utility software that converts an APKM to APKS which can be installed via an split apk installer that supports APKS format.
 Instructions: The app doesn't have any GUI. Goto your favourite file manager, select an apkm file and open it with UnApkm. You will be asked to provide a save location. When the conversion is complete, you'll see a toast message at the bottom saying "success". You can find the apks file in your provided location.

fdroid:io.github.sigmasd.foldercamera.name: Folder Camera
fdroid:io.github.sigmasd.foldercamera.summary: Take photos straight into folders, with optional secure transfer to your PC
fdroid:io.github.sigmasd.foldercamera.description:
Choose a folder. Take your photos. Keep every shot in its place.
Folder Camera is a native Android camera for organizing photos as you capture them. Choose a base directory with Android's folder picker, then enter or select a relative path before shooting. Nested folders, ordinary spaces and Unicode names are supported.
• Capture JPEG photos directly into the folder you confirmed
• Find destinations using a searchable folder tree
• Change folders between sessions without replacing existing photos
• Use pinch or slider zoom and Off, Auto, Flash or Always-on light modes when supported by your camera
• Preview, share and export photos through Android
• Keep saved photos accessible to other apps and after uninstall
• Capture without a PC, account or internet connection
Optional LAN transfer
Pair with the free, open-source desktop receiver to send copies directly to your PC over certificate-verified HTTPS. Sync is off by default. Pending transfers survive temporary connection failures and keep their original destination. The first receiver startup automatically selects a private LAN address and shows a pairing QR.
Privacy and control
No advertising, analytics or developer-operated photo server. No broad all-files access. You choose the Android and PC folders independently. The app is GPL-3.0-or-later open-source software; source code and support are available through the project website.
The optional desktop receiver is available for Linux, Windows and macOS, with its runtime and certificate generation included. Optional PC uploads are not required for local capture. Background upload timing is controlled by Android. Recover/export private staging before uninstalling; private app metadata and pairing credentials do not survive uninstall.

fdroid:io.github.toolicious.labler.name: LaBLEr
fdroid:io.github.toolicious.labler.summary: Design labels and print them on a P15/P12/L13 Bluetooth thermal printer
fdroid:io.github.toolicious.labler.description:
LaBLEr is a label printer app for Bluetooth Low Energy thermal label printers of the Marklife family (P15, P12, L13). Design your own labels right on your phone, save them as templates, and print them again anytime. It talks to the printer directly over Bluetooth LE, with no account, no cloud, and no vendor app.
Features:
* Multi-line text (size, bold/italic/underline, alignment, several bundled fonts plus your own TTF and OTF files), symbols and emoji, frames, imported images, and QR codes and barcodes (Code 128, EAN-13, UPC-A, Code 39, ITF) with typed QR content for links, Wi-Fi, email, phone and contacts.
* A direct-manipulation editor: pinch to zoom and pan, drag to move, resize and rotate, with snapping to the center, the edges and other elements. Graphics render for the 1-bit thermal head as a clean outline (region tracing or Canny edge detection, with a smooth pass and invert) or with a threshold, Floyd-Steinberg or Atkinson dithering.
* Templates: save, rename, duplicate, favorite and search; export a single label as a JSON file, or back up and restore your whole library.
* Placeholders for the date, the time, a running number, or a free-text value you are asked for at print time.
* An exact 1-bit preview, a choice of copies and die-cut or continuous media, and a print history you can reproduce.
* Reconnects to your saved printer automatically. Available in 17 languages, Material 3 design, light and dark following the system.
Privacy: LaBLEr is a fully local app. It does not declare the INTERNET permission, so the process cannot open a network connection at all. No account, no cloud, no analytics, no tracking. Your templates, print history and settings live in the app's private storage and never leave the device.
Only the P15 is verified on-device so far; the P12 and L13 use the same protocol and 12 mm (96-dot) print head.

apple-macos:6766652023.description:
Nota Scriptura is a notes app for sermons and Bible study that understands Scripture.
Type a reference like "Romans 8:28" or "1 Cor 13:4-7" anywhere in your notes and it's recognized as you write — turned blue, tied to that passage, and one tap away from the verse text. There's nothing to set up: the complete World English Bible is built into the app, so verse text is there immediately, even offline.
YOUR OWN COMMENTARY
Mark any paragraph as a verse note and it joins your personal commentary — every insight you've ever written, gathered from every note and arranged in biblical order. Jump to any book and chapter, search it, and tap any entry to go back to the sermon it came from. Export the whole thing, a single book, or your search results as rich text.
JUST WRITE
• Bold, italic, underline, headings
• Track the speaker and date for each sermon
• Recognizes single verses, ranges, cross-chapter ranges and lists ("Rom 1:1,3,5"), and optionally whole chapters
• Optionally expands abbreviations to full book names as you type
STUDY PANEL
Tap a reference to open the passage beside your notes — side by side on iPad and Mac, and as a slide-up panel on iPhone — along with the other notes you've written on those verses.
FIND ANYTHING
Search understands the Bible: search "Genesis" to find every note that touches it, or "John 3:16" to find notes on that verse — including notes that cover it within a range.
SAFE AND IN SYNC
• Notes sync through your own private iCloud Drive across iPhone, iPad and Mac
• Version history keeps recent versions of each note, so you can restore any of them
• Back up and restore your whole library
• Share notes as rich text or PDF, or send them to another Nota Scriptura user
PRIVATE BY DESIGN

 Features:
 See your notes as you write: jot down something for later, plan our where a scene will go before writing it, or summarize a scene to help organize your story
 Fill out notes in the editor: Dedicated documents for characters and information about the world
 Syncing support: delete files, move them, or add new ones. Cheese Paper will automatically process it, no restart required
 Simple files: the file format is specifically designed to be simple enough to edit on a phone. Sync to another device and access your project at all times
 Themes: Use supplied dark and light themes, or create your own
 Outline Export: Produce a single file outline containing your notes (but not story prose) which can easily be shared
 Story Export: Combine all of the scenes into a single markdown file that can easily be transformed into a wide variety of formats, including epub, docx, html, or pdf (with programs such as Pandoc)
 Randomize your theme: text too readable? Colors too pleasant? Not enough whimsy? Randomize every single color with no coordination, no consistency, and no concern for contrast (to the horror of everyone around you)
 The underlying text is all Markdown, so the file format is simple. Metadata is added to the underlying format in a TOML header, also simple and easy to edit. Any files created outside the editor are automatically read in and processed like any other files, even if some or all of the metadata is missing. It is entirely possible to create, edit, move, and delete files from another text editor, even your phone. Cheese Paper also plays nicely with syncing programs - if you sync the files on disk, it will happily load them.

flathub:io.github.lullabyX.sone.description:
SONE is a native, lightweight desktop client for TIDAL on Linux that pairs a modern, polished
 interface with bit-perfect, lossless Hi-Res audio — no compromise on either. Built with Tauri and
 Rust, it's small and fully native. The interface is customizable to the core: a full-screen player
 with karaoke-style synced lyrics, a floating miniplayer, and a theming engine that derives a complete
 light or dark palette from any two colors.
 It streams your library in lossless FLAC and Hi-Res quality up to 24-bit/192kHz, with gapless,
 silence-free playback. For bit-perfect output, exclusive ALSA mode bypasses PulseAudio and PipeWire
 entirely, sending the unaltered signal straight to your DAC — or use normal mode for casual listening
 through your system's default output.
 Audio
 Lossless FLAC and Hi-Res streaming up to 24-bit/192kHz
 Exclusive ALSA output — bypasses PulseAudio and PipeWire, sending bit-perfect audio straight
 to your DAC
 Bit-perfect mode with bit-depth promotion to your DAC's native depth
 Automatic DAC format and sample-rate detection, with graceful fallback on mismatches
 Channel negotiation and a stereo mix matrix for fixed-channel DACs
 Hot-swap DACs — the ALSA output re-initialises on device change, no restart needed
 Signal Path Transparency — inspect the live pipeline and confirm a pristine, bit-clean path
 to your DAC
 Gapless, silence-free playback
 Volume normalization (ReplayGain) with automatic album/track switching
 Video
 Music video playback in a dedicated player — full-screen or minimized to the player bar,
 with HLS streaming that starts at your selected quality and adapts to your bandwidth (video audio
 is streamed, not the bit-perfect path)
 Videos and tracks share one queue, with shuffle, repeat, autoplay, and history across both

flathub:org.quassel_irc.QuasselClient.name: Quassel Client
flathub:org.quassel_irc.QuasselClient.description:
Quassel IRC is a modern, cross-platform, distributed IRC client based on the Qt framework.
 Distributed means that one (or multiple) client(s) can attach to and detach from a central core that stays permanently online -- much like the popular combination of screen and a text-based IRC client such as WeeChat, and similar to (but much more featureful than) so-called BNCs. Re-attaching your client will show your IRC session in the same state as you left it in (plus whatever happened while you were gone), and this even when you re-attach from a different location. In addition, Quassel IRC can be used like a traditional client, with providing both client and core functionality in one binary. This so-called "Monolithic Client" completely hides the distributed nature, so for a purely local installation, Quassel IRC can be setup very easily.
 Cross-platform means that Quassel IRC is developed for and tested on Linux®, Windows®, and MacOS X®. It should also run on any other platform that is supported by the Qt library. Third-party mobile clients for Android and iOS also exist.
 By modern we mean that Quassel IRC will have all the features you'd expect from an IRC client nowadays. It also innovates in many areas. For example, the GUI features a dockable nicklist and topic bar, or you can arrange your channel and query buffers in default or custom views, which are also dockable. This means that you can arrange your GUI as you please. The architecture allows for other innovations, such as on-demand creation of log files in custom formats from the backlog.

Features: * Simple to set up: * Single binary, no other files. * Standalone, doesn't need inetd or ucspi-tcp. * No messing around with config files. * Written in C - efficient and portable. * Small memory footprint. * Event loop, single threaded - no fork() or pthreads. * Generates directory listings. * Supports HTTP GET and HEAD requests. * Supports Range / partial content. * Supports If-Modified-Since. * Supports Keep-Alive connections. * Can serve 301 redirects based on Host header. * Uses sendfile(). Security: * Can log accesses, including Referer and User-Agent. * Can chroot. * Can drop privileges. * Impervious to /../ sniffing. * Times out idle connections. * Drops overly long requests. Limitations: * This server only serves static content - *NO* CGI supported!

firefox-addons:3038292.name: Development Tenant Banner

firefox-addons:3038292.description:
Tenant Banner adds a small colored ribbon to the corner of the screen that tells you at a glance which environment you're working in - staging, UAT, production, or any custom environment you define. Built for admins, developers, and consultants who move between multiple environments daily and want a clear, unmissable signal before making changes.
Works with any web-based platform or admin console, cloud-hosted or on-prem. You define each environment yourself: a label, a snippet of the URL to match (like -stg. or admin.internal.corp), a banner color, and the text shown on the ribbon. Add as many environments as you need, reorder them to control match priority, and pick which corner of the screen the banner appears in.
All settings are stored locally in your browser. Nothing is collected or sent anywhere.
Features:
- Custom environment list with color, label, and banner text per entry
- Substring URL matching, works for any domain naming convention
- One global corner setting for consistent banner placement
- Live updates when settings change, no page reload needed
- Clear-all option to reset to defaults

bluejetty:00029761:ios.description:
PokeMate is the most popular platform for you to stay connected with your Pokémon GO friends.
• Find New Global Trainers, Receive Gifts, and Grind XP
Among 3.5 million trainers around the world, find a new friend instantly. Send or receive gifts and get friendship XP for each of them.
• Receive Worldwide Post Cards & Collect All Vivillon Patterns
Receive post cards from all over the world to complete your Villion patterns.
• Meet Your Local Community with PokeMate Clans
Trainers around your area are waiting for you. Organize local raids, mirror trades, and more. Find out who is playing in your area and meet them for in-person events.
• Find In-Game Trainers
Did a remote raid but cannot communicate with other trainers in the lobby? Saw trainers in your local gym and want to message them? They are all on PokeMate.

Don’t stress about not being able to use a lucky egg before becoming best friends. Just chat with your soon-to-be best friends to synchronize your lucky eggs.

Find worldwide friends to receive gifts from all over the world! Obtain your Platinum Pilot badge with the help of your long-distance friends.
• Verified Trainers
To make sure you are communicating with the right trainer, PokeMate verifies all trainers by asking for their in-game profile screenshots.
• Break the Language Barrier
Break the language barrier! Use the integrated translation service to connect with your friends even though you don’t speak the same language.
• Location Privacy
We respect your privacy. Therefore we do not share your location with other trainers.
DISCLAIMER
PokeMate is a third-party application to help trainers to get in touch with each other. It is not affiliated with Pokémon GO, Niantic, Nintendo, or The Pokémon Company.

Aim for escape while searching for and using items and hints!
[Hint Function] Even if you are new to escape games, you can clear it by looking at the hints. (Advertisements will be played)

bluejetty:00131506:ios.description:
► JUST BOUNCE AND DUNK
When you’re a basketball, what else are you going to do but head for the hoops? Dribble the ball along the mean streets of the big city, shooting hoops and stunning hoodlums in this entertaining casual platformer that never stops hustling in basketball games. Find out if you’ve got the skills to dunk hard, grab the cash, and dribble hoops in the next level in this fun freestyling game.
► Get slamming! 
Each level in the game consists of a series of obstacles, basketball hoops, dollar bills, street thugs and boxes of fruit that you have to dribble the ball through. Dodge, smash, grab, and score as appropriate in an endless series of fun games for kids:
●Make it rain! Make the ball bounce to hit every hoop in the level and smash every target to match the highest score so far in the game, or set your own benchmark for the perfect round with all the buckets you can score!
●Defend the zone! Clean up the streets as you play jump games by knocking down hoodlums, some of whom you’ll catch red-handed in the act of mugging innocent passers-by, so flap dunk on them fast!
●Hit all the right notes! Play the note boxes, smash the fruits, and enjoy the sound of breaking glass. Some obstacles in the game won’t bring you points or money, they’re just fun to slam dunk!
●Don’t get blocked! Avoid potholes and rows of spikes or you’ll have to take your ball home and start the level again.
●It’s mushrooming! Hit toadstools to double the size of your ball for extra points and extra destructive power until the end of the level.
●Absolute car-nage! There’s a huge range of beautiful cars in your path. Bounce hard enough on them and the wheels will fall off.
●Fly the flag! End each level of mini basketball on a high note by getting the flag as high up the flagpole as you can for extra satisfaction and extra points!
► MORE THAN JUST BOUNCING
There’s plenty in regular levels of Bounce Dunk to keep you entertained for hours of balling fun, but if that’s not enough:
►Boss it! 
Reach boss levels where your task is to knock the thugs out of their lowrider just by bouncing on it. Dribble hard to dislodge them all and grab the big bucks from the trunk!
Fashiona-ball! Want to bounce with a glitter ball? Take the cash you’ve earned on the streets and spend it on a huge range of cool new ball and shield skins that you’ll unlock as you complete levels.
► ARE YOU A BALLER?
Interested in fun kids basketball games with a little street style and swagger? Clean graphics, great beats, and incredibly satisfying haptic bounce effects enhance your gameplay experience and will keep you coming back to bounce and jump dunk again and again! Download Bounce Dunk now and get ready to shoot some hoops and cause some mayhem!
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

Each level in the game consists of a series of obstacles, basketball hoops, dollar bills, street thugs and boxes of fruit that you have to dribble the ball through. Dodge, smash, grab, and score as appropriate in an endless series of fun games for kids:

●Make it rain! Make the ball bounce to hit every hoop in the level and smash every target to match the highest score so far in the game, or set your own benchmark for the perfect round with all the buckets you can score!
●Defend the zone! Clean up the streets as you play jump games by knocking down hoodlums, some of whom you’ll catch red-handed in the act of mugging innocent passers-by, so flap dunk on them fast!
●Hit all the right notes! Play the note boxes, smash the fruits, and enjoy the sound of breaking glass. Some obstacles in the game won’t bring you points or money, they’re just fun to slam dunk!
●Don’t get blocked! Avoid potholes and rows of spikes or you’ll have to take your ball home and start the level again.
●It’s mushrooming! Hit toadstools to double the size of your ball for extra points and extra destructive power until the end of the level.
●Absolute car-nage! There’s a huge range of beautiful cars in your path. Bounce hard enough on them and the wheels will fall off.
●Fly the flag! End each level of mini basketball on a high note by getting the flag as high up the flagpole as you can for extra satisfaction and extra points!

► MORE THAN JUST BOUNCING
There’s plenty in regular levels of Bounce Dunk to keep you entertained for hours of balling fun, but if that’s not enough:

►Boss it! 
Reach boss levels where your task is to knock the thugs out of their lowrider just by bouncing on it. Dribble hard to dislodge them all and grab the big bucks from the trunk!
Fashiona-ball! Want to bounce with a glitter ball? Take the cash you’ve earned on the streets and spend it on a huge range of cool new ball and shield skins that you’ll unlock as you complete levels.

► ARE YOU A BALLER?
Interested in fun kids basketball games with a little street style and swagger? Clean graphics, great beats, and incredibly satisfying haptic bounce effects enhance your gameplay experience and will keep you coming back to bounce and jump dunk again and again! Download Bounce Dunk now and get ready to shoot some hoops and cause some mayhem!

bluejetty:00166733:ios.description:
Swipe2delete is your new best friend for cleaning up your camera roll, and it’s actually fun!
Sure, there are other apps out there that promise to help you declutter your photos. But let’s be real, they are either too complicated or just... boring. We wanted something simple, enjoyable, and super efficient. And thats how Swipe2delete was born!
So, how does it work? Easy: swipe right to keep a photo and swipe left to delete it. If you have second thoughts, no worries! Tap to undo and keep that snap. When you’re done with a batch, get a final look at what’s staying and what’s going, make any last-minute changes, and voila, mission complete!
Why month by month? Because we like our memories neat and organized! Swipe2delete helps you tackle your photos one month at a time, so it’s not overwhelming. And once you’ve finished a month, it gets checked off your list (but don’t worry, you can always go back if you want). Didn’t finish sorting? No biggie! Your progress is saved, with a handy progress wheel showing how much is left.
Your camera roll should be a highlight reel, not a cluttered mess of duplicates, blurry shots, and endless screenshots. With Swipe2delete, it’s all about rediscovering your best moments, without the clutter.
Feeling nostalgic? Check out our “On This Day" feature! Each day, we bring back photos from the same date in past years. Relive those memories and decide what’s worth keeping, one swipe at a time. It’s the perfect blend of fun and functionality!
With Swipe2delete you are able to clean your phone's camera roll using a simple and easy to use interface. Simply swipe left or right. It's such an easy photo cleaner, you will declutter your phone in no time!
Join thousands of happy users, that have collectively deleted over 15 million photos (and videos). That's alot of GB!
Happy swiping!

bluejetty:00083868:ios.summary: Use Jeff's run walk run® timer to track your workouts or subscribe for complete guidance from legendary Olympian, Jeff Galloway. Whether you're looking to complete your first 5K or improve your marathon finish time, Jeff has the perfect tra
bluejetty:00083868:ios.description:
Use Jeff's run walk run® timer to track your workouts or subscribe for complete guidance from legendary Olympian, Jeff Galloway. Whether you're looking to complete your first 5K or improve your marathon finish time, Jeff has the perfect training program for you. Jeff's unique run walk run® training method uses the principles of High Intensity Interval Training (HIIT) to quickly and safely improve your running strength, speed, and endurance. 
Try a free 7-day trial of Premium Access!
• Complete guidance every step of the way. Programs for 5K, 10K, half marathon, marathon and more!
• Custom programs for beginners to advanced athletes.
• Includes periodic Magic Mile Tests to measure your progress and dial in your pace.
• Set the beat of your music to the cadence of your run.
• Drills to help you improve your running strength, speed, and form.
• Over 70 healthy recipes to power your training.
• Daily tips to guide you every step of the way.
• Includes GPS tracking.
• Works outside or on a treadmill.
• Completely interactive. Change your workout at anytime and your coach Jeff Galloway — and your music — will respond!
• Sync your workouts to the Health app.
Bonus Content: Includes 40 tracks of high-energy fitness music for FREE.
EXPERT INSTRUCTION
Jeff Galloway is truly a running legend. He ran with Steve Prefontaine, Bill Rodgers, Frank Shorter, and Amby Burfoot when the United States was a leading power in marathoning. He ran in over 235 marathons and continues to average about 7 marathons a year. Jeff is also a legendary running coach, with over 50 years of expertise safely progressing runners of all levels to the finish line with a smile on their faces. Jeff's running books have sold over a million copies, and was a regular contributor to Runner's World. If you're looking for an expert coach, why not have one of the best in the world?
DESIGNED AROUND YOU
Whether you're looking to complete your first race or you want to improve your time, Jeff Galloway Run Walk Run has the perfect program for you. Your pace and run walk run® ratio of each workout is customized to your ability, plus Jeff Galloway Run Walk Run gives you complete control as you move through your workout. Turn the intensity down a bit when you're struggling or crank it up when you're ready for more, and Jeff Galloway Run Walk Run adjusts your workout — and your music — on the fly.
CUSTOMIZED MEAL PLANNER
Jeff Galloway Run Walk Run is also your personal diet coach with the Advanced Meal Planner system that helps you power your training with healthy meals designed for runners. Beyond just planning your own meals, the Advanced Meal Planner System features tools to help plan meals for the whole family!
• Over 70 quick, delicious and nutritious recipes, designed specifically for runners
• Ban ingredients or meals to customize your options
• Grocery lists
• Dynamically adjust recipes for weight loss, maintenance, or extra fuel for your workouts
• Pick the meals and days to eat on or off plan
• Dynamically adjust number of servings in a recipe
• Options for batch cooking so you can plan to eat delicious leftovers
• Mark favorite recipes
Works with Health
• Completed workouts sync to the Health app, including distance, calories burned and duration.
* Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
SUBSCRIPTION & PRICING TERMS
We offer 2 premium subscription plans: Monthly (1 month) or Annual (12 months). Unless canceled or auto-renew is turned off 24-hours before the end of subscription term or the 7-day trial period, you will be billed automatically based on your chosen subscription plan at the end of the free trial or on your subscription renewal date.
Manage your subscription and disable auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase or trial start. Read our full Terms and Conditions as well as Privacy Policy:
http://jeffgalloway.com/app/tos
http://jeffgalloway.com/app/privacy

bluejetty:00129318:ios.summary: The SBLive Sports app brings high school sports fans closer to the action than ever - with breaking news, live score updates and alerts, video highlights, social content and more. Follow your favorite high school teams with easy-to-navigate
bluejetty:00129318:ios.description:
The SBLive Sports app brings high school sports fans closer to the action than ever - with breaking news, live score updates and alerts, video highlights, social content and more. Follow your favorite high school teams with easy-to-navigate schedules, scores, rosters and standings. Stay up-to-date with the biggest stories in high school sports. All in one app.
Key Features
• Favorites: Personalize your experience by following your favorite teams. 
• News: Explore great original content from SBLive - your best source for high school sports news from around the country.
• Scores: See every game at a glance, with many scores updated in real-time.
• Videos: Watch exciting highlights, insightful interviews and more featuring your favorite teams and players.
• Rankings: Track your teams throughout the season as they try to climb to the top of SBLive's expert and computer rankings.
• Playoffs: Hop on the bandwagon and follow your teams on the road to the state championship with up-to-date brackets and the best playoff coverage around.
• Podcasts: Listen to "The Iso with Dan Dickau" and all of your favorite podcasts from SBLive Sports, right in the app.
• Social Content: Discover trending social stories from the biggest names in high school sports.
• Alerts: Enable notifications so you never miss exciting updates from your favorite teams.
COACHES & ADs: Download our free team management and scoring app, SBLive GameDay, to live score games, submit final scores and more.
Need help, have feedback or want to request a new feature? Email us at support@scorebooklive.com or tweet us @SBLiveHelp

bluejetty:00162749:ios.description:
Check your current stress score from 1 to 100 simply by placing your finger on your smartphone camera!
With over 3 million downloads, "Stress Scan" is back with a major renewal. It analyzes your autonomic nervous system balance through your pulse to visualize the stress on your mind and body.
Back by Popular Demand!
Once scheduled to end, Stress Scan is back due to overwhelming user request! We have relaunched with a fresh new design and upgraded features.
Featured in Major Media!
Featured on popular Japanese TV shows like "Matsuko's Unknown World," "King's Brunch," "HikakinTV," and in leading magazines such as "AERA" and "Tarzan"!
Do Any of These Sound Familiar?
・Feeling overwhelmed by recent stress or fatigue
・Struggling to recover even after taking time off
・Experiencing ongoing fatigue or feeling out of sorts
・Sensing that your autonomic nervous system is out of balance
・Wanting to objectively track your stress level as a number
・Wanting to check your nervous level before an important event
Key Features of Stress Scan
・Quick 60-Second Stress Assessment
Simply place your fingertip over the smartphone camera and light. Based on Heart Rate Variability (HRV) analysis, it measures your current stress state. Heart rate (bpm) is also measured simultaneously.
・Identify Stress Causes With Tags
Tag your situation (e.g., Working, Day Off, Post-Exercise) during measurement to view average stress scores for each context. Discover when and where you feel most stressed.
・Build a Habit With Reminders
Set custom notification alarms at your preferred times to make daily self-care a consistent habit.
・Easy Data Transfer When Upgrading Devices
By registering an account, you can easily transfer your measurement history to a new device. *You can also use the app without creating an account.
More new features are scheduled to launch soon!
How Does a Smartphone Camera Measure Stress?
It is scientifically proven that stress and fatigue disrupt the balance of the autonomic nervous system, which controls essential bodily functions.
Stress Scan detects subtle blood flow (pulse) changes through your phone camera to analyze your autonomic nerve balance:
Sympathetic Dominance (Higher heart rate, low variability) → Higher Stress Score
Balanced Autonomic State (Calmer heart rate, higher variability) → Lower Stress Score
Grounding in Trusted Science
Our measurements are based on Heart Rate Variability (HRV) analysis—a widely recognized methodology in heart rate and autonomic nervous system research. HRV analysis is an advanced stress-care technology utilized in high-stakes fields, including PTSD treatment for veterans by the U.S. Military and health management for astronauts at NASA.
Great for Various Everyday Situations!
・Daily health checkups and condition monitoring
・Measuring relaxation levels during meals or hobbies
・Checking the calming effect of travels or favorite places
・Gauging tension before big presentations or exams
・Sharing measurement results on social media with friends and family
Tips for Accurate Measurement & Stress Care*Individual responses to stress may vary.
・For Accurate Results: Heart rate increases after meals or workouts, which can temporarily inflate your score. Please measure while seated quietly at rest.
・Age Trends: Stress scores naturally tend to increase with age.
・When Your Score Is High: Take slow, deep breaths to help your body relax.
・Lifestyle Habits: Prioritizing sufficient sleep, moderate exercise, and weight management helps maintain a lower stress score over time.
Note: The advice provided within Habitone is for informational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice or diagnosis. Always consult with a doctor or specialist for medical decisions.
Terms of Use: https://www.dumsco.com/policy/B9awe89fwkcw5iXzGQYT/en

Turn your iPhone into a 3D tape measure, camera ruler, and room planning tool. Tape Measure Camera Ruler 3D helps you estimate room area, height, width, length, wall dimensions, floor plans, and distance directly in the live camera view.
Use augmented reality to place measurement points on floors, walls, furniture, pictures, buildings, and other objects. The app overlays virtual 3D measurements on the camera image, so you can quickly check dimensions when a physical ruler or tape measure is not nearby.
Watch our video here: https://ibn-software.com/tape-measure-camera#download
► Featured measurements
• Measure room area and floor size
• Measure height, width, and length
• Measure rectangular areas
• Measure distance from the camera to an object
• Create a 2D floor plan from measurements
• Export a PDF plan
• Use metric or imperial units
► Benefits of the Pro Version:
• No advertisements
• Enable "Room Area" measurement mode
• "Rectangular Area" measurement mode
• "Distance to camera" measurement mode
► Limitations
This app is designed for quick estimates and planning, not for precision work. Do not use it where exact construction, architecture, safety, or trade measurements are required. For critical measurements, use a professional measuring tool or a traditional tape measure.

bluejetty:00126743:ios.description:
What boy or girl is not fascinated by animals? Enjoy and learn while discovering seven vertebrates of the Amazon rainforest with all their systems - such as circulatory, nervous, and digestive - their skeleton, reproduction, and most amazing abilities.
Play and discover the macaws, electric eels, poison dart frog, spider monkey, anaconda, pink river dolphin, and jaguar with this educational and fun application ideal for the most curious users.
Explore the Amazon rainforest and some of its vertebrates: fish, birds, amphibians, reptiles, and mammals. With amazing animated and interactive illustrations.
Children learn by observing, making assumptions, playing, exploring, and asking questions in the app. No rules, no time limit, and no stress. Suitable for all ages!
FEATURES
• Discover vertebrates
• With beautiful and lively illustrations
• Explore the curious facts and abilities of each animal
• Watch how the frog catches its prey
• Learn about the skeleton and the names of bones
• Watch how the monkey uses its limbs
• Feed each animal
• Learn how fish breathe underwater
• Teach a parrot how to imitate your voice
• Discover how a dolphin uses echolocation to find its prey
• Try a jaguar's night vision
• Content for children aged three and up, games for the whole family
• No ads
ABOUT LEARNY LAND
At Learny Land, we love to play, and we believe that games must form part of the educational and growth stage of all children; because to play is to discover, explore, learn and have fun. Our educational games help children learn about the world around them and are designed with love. They are easy to use, beautiful and safe. Because boys and girls have always played to have fun and learn, the games we make - like the toys that last a lifetime - can be seen, played and heard.
At Learny Land we take advantage of the most innovative technologies and the most modern devices to take the experience of learning and playing a step further. We create toys that could not have existed when we were young.
Read more about us at www.learnyland.com.
Privacy Policy
We take Privacy very seriously. We do not collect or share personal information about your children or allow any type of third party ads. To learn more, please read our privacy policy at www.learnyland.com.
Contact us

bluejetty:00069345:ios.description:
Memory Game Classic — Train your brain and have fun!
Train your brain and have fun at the same time with Memory Game Classic — the ultimate card-matching game loved by players around the world!
Flip cards, find pairs, and put your memory to the test in this beautifully simple and relaxing classic. Perfect for kids, adults, and anyone who enjoys a good mental challenge, Memory Game Classic offers endless replayability and satisfying gameplay that never gets old.
Multiple Game Modes
Whether you’re playing alone or with friends, Memory Game Classic offers fun for everyone.
Single-Player Mode:
Play through 10 carefully crafted stages, each with a slightly higher level of difficulty. As you progress, the number of cards increases, making every new stage a rewarding test of focus and memory.
Can you make it all the way to level 10?
Two-Player Mode:
Enjoy friendly competition on the same device! Choose from three difficulty levels and see who can find the most pairs. It’s a simple, fun way to spend time together — great for families, couples, and friends.
Simple, Colorful Design
Enjoy a clean, colorful design that keeps your focus where it belongs — on the cards.
Everything about Memory Game Classic is designed for ease of play, from smooth animations to intuitive touch controls. Whether you play for a few minutes or a few hours, you’ll appreciate its simplicity and comfort.
Quick and Addictive Gameplay
Each round is short and satisfying — perfect for a quick break, a relaxing evening, or when you just need a moment to unwind.
No complicated rules, no pressure. Just pure, enjoyable gameplay that you can pick up and play anytime, anywhere.
Relax, Focus, and Train Your Brain
Studies show that memory games can boost focus, attention, and overall brain health.
By challenging yourself to remember patterns and positions, you’re giving your mind a gentle workout that improves concentration over time. It’s fun, calming, and beneficial all at once — a great habit for daily brain training.
Why Play Memory Game Classic?
Completely free to play — no hidden costs or in-app purchases.
Designed for all ages — easy for beginners, engaging for adults.
Improves memory and focus through fun repetition.
Works smoothly on any device with a small app size.
Regular updates and improvements keep the game fresh and enjoyable.
Ideal for both solo play and two-player challenges.
Whether you’re waiting for a friend, relaxing at home, or taking a short break during work, Memory Game Classic is the perfect companion.
Its simplicity makes it accessible to anyone, yet the challenge keeps you coming back again and again.
A Timeless Classic, Reimagined
Memory Game Classic captures the charm of the original card-matching games you grew up with — now optimized for modern devices. The satisfying “aha!” moment of finding a matching pair never fades, and the more you play, the more you’ll feel your concentration improving.
Play to relax, play to train your brain, or play to enjoy a few peaceful minutes of focus.
It’s the kind of game that’s easy to love — and even easier to play again and again.
Download Now!
Join thousands of players worldwide who are enjoying this relaxing and rewarding card-matching experience.
Download Memory Game Classic now and start your brain-training adventure today!

bluejetty:00082789:ios.description:
The ADHD Test is an easy to use, self-reported questionnaire measuring the symptoms of “attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder” (ADHD) in adults. The quick ADHD screening test includes 6 questions which are found to be the most predictive of symptoms consistent with ADHD. This quiz is adapted from the 18-question symptom checklist developed in conjunction with the World Health Organization and researchers from New York University and Harvard Medical School leading the Workgroup on Adult ADHD. The test can be self-administered. 
With Adult ADHD Test, you can:
- self-screen to validate potential symptoms of Adult ADHD
- store your test results and monitor improvements over time
- read concise, informative articles to expand your knowledge on ADHD
- share the results with a medical professional

bluejetty:00170319:ios.name: WSOC-TV Channel 9 Weather App
bluejetty:00170319:ios.summary:
Chief Meteorologist John Ahrens and Severe Weather Center 9 meteorologists have made the most accurate local weather app, “The WSOC-TV Weather App,” even better. Charlotte’s most powerful weather app includes the following:
Summary of Feat
bluejetty:00170319:ios.description:
Chief Meteorologist John Ahrens and Severe Weather Center 9 meteorologists have made the most accurate local weather app, “The WSOC-TV Weather App,” even better. Charlotte’s most powerful weather app includes the following:
Summary of Features:
- There is a new radar in the weather app that matches the radar found on other digital platforms and also includes future radar to provide you with a likely path and outlook of storms. The radar has 250 meter resolution, the highest available.
- New tracks - We added earthquakes and storm tracks as layers in the radar. Now you can track the location and magnitude of earthquakes as well for storms the speed, direction and type. Tap the “storm symbols” icon in the radar to see the list.
- Locally crafted forecasts. Select a location inside the Charlote market to see a local forecast created by WSOC-TV’s local weather experts. The app tells you which member of Severe Weather Center 9 crafted the local forecast. National applications that come pre-loaded on your phone don’t have local experts focused solely on getting the local forecast right every day.
- Push alerts are FREE for more than 25 alert types including everything from tornado warnings to winter storm warnings and tropical storm alert types. 
- Now you can scroll through the home screen to access most of what you need or want on one tab. 
- Place a location pin precisely where you want it for a specific address or any position on a map. When saving a location you can name it exactly how you want it. 
- The app works with identical features on tablet and handset.
- Additional items added seasonally
The weather app also has these critical benefits and features:
- The radar zooms down to your neighborhood or zooms out to check radar anywhere in the country.
- The app provides Location-Based alerts. While many other apps offer alerts based on your county, This app supports a more precise type of alert issued for the most dangerous types of weather threats. More precision means you get alerts that matter to you, not false alarms.
- Current conditions, hourly and daily forecasts for any location you enter.
- High resolution satellite cloud imagery
- Ability to add and save locations
- A fully integrated GPS for current location awareness
- Additional items added seasonally
*Data and alerting available for the United States only.

bluejetty:00062800:ios.name: TVAirScreen
bluejetty:00062800:ios.summary:
Pass the remote, not the phone.
Stop crowding around one tiny screen. TVAirScreen puts your photos on your Apple TV in seconds, so the whole room can enjoy them together — big, bright and easy to browse with the Siri Remote.
NO SETUP. NO
bluejetty:00062800:ios.description:
Pass the remote, not the phone.
Stop crowding around one tiny screen. TVAirScreen puts your photos on your Apple TV in seconds, so the whole room can enjoy them together — big, bright and easy to browse with the Siri Remote.
NO SETUP. NO ACCOUNTS. NO APPLE ID.
Your iPhone and Apple TV connect directly. There's no AirPlay to configure, no Apple ID to share and nothing to sign up for. Guests can put their own photos on your TV without touching your settings.
A CODE FOR NEW PHONES
Your TV shows a 4-digit code. A new phone enters it once and is remembered from then on. Phones that already use your TV keep working.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• Send a whole album in one go — photos arrive in the order you picked them
• Press Play/Pause on the Siri Remote for an instant, looping slideshow
• Swipe left and right to browse on the big screen
• Share straight from Photos, Files or Safari with the TVAirScreen share button
• Send PDFs — every page becomes a slide. Perfect for sheet music, lessons and presentations
• Send videos too — they play full screen on the TV, and Play/Pause on the Siri Remote pauses them
• Pick from Photos or Files, or take a new photo with the camera
• Your iPhone stays awake while connected, so the show keeps going
• View photos and PDFs full screen on your iPhone, with pinch-to-zoom
MADE FOR MOMENTS LIKE
• Holiday photos with the grandparents on the couch
• Parties, weddings and reunions — every guest can add their shots
• Travel slideshows the evening you get home
• Classrooms, meetings and presentations
• Choir, band and church rehearsals with the music on the big screen
• Holiday rentals — let your guests share to the TV
FREE TO START. PRO IS YOURS FOREVER.
Send up to 5 photos at a time for free, with no account. Unlock Pro once — no subscription — for unlimited batches, PDFs and videos. Bought TVAirScreen before it became free? Pro is already yours.
GET STARTED
1. Install TVAirScreen on your Apple TV, or scan the QR code it shows.
2. Open TVAirScreen on your iPhone and tap “Connect to Apple TV”.
3. Enter the code from the TV the first time, choose your photos, and watch them appear.
Requires the TVAirScreen app on your Apple TV.

bluejetty:00086989:ios.description:
Tell us when your exam is and the grade you want. Synt builds the study plan up to that day.
Synt is your personal tutor. Upload your notes — text, photo or PDF — or paste your course syllabus, and Synt gives you back a plan of sessions spread out until exam day: summary, quiz, flashcards, a review of your own mistakes and a mock exam the day before. Every day you know what's due and how much is left.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Tell us the subject, the exam date and the grade you're aiming for.
2. Upload your notes. Only have the syllabus? Paste it or snap a photo — we turn it into study notes.
3. Do today's session. It checks itself off when you finish.
WHAT YOUR PLAN INCLUDES
• AI summaries of your own notes, at the length you choose.
• Quizzes with questions taken from your material, scored on your grading scale.
• Automatic flashcards for memorizing.
• A concept map to see how everything fits together.
• Mistake review: it asks you again ONLY what you got wrong, reworded.
• A mock exam the day before, covering your whole syllabus.
• Reminders only when you fall behind. If you're on track, we stay quiet.
WHO IT'S FOR
For anyone with a date circled on the calendar: finals, midterms, SAT and ACT prep, college exams or Friday's test. And if you just want to summarize a long text, Synt still does that in seconds.
Download Synt and walk into the exam knowing you revised what you needed to revise.
Privacy Policy: https://synt.app/privacy
Terms and Conditions: https://synt.app/terms

bluejetty:00091907:ios.name: NALCHBP Telehealth
bluejetty:00091907:ios.summary: Welcome to the NALCHBP Telehealth Urgent Care. This app allows you to have a face-to- face visit with a qualified medical professional 24/7 on your mobile device with no appointment or referral needed. All providers are licensed and board-c
bluejetty:00091907:ios.description:
Welcome to the NALCHBP Telehealth Urgent Care. This app allows you to have a face-to- face visit with a qualified medical professional 24/7 on your mobile device with no appointment or referral needed. All providers are licensed and board-certified doctors, including pediatricians, who can diagnose, recommend treatment, prescribe medically necessary medications and provide a sick slip for school or work. Some of the conditions treated include:
• Allergies
• Cold and flu symptoms
• Sinus congestion
• Fever
• Headaches
• Pinkeye
• Insect Bites
• Earaches
• Rashes
• Cuts and scrapes
• And much more!
HOW IT WORKS
Request a visit - Open the NALCHBP Telehealth app and create an account. Log in and choose an available doctor by reviewing their provider profile. This details their spoken languages, state licensure, board certifications, professional affiliations, clinical interests and education. You will be asked to provide medical history for the patient, indicate what pharmacy you use and pay your $10 copayment for the visit.
Talk to a doctor – Within minutes, the doctor you have chosen reviews your medical history and your virtual visit begins. The doctor will discuss the issue with you, answer your questions and recommend next steps. If a prescription is medically necessary, it will be submitted to a local pharmacy of your choice. The average visit length is 10 minutes.
After the visit – Clinical notes about the visit will be available on your account for sharing with your primary care provider or for your records. Any prescription or sick slip written may also be found there.
Your NALCHBP Telehealth account is also available online at www.nalchbptelehealth.org or by calling 888-541-7706.
Get the urgent care services your family needs, wherever you are, with the NALCHBP Telehealth app.
Your privacy is taken very seriously. An NALCHBP Telehealth visit is secure and HIPAA compliant. This site is intended for NALC Health Benefit Plan High Option members only. Services are separate from your PPO provider network. If you are not an NALCHBP member, you will be responsible for the full cost of any services you receive from our urgent care practice.
Please note that telehealth is not for emergencies. If you’re having a medical emergency, call 911.
If you are an Apple Health user you will have the option to share important health information with your provider during your video visit. Sharing Apple Health data is optional but allows the provider to see heart rate, weight, and other health information to help them make a more accurate diagnosis.

bluejetty:00122812:ios.description:
Take your work to the next level by using Gridwise, the #1 business app for gig, hourly, and freelance workers.
Driving for Uber, Lyft, Doordash, Walmart Spark or Instacart? Get the all-in-one app uniquely built for rideshare and delivery drivers to track mileage, boost earnings, and get control of your expenses across all rideshare and delivery apps. Plus users get automatic earnings download for Uber, Lyft, Wingz, Uber Eats, DoorDash, Caviar, Instacart, Cornershop, Grubhub, Gopuff, Amazon Flex, Alto, Walmart Spark Driver, Shipt, Roadie, Point Pickup, Curb, Waitr, Favor Delivery, and more.
Gridwise is built for more than gig driving. Hourly and freelance workers can use Gridwise to track earnings across jobs and find better-paying opportunities.
Come join the growing community of 1,000,000+ workers using Gridwise as their one-stop shop to earn and keep more. Get even more tips in our Facebook group or on Reddit today!
Why Gridwise?
Earn more
Get valuable insights to find where and when to work to maximize your hourly or per-mile rate. Organize all your earnings in one place so you can compare them to other drivers in your area, monitor which services are most profitable, and find opportunities to earn more efficiently.
Keep more
Looking to keep more money with the best, most accurate deductions on your taxes? Or keep more of your personal time by hitting your daily/weekly goals faster? Gridwise can help you with both! Automatically log all your rideshare and delivery activities so you can easily monitor all your expenses and mileage with an all-in-one view.
Plan better
Tap into local event schedules, airport insights or neighborhood hourly wage data so you can focus on the most profitable gigs during peak times and in the busiest places, or see what places/times you should avoid if you hate sitting in traffic!
View and benchmark your performance
Run your business like a pro by getting the data you need in easy to read and interpret graphs. Gridwise goes deep and is built by gig workers for gig workers to deliver unique insights, unlike other trackers on the market like MileIQ, Hurdlr, Everlance, Mystro, Rydar, Sherpashare, Solo, and Stride.
Wait less and stay in the know
On the airport run? Our “just in time” airport arrival and departure insights have flight updates, plane sizes, weather info and customizable alerts so you know when to show up to the airport to spend the least amount of time in a queue.
Simplify your tax prep
Consolidate your business driving mileage expenses to make for an easy tax deduction. And, our Plus members save 50% on Keeper tax preparation services!
Enjoy perks
Get exclusive benefits just for being a Gridwise user to help you both on and off the road — from insurance to healthcare and more. Plus users get even higher discounts and offers.
Unlock even more perks with Plus!
Get the most out of Gridwise with a Gridwise Plus subscription. Join Plus for just $14.99/month or $107.99/year (or just $9/mo.) for our annual subscription. Since Gridwise is a business expense it’s completely tax deductible. Your payment will be charged to your iTunes account at the time of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal at any time from your iTunes account settings. Please see our terms of service and privacy policy for more information.

support: support@gridwise.io

bluejetty:00121323:ios.name: Forty Thieves Solitaire Gold
bluejetty:00121323:ios.summary:
Play Forty Thieves Solitaire Gold for a real solitaire challenge! If you’re bored of easy solitaire games, take on this hard card game, test your skills and triumph in a themed world based on the Arabian Nights!
Every effort has been made
bluejetty:00121323:ios.description:
Play Forty Thieves Solitaire Gold for a real solitaire challenge! If you’re bored of easy solitaire games, take on this hard card game, test your skills and triumph in a themed world based on the Arabian Nights!
Every effort has been made to create a beautiful, sumptuous theme and a perfect user experience, complete with delightful sound effects. Forty Thieves Solitaire is a unique and rare game with similarities to the popular Freecell. Your goal is to move all the cards to the 8 foundation piles from Ace to King. It uses 2 decks so that the rules state that only one card may be moved at a time. In the play area cards can only be moved to empty columns or in descending order by suit. Naturally, the game has a well-made tutorial to teach you anything you might need to know.
40 THIEVES FEATURES:
* Simple rules, quick tutorial (which you won't even need if you like Freecell!)
* Multiple rounds and multiple ways to score with bonuses. 
* Classic theme inspired by the folk tale of Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves.
* Beautifully animated, accompanied by a tailor-made soundscape.
* Extensive tutorial and instructions.
* Two levels of difficulty, both of them require you to be patient!
If you find other games too easy, then you’ll love Forty Thieves Solitaire Gold!
