bluejetty:00141368:ios.description:
COZY Wallet is a secure, powerful Web3 wallet built for the next generation of crypto users.
Designed with both centralized and decentralized features, COZY Wallet provides over 50 million users with a seamless and feature-rich experience for managing digital assets, engaging with communities, and executing fast, secure crypto transactions — all in one place.
Why COZY Wallet?
 - Support for 1000+ tokens and 60+ chains: Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), TRON (TRX), Dogecoin (DOGE), SATS, Solana (SOL), Cardano (ADA), Stellar (XLM), XRP and more
 - Native Telegram integration with Wallet Bot & Wallet Mini App
 - All-in-one Web3 utility tools: Cozy Card (Virtual Card), Bulk Transfers, Mobile Airtime, Gift Cards, Tip Box
 - Built-in WalletConnect for seamless dApp interaction
 - Passkey login, 2FA, HSM-grade protection, and cold wallet architecture
 - Trusted by global Web3 communities since 2019
Core Features
Multi-Chain Crypto Wallet
Manage over 1000+ digital assets across 60+ public chains, including BTC, ETH, USDT, TRX, DOGE, ADA, XLM, and SOL. Monitor your portfolio with real-time updates and a customizable dashboard. Compatible with both standard and NFT assets.
Telegram Wallet & Community Tools
Experience crypto on Telegram with COZY Wallet's native bot and mini app — no wallet address needed.
Empower your community with:
 - Airdrop and giveaway automation
 - Loyalty reward mechanisms in chat
 - Role-based access with on-chain asset verification
 - Membership & whitelist management
Perfect for DAOs, NFT communities, and Web3 startups looking to scale efficiently.
Virtual Card & Crypto Utilities
Use the Cozy Card (Virtual Card) to spend crypto globally with platforms like Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal.
Send mobile recharges, distribute tips, and issue branded gift cards securely — right from your wallet.
Uncompromising Security
 - Passkey login & two-factor authentication
 - Cold wallet infrastructure for maximum safety
 - HSM-grade key encryption
 - Frequent third-party audits 
 - Privacy-by-design architecture with future zk-SNARK compatibility
Built for Everyone
Whether you're a beginner or a Web3 veteran, COZY Wallet simplifies crypto for individuals, creators, developers, and communities.
Join the Web3 Future
Get started with the most versatile Web3 wallet. Explore dApps via WalletConnect, manage crypto on Telegram, and experience next-gen wallet security — all in one place.

bluejetty:00161683:ios.description:
Build good habits and break bad ones — in less than a minute a day.
Way of Life is the simple, beautiful habit tracker trusted since 2010 and featured in The New York Times, Forbes, and The Guardian. Mark each day green or red, keep your chains going, and watch your progress over weeks, months, and years.
WHY IT WORKS
Changing habits is hard. Seeing them clearly makes it easier. A few taps a day, and patterns start to appear:
• Am I exercising as much as I think?
• Am I drinking less alcohol or soda?
• Am I getting enough sleep?
• Am I eating more fruits and vegetables?
• Am I cutting back on sugar?
Track anything that matters to you — good habits and bad.
FEATURES
• Chains: challenge yourself not to break a streak
• Charts: pie charts, bar graphs with trend lines, and frequency distribution
• Scoreboard: instant weekly and monthly feedback
• Notes: jot down what went well, or what didn't
• Reminders with flexible schedules and custom messages
• Tags to organize your habits
• Widgets, Siri, and Shortcuts
• URL schemes for working with other apps
• Themes: Dark, Light, Rose, Serenity, Retro C64, and more
• Color-blind mode
• Interactive walk-through to get you started
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Way of Life doesn't pry into, sell, or share your data. Lock the app with a passcode, Face ID, or Touch ID. Back up to your preferred cloud storage provider, and export your data anytime as CSV, Excel, or JSON.
SIMPLE PREMIUM
No maze of paywalls. Everything above is included. Premium simply unlocks unlimited habits.
AS SEEN IN
The New York Times, Forbes, The Guardian, Fast Company, Business Insider, Entrepreneur, Lifehacker, Marie Claire, and Healthline.
"The ultimate habit building app." — AppAdvice
Featured on the Tim Ferriss podcast with Kevin Rose.

bluejetty:00200113:ios.name: Hark Pro
bluejetty:00200113:ios.summary:
Hark Pro is an operating system for your life, built to think ahead, and help you with real, practical things.
By combining advanced memory and the ability to use a computer in the cloud, Hark understands the context of your life and can t
bluejetty:00200113:ios.description:
Hark Pro is an operating system for your life, built to think ahead, and help you with real, practical things.
By combining advanced memory and the ability to use a computer in the cloud, Hark understands the context of your life and can take care of things across the web. No agents or subscriptions required.
Hark can log in to OpenTable and make a reservation for you. But it’s also smart enough to reference your calendar for an open time, recall your favorite spots for openings, note your friend’s food allergies in the reservation, and even create a button to reserve an Uber to get there that night.
Use Hark to order groceries. Return products. Manage your schedule. Build mini apps. And track complicated projects, integrating Google Docs and Slack messages, mindlessly. 
Hark is a simple chat app with powerful capabilities - freeing your time to spend away from screens.
Proactive thinking
Hark looks ahead. Book a movie on Hark, and Hark won’t just buy the ticket and add it to your calendar. It’ll scope the parking situation ahead of time, and offer to reserve you a spot before they fill up. Hark thinks creatively to remove friction across your life.
Use the web with Handoff
Just type “deliver me pizza” to hand off the task to Hark. It will hunt for the best local pizzarias, go on their websites, read their menus, and order you one for delivery via DoorDash (with your consent and favorite toppings, of course). Hark securely manages your logins to hundreds of sites including Target, Amazon, and LinkedIn so it can handle tasks from start to finish.
Hark can also fill out web forms for you, writing multiple services to get quotes on a move or renovation. It can dig through webpages to find dentists who actually take your insurance - and email them for you to ask if it's unclear. It can plan your new wardrobe, then present it on a custom website built just for you.
Manage your personal and professional life
With Email and Slack integration, Hark can keep track of your most important messages, build your daily schedule, balance your calendar, and summarize dozens of discussions across your workplace into just the things that you need to know.
Follow long term tasks with Projects
Hark can manage your life in one, long-running chat. But sometimes you want to start with a blank slate. Projects are dedicated threads for longer term work. They focus a single topic, and related files, in one place that you can visit again and again over time. 
Build your own Panels
Never learn to code. Hark can generate tiny bits of software called Panels - ranging from exercise trackers to media players - that live right inside the Hark app. All you do is prompt. You can even ask your Panels questions to dig deeper into their data, unlocking even more from services you already use like Strava, Spotify, and Venmo. 
Solve it with a button press
Notifications give you work. Hark’s Action Buttons provide solutions. Hark’s one-line summaries highlight the most important things you need to do next. Just press a button to “pay” a bill, “RSVP” to an event, or “review” an insurance claim.
Do everything else you expect an assistant to do
Researching questions. Analyzing PDFs. Yes, even telling you the weather. Hark offers all of the same baseline services offered by other leading AI labs, too.
Security and privacy
Your data is your own. Hark will never sell your data or serve you ads. We also never see your most private information, like stored passwords or credit card numbers, which are always encrypted in storage and in transit. 
Hark does real work
• Order dinner and groceries
• Book cheap flights and hotels
• Spot subscriptions before they renew
• Schedule automatic tasks
• Build websites, spreadsheets, and slide decks

Hark can log in to OpenTable and make a reservation for you. But it’s also smart enough to reference your calendar for an open time, recall your favorite spots for openings, note your friend’s food allergies in the reservation, and even create a button to reserve an Uber to get there that night.

Use Hark to order groceries. Return products. Manage your schedule. Build mini apps. And track complicated projects, integrating Google Docs and Slack messages, mindlessly. 

Hark is a simple chat app with powerful capabilities - freeing your time to spend away from screens.

Proactive thinking

Hark looks ahead. Book a movie on Hark, and Hark won’t just buy the ticket and add it to your calendar. It’ll scope the parking situation ahead of time, and offer to reserve you a spot before they fill up. Hark thinks creatively to remove friction across your life.

Use the web with Handoff

Just type “deliver me pizza” to hand off the task to Hark. It will hunt for the best local pizzarias, go on their websites, read their menus, and order you one for delivery via DoorDash (with your consent and favorite toppings, of course). Hark securely manages your logins to hundreds of sites including Target, Amazon, and LinkedIn so it can handle tasks from start to finish.

Hark can also fill out web forms for you, writing multiple services to get quotes on a move or renovation. It can dig through webpages to find dentists who actually take your insurance - and email them for you to ask if it's unclear. It can plan your new wardrobe, then present it on a custom website built just for you.

Manage your personal and professional life

With Email and Slack integration, Hark can keep track of your most important messages, build your daily schedule, balance your calendar, and summarize dozens of discussions across your workplace into just the things that you need to know.

Follow long term tasks with Projects

Hark can manage your life in one, long-running chat. But sometimes you want to start with a blank slate. Projects are dedicated threads for longer term work. They focus a single topic, and related files, in one place that you can visit again and again over time. 

Build your own Panels

Never learn to code. Hark can generate tiny bits of software called Panels - ranging from exercise trackers to media players - that live right inside the Hark app. All you do is prompt. You can even ask your Panels questions to dig deeper into their data, unlocking even more from services you already use like Strava, Spotify, and Venmo. 

Solve it with a button press

Notifications give you work. Hark’s Action Buttons provide solutions. Hark’s one-line summaries highlight the most important things you need to do next. Just press a button to “pay” a bill, “RSVP” to an event, or “review” an insurance claim.

Do everything else you expect an assistant to do

Researching questions. Analyzing PDFs. Yes, even telling you the weather. Hark offers all of the same baseline services offered by other leading AI labs, too.

Security and privacy

Your data is your own. Hark will never sell your data or serve you ads. We also never see your most private information, like stored passwords or credit card numbers, which are always encrypted in storage and in transit. 

Hark does real work

• Book cheap flights and hotels
• Spot subscriptions before they renew
• Schedule automatic tasks
• Build websites, spreadsheets, and slide decks

*If purchased or renewed near the turn of the month, the period may differ by a few days depending on platform reflection timing.
To cancel, please do so at least three days (72 hours) before auto-renewal.
*Missing this deadline may cause reflection timing discrepancies, preventing cancellation at the intended time.
Even if you cancel partway through, benefits continue until the end of the validity period.
Ex.: Purchased Jan 1 at 1:00 JST and canceled Jan 2 → benefits continue until Feb 1 at 12:59 JST.

*Please note that deleting the app or game data (account) does not cancel the subscription. Be cautious.

bluejetty:00119920:ios.description:
GET 24/7 PARENTING SUPPORT THROUGHOUT YOUR PARENTING JOURNEY
Join 10 million+ parents who turn to BabySparks for expert parenting guidance.
BabySparks offers 3 invaluable services to parents: 
For parents of children ages 0-3, we offer a personalized daily activity program. Each parent-led activity comes with a video tutorial and targets a critical area of development, helping you create the meaningful interactions that drive optimal development. Our proprietary smart adaptive technology learns and adapts to each child’s specific needs. Along with your activities, you get a daily feed with stage-based tips, access to our library of hundreds of development and parenting articles, tools to track milestones, progress and growth, and real-time reports.
For parents of children of all ages, we offer hundreds of expert-led online classes, covering every area of parenting. With our premium subscription, you get unlimited access to all of our classes.
Also for parents of children of all ages, our AI powered parenting expert, Ava, is always online, ready to answer any question you have about parenting. Chat for free for a limited time, or get unlimited access to Ava with our premium subscription. 
Whether you’re the parent of a baby or toddler who wants to set your child up to thrive, or a parent of an older child looking for support on your parenting journey, BabySparks has your back!
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Download BabySparks at no cost to create a profile for your child and access sample activities, milestones, and development information. Subscribe to unlock our full collection of activities, milestones, articles, tracking tools and more. You can subscribe on a monthly or annual.
Your credit card will be charged for this subscription through your iTunes account once you confirm your purchase. Our monthly and annual subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled 24 hours before the end of the current period. The price of your subscription won't increase when renewed.
You can manage and turn off auto-renew for your subscriptions in your iTunes account settings. You can find additional information on how to cancel or manage your subscriptions here: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
For our privacy policy and terms of use, please go to:
https://babysparks.com/privacy
https://babysparks.com/terms

bluejetty:00096158:ios.description:
Experience the joy of diamond art painting in a whole new way! Make a fresh discovery in the world of coloring games—this isn't a paint-by-numbers game but rather a tactile puzzle where sorting gems reveals art. In Brilliant Sort, you'll sort sparkling diamonds by color, clear space on the shelf, and place each gem in the perfect spot. Fans of gem-sorting gameplay will adore watching dazzling pixel art images appear piece by piece as the clock ticks down.
A GROWING COLLECTION OF GEM ART
Discover hundreds of stunning pixel art pictures to complete in Brilliant Sort, from beautiful landscapes to cute characters. New artwork is added regularly to keep your diamond sorting journey fresh.
RELAXING YET CHALLENGING
Looking for a diamond art game that's both calming and engaging? Brilliant Sort is a relaxing brainteaser for those who enjoy peaceful yet captivating challenges. The early levels are easy to pick up, while later ones test your strategy and speed. It's rewarding without ever feeling stressful.
NEW WAYS TO PLAY
Themed Galleries: Tackle a curated group of levels tied together by one beautiful theme. Finish the gallery to earn a special reward!
Big Picture: Assemble one breathtaking diamond art picture made of tons of tiny segments. Each segment is its own level; complete them all to reveal the final image and claim your prize.
Event Locations: Explore limited-time event maps made of unique gem levels that require special event energy to play. Complete the whole location before the timer runs out to earn exclusive rewards.
Season Albums: Collect themed cards into seasonal albums by opening special packs from events, offers, and the event shop. Fill collections and complete the whole album to claim extra prizes.
FUN POWER-UPS TO HELP YOU WIN
Extra Shelf: Gain more space to plan your moves.
Time Freeze: Stop the clock to strategize without pressure.
Auto Sort: Instantly place diamonds in their correct spots.
PLAY ANYWHERE, ANYTIME
Enjoy diamond painting in Brilliant Sort anywhere—it's perfect for a quick break, a relaxing evening, or as you unwind before bed.
LOVED BY PLAYERS WORLDWIDE
"I truly love this game. It's beyond relaxing. A 10 out of 10 in my book—I highly recommend it!"
"I really enjoy this diamond game. Never played anything quite like it."
"I love this game so much. It's super easy but still takes some thought and is super fun."
Brilliant Sort: Puzzle Game isn't just about sorting gems; it's diamond painting brought to life, one move at a time. Whether you're a casual player or a puzzle pro, you'll find joy in every sparkling diamond you place.
Download now and start revealing dazzling art!
Terms of Service:
https://belka-games.com/terms-of-service/
Privacy policy:
https://belka-games.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00186736:ios.summary:
Welcome to the mixing master class that offers an unparalleled mobile DJ set-up as well as a massive variety of learning resources that will teach you how to mix like a pro!
DJ it! condenses a fully functioning DJ set-up into your mobile p
bluejetty:00186736:ios.description:
Welcome to the mixing master class that offers an unparalleled mobile DJ set-up as well as a massive variety of learning resources that will teach you how to mix like a pro!
DJ it! condenses a fully functioning DJ set-up into your mobile phone without sacrificing a single feature. Your fingertips will have access to all the tools the pros have at their decks except now they're on your mobile. Better still, DJ it! showcases precisely how to use these tools effectively as it offers a personalized educational experience to guide new DJs and veteran mixers alike!
Learn to mix. 
Having the perfect tools is one thing, but you need to know how to use them! Thankfully, DJ it! is all about doing just that. Whatever your ability level, DJ it! offers lessons that will help you master critical techniques that are essential for every DJ. 
Quiz
Start by taking a simple questionnaire to let DJ it! analyze your skill level! Study up and attempt more challenging quizzes to earn high scores and expand your knowledge.
Glossary 
Faders, Pitch Sliders, Filters, Channels, Turntables, Decks, Mixers... Don't panic! Our extensive glossary covers every piece of language that every Dj needs.
Dj Tips
Master looping, explore creating hot cues and learn the ins-and-outs of the mashup with quick tips tailored to a variety of skills levels and requirements.
Tutorials 
Here you can learn how to use every single aspect of DJ it! incredible turntable set up. Explore every feature of your mobile mixing desk and tap on whatever you need to learn more about. With tutorials, you'll be mixing like a pro in no time!
Practice makes perfect.
DJ it! also offers an unrivaled mobile mixing set up that makes creating fresh music just as easy as it is to get up and dance to it! However, that doesn’t mean it’s not for experts too! Aside from lessons, it offers a complete Djing package that any advanced Dj could use to scratch, mash, edit, loop and fade their way to the top, all from their pocket!
Your set-up includes: 
- Automatic BPM detection
- Tap to adjust BPM, merely tap the track to sync!
- All the PRO FX you need including Delay, Reverb, Flanger, Gate, High/Low-Pass, Phaser, Bit Crusher, Roll, Reverse.
- Loops: from 1/16 to 64
- Up to 4 Hot Cues per deck!
- Automated audio FX sync on the BPM.
- Three band EQ.
- HD recording with automatic saving and uploading to your library so you'll never lose a mix.
- Support for all major audio formats including MP3, AAC, WAV, AIFF
Welcome to DJ it! - your new one-stop shop for all your mixing needs. 
Study up because it’s time to learn how to mix your masterpiece!
The app contains the following subscription options:
- Weekly with a 3-day free trial at $7.90*.
- Annual at $39.99.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- The account is charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
- The cost of renewal is equal to the value that “Apple’s App Store Matrix” determines as the equivalent of the subscription price in $USD.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.
Privacy Policy: https://gismart.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://gismart.com/terms-of-service/

The world's original winter-themed mobile game! Over 400M players!
The blizzard has reset the world, and now, a new story awaits your touch!
As a rising survivor, gather your crew and team up with the free SSR hero Molly.
Together, you'll set out on a joyful adventure, spark the fire of hope, and rebuild a cozy home on the frozen frontier!
[Game Features]
◆Rebuild & Restore: Easy Progress
Warmth begins with a single spark. Fire up the furnace to melt the snow and reclaim the land! Manage your people and resources to build a bustling, welcoming town!
◆Idle & Earn: Constant Rewards
Send your heroes out with one tap, then come back to a pile of resources ready for your next big upgrade, all stress-free.
◆Tap & Play: Instant Fun
Go ice fishing for rare catches or uncover hidden treasures beneath the snow. Perfect for quick, fun sessions anytime!
◆Plan & Pair: Heroic Combos
All heroes share the same level, so you can upgrade and swap without the grind. Mix and match their skills for ultimate combos!
◆Unite & Triumph: Shared Success
Join an alliance to heal faster, grow stronger, and explore further. Together, we share the chill and the cheer!
Ready to thrive in the frost? Download Whiteout Survival now — a perfect survival experience blending teamwork, idle fun, and smart strategy!

bluejetty:00122356:ios.description:
The most amazing dice game you can ever play!
Join the only free-to-play multiplayer Yatzy community, that takes Yazty game seriously. Whether you call it yahtzee, yacht, yatzee, yachty, there is only one ultimate version of the dice game - Yatzy Ultimate!
Play alone or against opponents from around the world in a real PvP multiplayer experience. No double rolls, no pay-to-win, no fancy graphics, just a pure form of yatzy being played in our community. Choose from one of the 3 rulesets to play by: Yatzy, Maxi Yatzy and American Yatzy.
Yatzy Ultimate is one of the most popular and fun Yatzy board games that is free to play. We completely reinvented the Yatzy concept based on player inputs and made it more exciting by adding new and unique game features.
Start the journey as a Newbie on Noob Alley, and advance to higher levels using your skills and a little luck. Play Online and Challenge games and soon you’ll become the Ultimate Yatzy Champion.
Build your own buddy list by adding your friends and family, or meet new friends from all over the world. You can challenge your buddies from your buddy list and always have someone to play with.
▪ FEATURES ▪
▪ Multiplayer - play against the best opponents from around the world
▪ Level Up - ranks which will provide you constant challenge playing with more experienced players
▪ Buddies - invite your buddies and play with them
▪ Solo Challenge - don’t feel experienced enough, try the challenge mode and play against yourself for both coins and experience.
▪ Global Leaderboards - beat high scores and climb straight to the top
▪ Chat - Chat with your Buddies
▪ Archive - History of all your games
▪ Bonus - Progressive daily bonus, First Win of the Day, First Loss of the day
▪ HIGHLIGHTS ▪
▪ Play for FREE
▪ Play on any device
▪ 3 Game Modes: Yatzy (Scandinavian), Maxi Yatzy and American Yatzy
▪ Suitable for all ages — play with all your friends and family!
▪ Play'n'wait - if you want to challenge yourself to a classical game with some experienced opponents.
▪ Available in 8 languages: English, French, German, Danish, Swedish, Spanish, Russian and Turkish
Let us know your suggestions and improvements or issues/bugs you have: support@snowballgames.io.
Let's roll!

“Since we started using Theo in our bedtime routine, our evenings have completely changed. My kids look forward to the daily affirmations—they learn about the power of prayer and pick up something new every night. They now sleep better than ever!”
— Emily, mom of Jack.
**BRING YOUR FAMILY CLOSER TO GOD**
Theo is a Prayer & Meditation app designed to help parents and children deepen their faith, connect with God, and experience the peace and love Jesus teaches us. With Theo, even the busiest parents can create a meaningful devotional routine in just 9 minutes a day.
OUR METHOD:
 1. Connect with God through daily prayers, religious reflections, and audio meditations.
 2. Reaffirm your identity in God with daily affirmations.
 3. Do it together—parent and child.
“We were drowning in worry—this app brought us peace we didn’t know existed.”
– Olivia, Mother of Noah
WHY THEO?
In today’s world, families need a sanctuary of faith. Theo offers a safe space to explore spirituality, deepen faith, and foster love and peace. 
Developed by the creators of the award-winning Storybook App, Theo provides over 100 devotional prayers, meditations, and Bible stories tailored to the spiritual growth of children.
Theo’s content is rooted in the holy Tradition of Catholic and Christian faith, while also offering the option to filter for general non-denominational Christian content. 
Whether you’re just beginning your faith journey or have been walking with God for years, Theo helps your family cultivate meaningful habits of prayer and reflection that last a lifetime.
FEATURES DESIGNED FOR FAMILIES: 
• Guided Prayers: Teach your child how to talk to God with heartfelt prayers, including novenas, the Rosary for kids, and more.
• Bible Stories: Spark your child’s imagination with inspiring stories from Creation to the life of Jesus.
• Positive Affirmations: Encourage confidence and self-worth with verses that remind children of their value as God’s beloved.
• Meditations Inspired by Scripture: Unique, immersive audio meditations that help children reflect on biblical teachings and calm their minds.
• Bedtime Routine Support: Transform bedtime into a peaceful, faith-filled moment that promotes restful sleep.
• Faithful and Safe Content: Curated by theologians and free of modern ideologies to ensure it aligns with traditional Christian values.
HOW DOES THEO HELP YOUR FAMILY?
• Deepen Your Faith Together: Create meaningful family traditions rooted in prayer.
• Reduce Stress and Anxiety: Help your child find calm and reassurance with soothing meditations.
• Strengthen Bonds: Spend quality time together with engaging stories and prayers.
SUBSCRIPTION OPTIONS
Theo is free to download and offers limited free content. Unlock the full experience with our premium subscription:
• $59.99/year for unlimited access to meditations, prayers, and Bible stories.
• 7-day free trial included.
Prices may vary by region. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled 24 hours before the end of the billing period.
JOIN FAMILIES AROUND THE WORLD
Theo is created by the team behind Storybook, the #1 parenting app trusted by over 4 million families globally.
Download Theo today and transform your family’s faith journey—one prayer at a time.

bluejetty:00153232:ios.description:
Remote for Hisense TV puts the whole remote on your iPhone, whichever smart system your Hisense happens to run. VIDAA, Android TV, Google TV, Roku TV or Fire TV — the app works out which one it is talking to and connects the right way, so you never have to know.
Remote slipped between the cushions? Batteries gave up just as the film started? Open the app and power, volume, channels, the arrow pad and OK are right under your thumb. If you'd rather glide than tap, flip to the touchpad and swipe through the menus. One tap on the search key takes the TV straight to its search screen, and on Android TV models your favourite services open from the iPhone as well.
More than one Hisense in the house? Add each of them once — living room, bedroom, kitchen — and hop from one to another in a second.
Getting started takes about a minute. Keep the iPhone and the television on one home Wi-Fi, tap Add TV and choose your set from the list. Some TVs show a short code the first time; type it in and that's it. If your TV stays hidden, the help pages inside the app explain the usual reasons, from a separate guest Wi-Fi to a VPN left on.
Full access comes with a subscription: $4.99 a week after a 3-day free trial, or $19.99 a year.
Payment is taken from the Apple ID account as soon as the purchase is confirmed. The plan carries on automatically: to end it, cancel automatic renewal 24 hours or more ahead of the next billing date, because the charge for a new period is made within the final 24 hours of the current one. Plans are changed or cancelled under Subscriptions in the Apple ID settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://docs.google.com/document/d/19UU9A_3RwRK69o4OXCAherZPkQrd3YJSETZMk83GxeA/edit?usp=sharing

bluejetty:00145248:ios.description:

This daily diary is not just about writing down mundane events; it's about engaging in a rewarding self-care routine through thoughtful writing prompts that inspire self-discovery.
Our daily journal and diary app offers 190+ journal prompts to kick-start your writing and reflection journey. With daily reminders to ensure you stay on track, maintaining a consistent journaling habit has never been easier. This daily diary app is all about helping you develop a strong self-care practice through the power of writing.
The key features of our daily journal and diary app include:
* A comprehensive library of journal prompts, ensuring diverse and thought-provoking topics for daily reflection
* "Dive Deeper" questions accompanying each prompt, allowing you to explore your thoughts more thoroughly
* Daily reminders to help you establish a consistent journaling habit
* PDF export functionality, enabling you to print, email, or save your diary entries for future reference
* A customizable experience, with the ability to create your own unique journal prompts
* A focus on privacy: entries are stored on your device, and no account is required
Transform your daily journaling and diary experience with Prompted Journal and make self-care a priority. By dedicating just five minutes a day to journaling, you can reap the benefits of a deeply enriching self-care routine that fosters personal growth and well-being. Our daily journal and diary app is designed to make journaling easy and enjoyable, so you can focus on what truly matters: nurturing your inner self.
At Prompted Journal, we're committed to creating writing apps that promote self-care and wellness. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. Your privacy is our top priority, and we've built this daily diary journal with that in mind.
Get ready to embark on a journey of self-discovery and growth with the Prompted Journal daily journal and diary app – your everyday self-care companion.

Compete with the WORLD in RealTime!! 
Overcome your heartbeat and the vibrations of wind while taking aim. 
And feel the pleasure when winning the largest points.

it's so simple and it helps to improve your concentration

1. Pull the bow on the screen. 
2. take aim moving to left or right.

1. we provide 10 arrows at first. 
2. If you shoot 10 score, you can get 2 more arrows. 9 score-1.5arrows , 8 score-1 arrow 
3. you can get 5 arrows at the most if you shoot 10 score in a row. 
4. But, we confiscate one arrow from you if you shoot under 5 scores. 
5. it will be easy if you wait for moment that you can't hear the sound of a heartbeat. 
(about 5 seconds)

bluejetty:00071033:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00071033:ios.description:
Build better habits. Build a better life.
Since 2016, Habitify has helped 3M+ people form over 20M habits — and earned repeat features from Apple, including App of the Day. We believe everyone deserves a better life: more good habits, fewer bad ones. Building habits is hard. Habitify makes it easier.
# Why Habitify
Habitify is built for one thing: your habit-forming success. That's our north star. Every feature exists to get you started, keep you going, and help you win.
# STAY MOTIVATED, EVERY DAY
Motivation gets you started — and keeps you going. Habitify keeps you fueled with:
- Personalized notifications that adapt to your journey
- Beautiful charts, streaks, and progress views that celebrate how far you've come
- Milestones that turn small wins into lasting momentum
# TRACKING THAT HAPPENS AUTOMATICALLY
Building habits shouldn't create a new habit of opening a habit tracker. With your consent, Habitify logs progress automatically by connecting to the apps you already use:
- Apple Health & Google Health/Fit
- Fitbit & Strava
- Screen Time & RescueTime
Walk, run, sleep, meditate, read, or cut screen time — and watch it log itself.
# BUILT FOR THE AI ERA
Habitify works the way you work now. With API, MCP, App Intents, and Siri support, you can:
- Log habits by chatting with your favorite AI assistant
- Ask for your progress and stats in plain language
- Trigger updates hands-free with Siri
Your habits, wherever your conversations happen.
# INVISIBLE BY DESIGN
The best habit tracker is one you barely notice. Habitify stays out of the way — quietly tracking, gently motivating — so your energy goes to living your habits, not logging them.
# EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO SUCCEED
- Create habits in seconds with daily, weekly, or custom schedules
- Smart reminders for morning, noon, or night
- Streaks, completion history, and a clean progress calendar
- Notes, mood tracking, and a built-in timer
- Mark habits done, skipped, or missed — pause anytime life changes
- Friendly challenges.
- Sync across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch
# JOIN 3 MILLION+ PEOPLE
Whether you want to be more productive, get fit, sleep better, or simply feel more in control, Habitify gives you everything you need to make it happen.
Download Habitify and start building a better life today.
---
Habitify is available for free on all platforms. When you are ready to grow, unlock Habitify Plus to enjoy unlimited habits, smart reminders, and custom group areas to organize your routines. For the ultimate productivity and wellness experience, try Habitify Pro with a 7-day free trial. It includes all the features of Plus, alongside premium upgrades such as automated integrations with Apple Health and top apps, and advanced timers (pomodoro, stopwatch).
---
Contact & Support

• Email: contact@habitify.me
• Privacy Policy: https://habitify.me/privacy-policy
• Terms of Use: https://habitify.me/terms-of-use
• Feedback Forum: https://feedback.habitify.me

bluejetty:00136895:ios.description:

bluejetty:00164222:ios.summary:
Battery Life shows the battery level of your iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, AirPods and other connected devices in one place – in the app, in widgets and on your watch face. Downloaded by millions of users since 2014.
► BATTERY
• Battery charg
bluejetty:00164222:ios.description:
Battery Life shows the battery level of your iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, AirPods and other connected devices in one place – in the app, in widgets and on your watch face. Downloaded by millions of users since 2014.
► BATTERY
• Battery charge in percent, charging state, thermal state and Low Power Mode
• Runtimes: how long the remaining charge lasts for video, video streaming, audio, web browsing and more, based on the figures Apple publishes for your model
• A step-by-step guide to the battery health and maximum capacity that iOS measures
► CONNECTED DEVICES
• AirPods and their charging case, Beats, keyboards, trackpads, game controllers, hearing aids and other accessories that report their battery over Bluetooth or cable
• The last reading stays visible after a device disconnects
• Give devices your own names and hide the ones you do not need
► WIDGETS (iOS 17 or later)
• Three widgets in different sizes for your Home Screen: Battery, Runtimes and Devices
• Lock Screen widgets for a glance without unlocking
• Pick the device to show, your favorite accessories and the sort order
► NOTIFICATIONS
• Get notified when your iPhone, iPad or Apple Watch has charged to the level you choose
• Get notified when a battery falls below the level you choose
► APPLE WATCH (watchOS 10 or later)
• The Watch app shows the battery level of your Apple Watch, your iPhone and your connected devices
• Complications for any watch face: Watch battery, iPhone battery or both
► BATTERY LIFE PRO (one-time In-App Purchase)
• No advertisements
• All notifications, including low battery and Apple Watch
• The larger Runtimes and Devices widgets
• Connected devices and raw data in the Watch app, plus the iPhone and combined complications
► PRIVACY
Your battery readings and your list of devices stay on your device. There are no accounts and no cloud.
► PLEASE NOTE
iOS and watchOS decide how often an app may run in the background. Notifications, widgets and complications therefore update on a schedule set by the system, usually every 5 to 60 minutes, and cannot show real-time values. Notifications need Background App Refresh, and they stop when the app is closed in the App Switcher.
► SUPPORT
Questions or feedback? Open Help (FAQ) or Send Feedback in the More tab.

bluejetty:00061007:ios.summary: Citrix Workspace app lets you access your SaaS, web apps, mobile, virtual apps, files, and desktops to help you be as productive on the go as you are in the office. If your company uses Citrix, you have the freedom to work on your favourite
bluejetty:00061007:ios.description:
Citrix Workspace app lets you access your SaaS, web apps, mobile, virtual apps, files, and desktops to help you be as productive on the go as you are in the office. If your company uses Citrix, you have the freedom to work on your favourite device from wherever you are. Just ask your IT department how to get started.
HOW TO USE CITRIX Workspace app
1. Open Citrix Workspace app and tap on Get Started.
2. Enter the Server or email address as instructed by Your IT Help Desk or system administrator.
3. Enter your User Name and Password.
4. Select the applications you want to use.
5. For adding multiple accounts, navigate to Settings and tap on Manage Accounts.
6. For Deleting/Editing Account already added navigate to Settings and tap on the Store.
HOW TO REPORT AN ISSUE TO CITRIX - Please contact your company's IT support team before following these steps:
Option 1
1. Open Citrix Workspace app and tap 'Settings' and then 'Report Issue'.
2. Click on Advanced, choose Location as File & Console, Log Level as Verbose, click on the back arrow.
3. Type in a description of the issue and click Share. Choose your Email app. This will generate a log file attached to the draft email.
4. Send the email to your company's IT support team.
Option 2
1. In the App Store, go to Citrix Workspace
2. Tap 'Reviews' and then tap 'App Support' found at the bottom right of the screen.
3. This launches the Citrix support forum where you can review reported issues OR
4. To report issues, tap the menu icon and create an account first.

bluejetty:00023842:ios.name: ToneStack PRO Guitar Amps & FX
bluejetty:00023842:ios.summary: The long awaited amps & effects powerhouse is finally here: meet the all-new ToneStack PRO! Featuring next generation DSP, a load of all-new amps & effects, and seamless AUv3 implementation, the latest of the ToneStacks is the go-to audio p
bluejetty:00023842:ios.description:
The long awaited amps & effects powerhouse is finally here: meet the all-new ToneStack PRO! Featuring next generation DSP, a load of all-new amps & effects, and seamless AUv3 implementation, the latest of the ToneStacks is the go-to audio processing solution for both guitarists and producers.
ToneStack PRO is faster, more efficient, and more powerful than ever. New digital modeling algorithms make every amp and effect sound bigger and richer than before. Advanced optimization enables stereo processing across the board — even for amps and cabs! Everything is brand new and envisioned to maximize your workflow, whether you use ToneStack PRO by itself, in a DAW, in your bedroom, or in the studio.
With an ability to expand to 80 amps and over 170 effects, ToneStack’s offerings are as vast as they are varied. If you’re after vintage amp tones oozing of warmth, a room-filling overdrive, or the sparkliest of cleans — ToneStack PRO has the amp for you. If your goal is to craft your own unique tones, then ToneStack PRO offers a virtually bottomless well of distortions, overdrives, modulation effects, pitch shifters, filters, wahs, delays, reverbs to draw from — and much more.
This huge collection also works as an AUv3 plugin inside AU host apps like GarageBand, Cubasis 3, AUM, and many more! Just fire up your favorite DAW and now you can run many instances of ToneStack PRO simultaneously. Record a track just once and experiment with amps, effects, and settings to find the perfect tone. Use ToneStack PRO to sweeten synths, drums, or vocals. Use its studio quality dynamics processors, filters and EQs to mix and master your project.
ToneStack PRO comes with a fresh batch of 10 amps, 10 cabs, and 30 effects. The expansion packs let you unlock the whole collection of over 330 pieces of gear, including countless iconic amps, boutique offerings, high quality studio FX, rarities, and many more goodies that help showcase ToneStack PRO’s next generation audio technology.
With ToneStack PRO, you also gain access to one of the platform’s top MIDI and preset management systems, with super-easy MIDI learn and the ability to easily save, organize, and share presets. The standalone app also comes with a built-in “tapedeck” and an optional 8-track recorder (first two tracks included for free) to help quickly sketch out your ideas. With its cutting-edge features, big tones, intuitive workflow, and huge variety of amps and effects, ToneStack PRO will easily become the centerpiece of your practice space as well as your recording exploits.
Selected Features Include,
• Starting with ToneStack Pro v2, Gen3 Virtual-Circuit DSP technology that models real-world circuits
• Includes starter pack with 10 amps, 10 cabs & 30 FX
• Expandable to 80 amps & cabs, and over 170 effects
• Amps cover iconic vintage gear to modern distortion powerhouses
• FX include distortions, overdrives, mods, pitch shifters, filters, wahs, delays, reverbs, rack processors & more
• Usable as AUv3 FX insert - run multiple instances in AUv3 host
• AUv3 MIDI-enabled and regular FX plugins are both included
• Mix-and-match amps and cabs
• Stereo processing, including for amps and cabs
• Amps, cabs can toggle between mono and stereo for realism
• Place up to 64 units in the effects chain
• Each cab provides dual direct mics and stereo room mics. Each direct microphone is adjustable for distance, offset, panning, mute/solo, and gain. Room mics provide adjustable room size, gain, as well as stereo spread.
• Signal splitting& blending via the ABY unit — great for multi-amp setups
• MIDI Learn
• MIDI Program Changes
• Tuner with always-on and fullscreen modes
• Drag-and-drop signal flow management
• Flexible UI design
• Powerful YPAT preset management system
• Over 350 factory presets
Standalone App Also Includes,
• Tapedeck with punch looping, pitch/time manipulation, FX send for re-amping
• Optional 8-track recorder with track inserts and dual sends
• Metronome, tap bpm, time signature

Осваивай иностранные языки самостоятельно
— Используй встроенный словарь. Учи слова через карточки и другие тренажеры.
— Смотри видеопрактики и слушай аудиокниги для улучшения понимания языка на слух.
— Прокачай разговорный язык с тренажером ситуаций.
— Занимайся в удобном темпе и регулярно отслеживай свой прогресс.
Улучши разговорный язык со Skyeng Talks
Skyeng Talks — 15-минутные онлайн-занятия с носителями языка из разных стран. Улучши свой разговорный французский, корейский, португальский, турецкий, испанский, итальянский, китайский, японский, немецкий, английский или греческий язык с помощью коротких сессий.
Начни обучение с преподавателем
— На первом занятии преподаватель определит твой уровень и предложит персональный план обучения с учётом целей и интересов.
— Доступны индивидуальные и групповые занятия. Начни изучение языка в любом удобном формате.
— Общайся с преподавателем в чате, задавай вопросы и получай консультации.
— Удобное расписание: назначай, переноси или отменяй онлайн-уроки.
— Выполняй домашние задания прямо в приложении.
Изучай языки в любом возрасте
Skyeng предлагает программы для детей и взрослых с разным уровнем подготовки. Начинающие смогут освоить базовую лексику и грамматику, а продолжающие — улучшить разговорные навыки, произношение и понимание живой речи.
Используй мультиаккаунт для всей семьи
Мультиаккаунт позволит контролировать баланс уроков и оплату в одном кабинете.
Отслеживай прогресс
Приложение показывает прогресс изучения слов, тем и других материалов. Регулярные отчеты о достижениях и посещаемости помогут оценить результаты и понять, сколько осталось до учебной цели.
Учить иностранные языки несложно, а вместе с Skyeng — еще проще!

bluejetty:00186393:ios.description:
Welcome to My Town Home – a fun dollhouse game for kids! Visit a big house where girls and boys can create their own family life stories and enjoy in fun role-play games all day!
Explore all 6 rooms in this Dream House and play fun family games the way you like! My Town Home Family Dollhouse game offers great animations and many characters to play with!
MY TOWN HOME GAME – EXPLORE A BIG PLAYHOUSE AND HAVE FUN
Parents, do you remember growing up, playing family games with your dolls in their tiny dollhouses? It is so fun when you can create your own stories about those dolls’ life and role play as a mom, dad, or as any other character!
My Town Family game for girls and boys is available NOW! Your little ones can play with virtual doll all day in this family dollhouse games and create their own game rules! Let them make their game rules and enjoy having fun in this dollhouse like you did when you were a kid!
MY TOWN HAS FUN FAMILY GAMES FOR KIDS 
Let’s explore My Town Home! Check all rooms, visit a kitchen and prepare your favorite meal! Or what about taking a shower in the bathroom after you had a lot of fun in the garden? Enjoy in the living room with mom, dad, and friends! Fun is everywhere!
Brush your teeth, play with toys in your room or go outside and swing or slide in the playground! This is an amazing dollhouse where kids can play some fun doll games as much as they like! All My Town games foster kids' creativity and imagination!
MY TOWN HOME FEATURES:
- 6 rooms in this Home Dollhouse to explore: Living room, kitchen, garden, and more
- Meet My Towny Home family: mom, a dad & 6 kids, friends, pets
- Create your own role-play stories
- 100+ Items available to move around
- Play dress up games for kids and customize characters your way
- My Town FREE game for all kids
- Enjoy My Town Home game and create your own doll story!
MY TOWN FAMILY HOME GAME FOR GIRLS AND BOYS
My Town Home Family game for girls and boys is made for kids to be creative and to use their imagination without game rules! Meet fun family characters (mom, dad, kids) and create your own game! Manage house life and create unique family life stories in your new home!
MY TOWN – START NEW ADVENTURE
Unique adventures await you in MY TOWN HOME dollhouse game for kids. Kids can choose different characters while playing family games - play as a mom, dad, or a child, it’s up to them to choose a favorite character. Enjoy the family game adventures all day long! My Town Home Family Dollhouse game fosters kids creativity allowing them to play fun family games the way they like!
FUN DOLL HOUSE GAMES
You can easily interact with the environment as you can move items and characters seamlessly between them. Playing My Town Home Doll House Game, kids can create their own virtual family life stories and set their game rules! Start an adventure and choose a different character to make your game story. It’s up to you how the game will go - enjoy family game adventures all day long!
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
For kids 4-12. My Town Family games are safe to play even when parents are not at home
ABOUT MY TOWN GAMES STUDIO
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse games that promote creativity and open-ended play for all kids in the world. My Town games introduce experiences for hours of imaginative play.

Photo Editor:
‒ Use unique photo filters to set the mood and captivate.
‒ Adjust brightness, clarity, contrast, saturation, HSL, curves, hue, and grain.
‒ Auto-focus, blur backgrounds, and sharpen photo subjects.
‒ Crop images into any shape and experiment with perspectives.

bluejetty:00015212:ios.summary:
This is an educational game that allows you to learn the u.s.a map as if you play a jigsaw puzzle produced by Digital Gene.
This game is designed to be simple yet fun to play. Not only people who like the map, but also who are not good at
bluejetty:00015212:ios.description:
This is an educational game that allows you to learn the u.s.a map as if you play a jigsaw puzzle produced by Digital Gene.
This game is designed to be simple yet fun to play. Not only people who like the map, but also who are not good at geography can enjoy playing it.
The app is best suited for people who want to learn the United States of America map or students who want to get ready for the exams. Or why don't you try this game to stay sharp during your spare time?
You can improve your knowledge as you play the game aiming for the best time or compete against players from all over the world.
You can also collect picture panels when you satisfy certain conditions. So do your best to get all of them.
There are various modes available, including a [training] mode with the state names and boundaries, a [basic] mode testing only state names, and an [expert] mode without hints.
When you're stuck on finding the location of a state, use the [Assist] function. It will help you to navigate the correct location without hassling yourself.
However you will be added a 30 seconds penalty when you use the [assist] function. If you want to achieve a higher ranking, it'd better not to use this function.

bluejetty:00097299:ios.description:
App Kainágua – Seu Treino, Sua Academia, Sempre com Você
O App Kainágua foi criado para ajudar você a aproveitar ao máximo os serviços da sua academia, seja treinando indoor ou outdoor. Seja qual for seu objetivo – manter a forma, melhorar o desempenho esportivo ou aprimorar sua saúde – o app oferece um plano de treinamento personalizado desenvolvido pela nossa equipe para guiar você nessa jornada.
Desafios que Motivam - Torne seus treinos ainda mais envolventes com desafios personalizados. Supere seus próprios limites, compita com a Comunidade, acompanhe seu progresso no ranking e conquiste Badges ao atingir suas metas.
Sua Academia na Palma da Mão Descubra e participe de programas, aulas e desafios exclusivos da sua academia. Use o App Kainágua para reservar aulas coletivas com facilidade e agendar atendimentos com nossa equipe. Para ajudar na sua rotina, você receberá lembretes inteligentes para não perder nenhum compromisso.
Monitore Seu Progresso em Tempo Real Acompanhe sua evolução conectando seu monitor de frequência cardíaca, Apple Health ou dispositivos como Garmin, Suunto, Polar, Withings, Swimtag, Strava, Runkeeper, MyFitnessPal, MapMyFitness e FitBit.
Alcance Seu Melhor Desempenho Seus resultados são registrados no Wellness Passport, com destaque para os MOVEs – unidade que mede seu nível de atividade de forma objetiva. Defina e atinja sua meta diária de MOVEs e acompanhe sua evolução com o MOVERGY, que analisa sua tendência de atividade ao longo de 2 semanas.
Com o App Kainágua, seu treino é mais eficiente, sua rotina mais organizada e sua performance sempre em evolução.

bluejetty:00177246:ios.name: Teleprompter: Sufler
bluejetty:00177246:ios.summary: Sufler is your ultimate teleprompter tool, designed to meet the diverse needs of content creators, business professionals, educators, and public speakers. Whether you're filming high-quality videos, delivering polished speeches, or creating
bluejetty:00177246:ios.description:
Sufler is your ultimate teleprompter tool, designed to meet the diverse needs of content creators, business professionals, educators, and public speakers. Whether you're filming high-quality videos, delivering polished speeches, or creating engaging social media content, Sufler has you covered.
Unparalleled Customization
Tailor every aspect of your teleprompting experience to suit your unique requirements. With Sufler, you can:
• Adjust scrolling speed to match your speaking rhythm.
• Modify fonts, text sizes, and offsets for optimal readability.
• Customize the appearance to fit your style or branding.
• Configure camera and microphone settings directly within the app.
• Add delays to time your script perfectly.
• Instantly preview changes in real-time as you tweak your setup.
Three Versatile Modes for Every Scenario
Studio Mode:
Perfect for professional setups. In this mode, Sufler displays smooth, autoscrolling text that you can easily read from your device. It pairs seamlessly with high-quality camera equipment, making it ideal for studio recordings or live presentations.
Camera Mode
A favorite among content creators and entrepreneurs. This mode combines autoscrolling text with camera recording, allowing you to film yourself while staying on script. It’s perfect for creating quick, polished videos for your business, social media, or personal brand.
Picture-in-Picture (PiP) Mode
Ideal for multitasking! PiP Mode lets you overlay Sufler's teleprompter on top of other apps. Want to use TikTok’s advanced camera with face-enhancing machine learning models? No problem—Sufler allows you to record videos on TikTok or other apps while seamlessly reading your script.
Powerful Additional Features
Remote Control Support
Control the teleprompter from a distance using Bluetooth devices such as keyboards, gamepads, or even your smartwatch. Perfect for hands-free operation during solo shoots or when working in large spaces.
Display Mirroring
Project your teleprompter onto larger external screens for better visibility or for use in professional studio environments. This feature enhances collaboration and ensures everyone stays on the same page.

bluejetty:00092633:ios.description:
Zeno is the simple app for people who want to train, eat and move well — without drowning in research, apps and $100 subscriptions.
Plan and log your workouts. Track your calories and macros. Build a daily stretching habit. All in one app. Free forever plan.
WHAT YOU GET
STRENGTH TRAINING
Custom workout programs, built around you.
- Tell Zeno your equipment, schedule, goals and even your injuries. It builds the plan.
- Know exactly what to lift — every set, every rep.
- Weights go up automatically as you get stronger. Progressive overload, handled.
- Log every set, rep and workout. Watch the numbers climb.
- Learn proper form with 3D demonstrations you can rotate and zoom.
CALORIE TRACKING
Track your calories and macros without the obsession.
- Search foods or scan a barcode.
- See your calories, protein, carbs and fat at a glance.
- Built to support your training, not take over your life.
FLEXIBILITY
Loosen up and move better.
- Follow guided stretching routines.
- Target the areas that need it.
- A few minutes a day is enough.
WHY ZENO
Every level, from your first session on. Most apps assume you already know what you're doing. Zeno meets you where you are — beginner to advanced.
Nothing to decide. Open the app. It tells you what to do today.
One app, not five. Training, nutrition and mobility in one place.
Free forever plan. No ads. No credit card. Premium is there if you want more, never a trap.
Most workout apps cost over $100 a year. Zeno has a free forever plan.
This app won't change your life. You will.
Start today.
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Is Zeno really free?
Yes. The free forever plan gives you real, usable training, tracking and flexibility — no credit card, no trial countdown. Upgrade only if you want more.
Do I need any experience?
No. Choose beginner, intermediate or advanced. Zeno meets you where you are and progresses as you improve.
Is this just a habit tracker?
It's more than a tracker. Zeno builds your plan, tells you what to do, and adjusts as you go — from your first session to your hundredth.

bluejetty:00014819:ios.summary: Whether you’re at work and need to stay connected, or you’re at home and need to access benefits or payroll information, some things can’t afford to wait until you get back to your work computer. With the redesigned TriNet Mobile app, emplo
bluejetty:00014819:ios.description:
Whether you’re at work and need to stay connected, or you’re at home and need to access benefits or payroll information, some things can’t afford to wait until you get back to your work computer. With the redesigned TriNet Mobile app, employees can access important HR details, and admins have the freedom and flexibility to manage HR from the palm of their hands. TriNet Mobile is available for free to all active TriNet employees, and provides secure access to your HR information. 
Key Capabilities:
* Money - View a summary of your most recent paycheck with a detailed breakdown of earnings, taxes and benefits. Compare previous paychecks and access W-2 and W-4 forms. Admins can review and approve payroll on the go.
* Benefits - Access member identification cards from certain medical insurance providers for yourself and covered family members. View TriNet benefits coverage including medical, life, disability and flexible spending account details. During TriNet’s annual Open Enrollment, review and re-enroll in your current benefit plans. 
* Time Off - View your available balance and request time off. Managers and admins can approve time off for team members. 
* Flexible Spending Accounts: View your transaction details and status, or submit claims and receipts. 
* Perks – Access popular deals including discounts on movie tickets, restaurants, car rentals and Apple devices
* Directory/Team – View profiles of your manager, colleagues and team members, and contact them easily through call, email and chat. 
* My To Do’s – View and complete employee to-do items directly from the dashboard (time off requests, expense reports, etc.). 
* Security – Stay protected through password or biometric security using your TriNet credentials and multi-factor authentication. 
* HR – Admins with permissions can add new hires, view employee information such as profile, work, benefits and pay details. 
Using the app means you agree to our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy:
 * https://www.trinet.com/platform-terms
 * https://www.trinet.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00014690:ios.description:
ScanMe turns your iPhone or iPad into a powerful, easy-to-use scanner in just seconds.
Create as many multi-page documents as you need — fast, simple, and intuitive.
Choose your scanning mode:
Let the app detect the document area automatically, or
Snap the photo yourself for full control.
Use your device’s flash if needed, adjust borders, and pick the look you want: Black & White, Color, or Original. You can also fine-tune brightness for the perfect result.
Organizing your files is effortless: give each document a name, add tags for quick search, add or remove pages, reorder them, or rescan if needed.
For best quality, place your paper on a flat surface and smooth out any folds.
Easily upload your documents to Google Drive whenever you need.
When exporting, choose PDF or JPEG, set the quality and file size, then share or print directly from the app.
Subscriptions
ScanMe offers auto-renewable subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings.
Terms of Use: https://appscanme.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00171759:ios.name: Great Conqueror 2: Shogun
bluejetty:00171759:ios.summary:
【Game Introduction】
As the Ashikaga Shogunate wanes, warlords arise and the fog of warfare engulfs the era of Sengoku. In this era, a host of generals and daimyos compete for power, overthrowing higher positions, and the wielding of swords
bluejetty:00171759:ios.description:
【Game Introduction】
As the Ashikaga Shogunate wanes, warlords arise and the fog of warfare engulfs the era of Sengoku. In this era, a host of generals and daimyos compete for power, overthrowing higher positions, and the wielding of swords and blades. Numerous legendary figures such as Oda Nobunaga, Tokugawa Ieyasu, Toyotomi Hideyoshi, and Takeda Shingen ascend onto the stage. Amidst the background where the flames of war rise all around, you will witness the rise and fall of various factions in the Sengoku period in the game.
【Game Characteristics】
▲ Relive real historical events in hundreds of campaign
* Explore 16 chapters with over 200 well-known ancient military battles, including historical events such as the “Battle of Okehazam”, "Mino Campaign" and "Armed Unification". To recreate the tumultuous time of the Sengoku period.
▲ Experience the battles of wits and courage between different Powers in the Sengoku period
Including conquest scenarios such as "Turmoil in Owari", "Armed Unification" and "Encirclement of Nobunaga", allow you to experience both open strife and the veiled struggle between daimyos and different factions. Elements such as retainers group, subordinate states, prestige, personality, and attitude will affect the tides of war, bringing you a new gameplay experience with unlimited potential. The occurrence of historical events will impact the state of the battlefield, and completing missions will reward you with battlefield bonuses. By employing different diplomatic strategies such as gifts, agreements, and war declarations, you will gain deeper insights into the diplomatic situation and attitude between daimyos. Thereby enabling you to make flexible strategies and tactics to advance steadily between conquest and diplomacy!
▲ Begin with one castle, unify the whole region
Take Osaka Castle as your main castle, gradually conquer neighboring Powers, embarking on a journey to dominate, to achieve the ambition of "unifying the entire country" and become the "Tenkabito".
Princesses, expeditions, special forces... more interactive gameplay, with more item rewards. 
In the "Tenkabito" mode, different choices will unlock different history! Fight for your country or open a different path—it is all decided by your wisdom. Write your history and create exceptional glory for the empire!
▲ Legendary generals and extraordinary troops await your command
* Become legendary figures such as Oda Nobunaga, Tokugawa Ieyasu, Toyotomi Hideyoshi, and Takeda Shingen. The spirit of the samurai awakens at this very moment! 
* Infantry, cavalry, archer, musketeer, war gear, ship... a wide variety of unit types allow you to strategize within the command tent and achieve victory a thousand miles apart! There are also special troops with exceptional combat abilities, such as ninjas, sword masters, and Horoshū, ready to be dispatched at any time. Hone your troops on the battlefield as they will gain level upgrades, potentially altering the state of the battlefield!
▲ Conquer the Chaotic era with the assistance of divine artifact suit
Wakizashi, naginata, muramasa, armor... a variety of ancient military equipment and traditional Japanese items will aid you to rise in the Sengoku period. A single exclusive equipment general is no longer your only choice! The powerful suit system and comprehensive forging system allow you to have an abundance of equipment combinations to choose from!

Including conquest scenarios such as "Turmoil in Owari", "Armed Unification" and "Encirclement of Nobunaga", allow you to experience both open strife and the veiled struggle between daimyos and different factions. Elements such as retainers group, subordinate states, prestige, personality, and attitude will affect the tides of war, bringing you a new gameplay experience with unlimited potential. The occurrence of historical events will impact the state of the battlefield, and completing missions will reward you with battlefield bonuses. By employing different diplomatic strategies such as gifts, agreements, and war declarations, you will gain deeper insights into the diplomatic situation and attitude between daimyos. Thereby enabling you to make flexible strategies and tactics to advance steadily between conquest and diplomacy!

▲ Begin with one castle, unify the whole region
Take Osaka Castle as your main castle, gradually conquer neighboring Powers, embarking on a journey to dominate, to achieve the ambition of "unifying the entire country" and become the "Tenkabito".
Princesses, expeditions, special forces... more interactive gameplay, with more item rewards. 
In the "Tenkabito" mode, different choices will unlock different history! Fight for your country or open a different path—it is all decided by your wisdom. Write your history and create exceptional glory for the empire!

▲ Legendary generals and extraordinary troops await your command
* Become legendary figures such as Oda Nobunaga, Tokugawa Ieyasu, Toyotomi Hideyoshi, and Takeda Shingen. The spirit of the samurai awakens at this very moment! 
* Infantry, cavalry, archer, musketeer, war gear, ship... a wide variety of unit types allow you to strategize within the command tent and achieve victory a thousand miles apart! There are also special troops with exceptional combat abilities, such as ninjas, sword masters, and Horoshū, ready to be dispatched at any time. Hone your troops on the battlefield as they will gain level upgrades, potentially altering the state of the battlefield!

▲ Conquer the Chaotic era with the assistance of divine artifact suit
Wakizashi, naginata, muramasa, armor... a variety of ancient military equipment and traditional Japanese items will aid you to rise in the Sengoku period. A single exclusive equipment general is no longer your only choice! The powerful suit system and comprehensive forging system allow you to have an abundance of equipment combinations to choose from!

bluejetty:00041477:ios.description:
Welcome to My Perfect Farm – a relaxing farming simulator game where you can harvest various crops like corn, wheat and take care of beautiful animal's camel, cow, chicken and Ostridge to grow them and build your dream farmland in desert area. Join Shaikh and Hind now to grow your idle farm where beautiful animals are awaiting.
In Cow Farming Game – Start building your perfect animal farm, grow crops, feed animals, and sell goods to expand your farm city. You can hire helpers to complete your task early and unlock new exciting areas in this camel farm game.
In Milking area, you can produce milk from Cow, Goat and Camels. Collect milk bottles and sell them to customers who want to buy milk. 
In Chicken and Ostridge areas, collect eggs and sell them to customers who want to buy eggs.
In Production area, there are Dates and Cheese machines available. Collect milk bottles and send them to machine and produce cheese boxes.
In Farming areas, there are three different crops like corns, watermelon and cabbage. Harvest crops and feed animals to produce milk.
You can enjoy more with newly launched features in the game. There are four different areas added, tomato area, wheat area, olive tree area and hunting area. Additionally, new machines are added like ketchup machine, olive machine and flour machine. Don't waste your time and download now this exciting farming game.
Core Game Features
Grow & Harvest Crops – Plant wheat, corn, vegetables, and fruits.
Raise Adorable Farm Animals – Cows, camels, sheep, goats, chickens, and more.
Trade & Expand – Sell goods to villagers and grow your farming empire.
Idle Gameplay – Earn coins and build your offline farming game easily.
Multiple Areas – Transform desert into a green village farming simulator.
Earn Coins – Collect milk bottles, eggs, and sell to earn coins.
Daily Rewards – Log in daily to collect free rewards.
Family Farm Game – Suitable for all ages and kids farming lovers.
In this Farm Building Game, you will experience the wonders and challenges of realistic farming. Grow corn, feed the cows, camel, hens and Ostridge.
Farming & Building Game lets you enjoy with animal and care of them. In this camel farming game, collect milk and eggs, sell them, and use coins to upgrade your land.
Build Your Own Farm Town
Start by planting crops, harvesting them, and selling produce to earn money. The more you grow, the more you unlock in this Middle Eastern farming game.
Grow and Sell Crops
Harvest fruits, vegetables, and berries to feed animals. Sell them to expand your dream farm city and unlock new farm zones in your casual farming game.
Trade Goods and Earn Coins
Enjoy farming life with cute frenzy animals like chickens, goats, and cows. Feed them, collect produce, and complete orders to grow your Arabic farm game.
Hire and Unlock Helpers
As your farm grows, unlock helpful farmers with unique skills. Complete the camel zone, unlock the ostrich farm, and improve your animal care game step-by-step.
Why This Farming Game?
My Perfect Farm is a relaxing, fun, and offline farming simulator. If you're bored or love nature games, this desert farm game is your perfect escape. Enjoy raising animals and transforming a dry land into a beautiful green farm city.
So, What Are You Waiting For?
Download now and play this trending idle farm game. Cute animals like camels, cows, chickens, ostriches, and sheep are waiting for you in this amazing kids farming game

✅ All charts can be shared through mobile social media of you.

bluejetty:00088135:ios.name: Miracle of Mind - Sadhguru
bluejetty:00088135:ios.summary: Miracle of Mind is a simple, effective, and free app designed to help you take charge of your mental wellbeing and establish a daily meditation practice with a 7-minute guided session by Sadhguru. It offers an engaging experience through mi
bluejetty:00088135:ios.description:
Miracle of Mind is a simple, effective, and free app designed to help you take charge of your mental wellbeing and establish a daily meditation practice with a 7-minute guided session by Sadhguru. It offers an engaging experience through milestones and rewards, helping you make it a part of your every day to manage stress and anxiety, enhance focus, and nurture emotional health.
Meditation for Beginners and Long-Term Meditators
Whether you’ve been practicing meditation or it’s your first time, this app is designed for everyone. There is only a single meditation, which means you have a focused, go-to practice to return to every day, fostering a deeper and more intense practice. Additionally, you can set your meditation duration to fit your schedule while the app reminders help you stay consistent.
Daily Wisdom for Inner Wellbeing
Alongside daily meditation, you can stay inspired with daily wisdom from Sadhguru, offered as short, powerful insights in the form of quotes, audio, and video. These nuggets throw light on various aspects surrounding meditation and mental wellbeing, which can enhance the way you experience life. 
Gamification for Motivation
Stay motivated with our gamification features, designed to keep you on track and inspired! Track your progress with streaks and celebrate milestones with rewards. Valuable stats, including total meditation minutes and the length of your streak, offer a comprehensive view of your meditation journey. 
The app is all about enhancing your meditation experience. Dive in, explore, and let every session help unfold the miracle of your mind. 
About Sadhguru
Yogi, Mystic and Visionary, Sadhguru is among the most influential voices of our times. A New York Times bestselling author, Sadhguru is acclaimed as a speaker and opinion-maker of international renown. His videos are available in 35 languages on social media and were viewed more than 4.37 billion times in 2023 alone. 
Sadhguru's fundamental vision is to offer the science of inner wellbeing to every human being - a science that helps a person realize the ultimate potential within. From this vision stem a multitude of projects, programs, and methods, all towards the same aim: to raise every human being to the peak of their potential so that they are exuberant, all-inclusive, and in harmony within themselves and the world.
Sadhguru has over the last 4 decades offered technologies for wellbeing to all, irrespective of nationality, creed, race or religion. These powerful tools have empowered millions of people to take charge of their mental wellbeing. Sadhguru is recognized as a global authority on wellbeing, and has led the 2016 International Day of Yoga session at the United Nations Headquarters, as well as meditation sessions at global forums such as the World Economic Forum. 
Sadhguru has also launched several large-scale projects in environment, education and community revitalisation. As part of the Conscious Planet initiative, he has also launched the world's largest people's movement - Save Soil, which has so far reached over 4.1 billion people.

bluejetty:00138251:ios.description:
Get fully prepared to earn your Phlebotomy Technician certification with the all-in-one Phlebotomy Practice Test app — your personal study coach for passing the exam with ease and confidence. Trusted by thousands of medical students and lab professionals, this app helps you master essential skills like venipuncture, patient safety, and specimen handling through realistic practice tests and interactive learning tools.
Our Phlebotomy exam prep questions are categorized into various topics:
• Core Knowledge
• Safety and Compliance
• Patient Preparation
• Routine Blood Collections
• Special Collections
• Processing
**Why You’ll Love This App**
- Realistic Exam Simulation: Take practice tests that mirror the format and difficulty of the actual ASPT or NHA Phlebotomy Certification exams. Get instant feedback to know exactly where you stand.
- Study by Topic: Learn step-by-step across core areas: Anatomy & Physiology, Safety & Infection Control, Specimen Handling, Equipment & Procedures, and Professional Ethics. Reinforce weak areas with focused review.
- AI Mentor – Smart Study Assistant: Meet Mentora, your AI-powered tutor that explains concepts, answers your questions, and helps you understand each topic faster and better. Study like you have a personal instructor on demand.
- Custom & Diagnostic Tests: Start with a diagnostic test to identify your strengths and weaknesses, then build custom tests to focus on specific topics or question types.
- Detailed Explanations & References: Access detailed rationales for every question to understand not just the ‘what’ but the ‘why’. Build deeper clinical understanding as you practice.
- Progress Tracking & Analytics: Monitor your passing probability, topic performance, and progress over time. Stay motivated with clear goals and measurable improvement.
**Designed for Future Phlebotomists**
Whether you’re preparing for ASPT, NHA, or other certification exams, this app helps you practice smarter and stay confident on test day.
Start Your Certification Journey Today! Download the Phlebotomy Practice Test app and take your first step toward becoming a certified phlebotomy technician.

bluejetty:00086160:ios.description:
Complete verification of the history of a used car before purchase. Auto Expert is your personal car library and a detailed report on VIN (VIN) and state number, which will help you make the right choice and avoid buying a problematic car.
Our comprehensive auto check provides detailed information to assess the actual condition of the vehicle. Find out the whole truth about the car before making a deal on Avito or auto ru.
What the Autoexpert report contains:
- History of ownership and operation: Checking the databases of the traffic police of the Russian Federation will show the number of owners and registration periods. We find the car's car code and data from the database drm vin01.
- Participation in an accident: Get information about road accidents with a description of damage. It is indispensable for assessing the condition of the body.
- Legal purity: Data from the Registry of Liens and the FSSP will help to ensure legal purity. We check the availability of the CTP policy and unpaid fines, which may come as a surprise after purchase.
- Real mileage: We compare data from different sources, including the history of technical inspections and auction sites, in order to identify the twisted mileage.
- Checking the seller for anti-overbooking: We analyze the seller's phone number to identify professional resellers. Our report collects the history of ads from popular sites, as well as tracks price dynamics through auto.ru and the nomerogram service.
Auto Expert is your main assistant in choosing and buying a used car. Download the app for free and make your decision based on facts, not on the seller's words.
