bluejetty:00115478:ios.summary: Vloset Healthy Wearing is a virtual closet app that allows you to add all of your clothes and analyze how healthy they are. The Vloset Health Score and detailed material information help you understand the analysis of each clothing piece. S
bluejetty:00115478:ios.description:
Vloset Healthy Wearing is a virtual closet app that allows you to add all of your clothes and analyze how healthy they are. The Vloset Health Score and detailed material information help you understand the analysis of each clothing piece. See what each material is rated in order to avoid harmful fabrics and learn more about healthier options. Then, you can declutter your closet and start filling it with better, less harmful clothing.
HOW IT WORKS 
Easily add pictures of your clothes with automatic background removal. Use clothing item tags to add each material and its percentage to determine the Vloset Health Score. 
Once you’ve added your clothes, you can easily see which items you’d like to keep, replace, or donate. 
You can organize your clothes however you’d like with custom clothing categories that you get to create. 
Make outfits with your clothes so you can have them saved and always have something to wear. If you’re starting a capsule wardrobe with your new healthier clothes, making outfits are a great way to save the different combinations. 
We understand how replacing your current clothes for healthier alternatives can be overwhelming. Vloset Healthy Wearing helps make it easy. 
P.S.
What if you upgrade your iPhone yearly? Don’t worry! Everything is backed up to the cloud if you have iCloud Drive enabled. Just download the app again on your new phone and everything will be there. 
P.P.S.
No account required! How? Simple, all of your data is linked to your Apple Account and is stored privately.
This app is subject to Apple’s standard End User License Agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00164090:ios.description:
Turn any idea into a high-quality original song with vocals – a birthday song for someone you love, a graduation anthem, a wedding surprise or a track just for you. Describe it, chat it through or bring your own lyrics, and MusicMint AI makes the music. No singing, instruments or music theory needed.
THREE WAYS TO CREATE
• Chat (Beta) – Talk it through. Tell MusicMint who the song is for and what you want to say. Type, use voice input or start from a photo, and shape the story, mood and lyrics step by step.
• Quick – One prompt, a whole song. Describe the sound you have in mind, pick a style and mood if you like, and create. Switch on Instrumental for music without vocals.
• Custom – Your lyrics, your sound. Bring your own words or write them with AI help, then set the style, mood and vocal.
START FROM A MOMENT
Birthday, graduation, wedding, party and more – pick a moment and get a head start on the right song.
SONGS MADE FOR SOMEONE
Send a song as a gift with a personal link, or share it with friends. Every creation gives you two versions, so you can choose the one that fits best.
WRITE AND SHAPE YOUR LYRICS
Use the Lyrics Editor to write from scratch or get AI help with the words. Organize verses, choruses and bridges, preview them, save them to your library and turn them into a song with one tap.
MORE AI TOOLS
• AI Voice Cover – turn a song into a cover with an AI voice.
• Album Cover – create artwork for your songs with AI.
DISCOVER MUSIC AND YOUR NEXT IDEA
Browse recommendations and charts in Discover, or listen through the Feed. Hear something you love? Tap "Make one like this" to open a new Custom draft with that song's available lyrics and style, and make it your own.
FIND YOUR SOUND
Pop, rock, hip-hop, blues, jazz, EDM, K-pop and more. Choose the style and mood that fit your idea – upbeat, heartfelt, dreamy or calm.
KEEP EVERYTHING IN MY STUDIO
Find all your songs and versions in My Studio, listen back, download them as MP3 and share your favorites.

bluejetty:00042071:ios.description:
FitGrid is an all-new fitness social network. Now you can find your new favorite workout classes and stream them along with all of your favorite people.
FIND VIRTUAL & IN-STUDIO CLASSES YOU LOVE
Leverage our AI-powered recommendation engine to find and manage your classes in one place. Get notifications when classes go live, friends sign up for classes, or a class is changed/canceled.
SORT BY YOUR FRIENDS’ FAVORITE INSTRUCTORS AND WORKOUTS
Tap into your friends’ fitness routines, discover which classes they’re taking, and find the ones you like best.
CONNECT WITH FRIENDS, CLASSMATES, AND INSTRUCTORS
Message a friend to let them know you’ll be working out with them at home or check-in with your instructor about your form.
LET YOUR INSTRUCTORS KNOW ABOUT YOUR PAINS OR INJURIES

Automatically track how many workout classes you are taking each week and add additional workouts that were performed outside the classroom so you can monitor your progress and achieve your goals. Get free class reward points for every class you take! 
How to use the app:
* Download the FitGrid app, search for classes, and connect with classmates
* Search for live-stream and in-studio classes, such as: yoga, Pilates, HIIT, boxing, spinning, strength training, barre, running, dance, martial arts, meditation, and more.
* Stay motivated by forming groups and plan workouts together
* See class details so you know what to expect
* Manage classes seamlessly with one account
FItGrid is more fun with friends. Download the app today and get your first class free!

bluejetty:00182849:ios.name: Incredibox
bluejetty:00182849:ios.summary: Incredibox lets you create your own music with the help of a merry crew of beatboxers. Choose your musical style to start laying down, recording and sharing your mix. Get your groove on with hip-hop beats, electro waves, pop voices, jazzy s
bluejetty:00182849:ios.description:
Incredibox lets you create your own music with the help of a merry crew of beatboxers. Choose your musical style to start laying down, recording and sharing your mix. Get your groove on with hip-hop beats, electro waves, pop voices, jazzy swing, Brazilian rhythms and much more. As well, discover a selection of mods created by the community. Plenty to keep you mixing for hours, with no ads or microtransactions.
Part game, part tool, Incredibox is above all an audio and visual experience that has quickly become a hit with people of all ages. The right mix of music, graphics, animation and interactivity makes Incredibox ideal for everyone. And because it makes learning fun and entertaining, Incredibox is now being used by schools all over the world.
How to play? Easy! Drag and drop icons onto the avatars to make them sing and start to compose your own music. Find the right sound combos to unlock animated choruses that will enhance your tune.
Once your composition sounds great, just save it and share it to get as many votes as possible. If you get enough votes, you may go down in Incredibox history by joining the Top 50 chart! Ready to show your stuff?
You can also download your mix as an MP3 from the app and listen to it over and over again!
Too lazy to create your own mix? No problem, just let the automatic mode play for you!
Pump it up and chill ;)
****************
Incredibox, the brainchild of Lyon, France-based studio So Far So Good, was created in 2009. Starting out as a webpage, it was then released as a mobile and tablet app and became an instant hit. It has won several awards and appeared in various international media, including: BBC, Adobe, FWA, Gizmodo, Slate, Konbini, Softonic, Kotaku, Cosmopolitan, PocketGamer, AppAdvice, AppSpy, Vice, Ultralinx and many others. The online demo has attracted more than 100 million visitors since its creation.

bluejetty:00048359:ios.description:
NCE Exam Prep: 2026 is an exam preparation app that will help you pass the National Counselor Examination for Licensure and Certification (NCE) administered by the National Board for Certified Counselors (NBCC) with a high score on your first attempt! 
NCE Exam Prep: 2026 will not only help you gain insight into concepts related to NCE exam preparation, but will also help you increase your confidence in passing the exam on your first attempt by practicing hundreds of exam-like questions.
### Pass the exam on the first attempt ###
In NCE Exam Prep: 2026, there are a large number of questions prepared by exam experts covering the range of official test requirements. According to the test requirements, you must master several subjects in order to successfully pass the NCE exam.
Specifically, these subjects include:
- Professional Practice and Ethics (12%)
- Intake, Assessment, and Diagnosis (12%)
- Areas of Clinical Focus (29%)
- Treatment Planning (9%)
- Counseling Skills and Interventions (30%)
- Core Counseling Attributes (8%)
To help you pass the exam, our test experts have carefully analyzed and broken down the above subjects. You will need to practice all 6 subjects, which will help you pass the exam with confidence!
### Key features ###
- Over 1000 practice questions, each with detailed answer explanations
- Specialized practice by content area, with the flexibility to switch between them at any time
- View an analysis of your current performance in the "Statistics" section
The most important part of passing the NCE exam is to keep practicing and not lose confidence in the exam. You will find that each time you practice on NCE Exam Prep: 2026, your knowledge of the exam increases, thus increasing your certainty of passing the exam.
Set aside a certain amount of time each day to practice some questions while hinting to yourself that you will do the same tomorrow. After you have developed good study habits, you will find it easier to pass and score high on not only the NCE exam, but on any other exam!
### Purchases, subscriptions and terms ###
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to unlock access to all features, content areas and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted directly from your Apple account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged according to the rate and term chosen for the subscription plan. If you need to cancel your subscription, please do so no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term or your account will be automatically charged for renewal.
You can manage your subscription by turning off auto-renewal in your account settings in Apple after purchase. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).

Privacy Policy - https://www.yesmaster.pro/Privacy-Policy/
If you have any questions or comments about your use, please email us at contact@yesmaster.pro and we will resolve them for you within 3 working days at the latest.

bluejetty:00080994:ios.description:
Kingland - Castle Adventure invites you to an epic medieval adventure where your strategic prowess as a King will shape the fate of a feudal realm.
Build your own kingdom from the ground up, starting with a humble castle and expanding into a grand empire. Gather resources, harvest town materials, and manage your resources wisely to progress.
In Kingland - Castle Adventure, the balance of power is constantly shifting.
You must conquer new territories and build alliances to face the ever-present threat of darkness. Engage in epic battles where you’ll fight zombies, face off against rival heroes vs. hordes, and navigate through a world plagued by wasteland life and dark magic.
Experience the true essence of medieval life as you rise to power.
Build your castle, upgrade your heroes, and lead them into war and order. Craft your strategy to overcome the challenges of feudal conflicts and war, and restore the honor of kings in your battle against the dark forces.
Gameplay Features:
Build Your Castle:
Strategically fortify your castle in the midst of the zombie apocalypse. Customize defenses, recruit brave warriors, and arm yourself to protect your people.
Fight Against Zombies:
Lead your armies in adrenaline-pumping combat against persistent zombie waves. Command troops, cast powerful spells, and wield legendary weapons to push back the darkness.
Fast-paced Combat:
Experience real-time battles against zombie waves. Plan your tactics, coordinate with allies, and unleash devastating attacks to emerge victorious. Save your territory from becoming a wasteland.
Reclaim the Land:
Restore balance to the wasteland by healing corrupted areas. Use the power of nature to cleanse the land, cultivate fertile soil, and reclaim lost territories. Build up your kingdom from wasteland life to a glorious realm.
Become the King:
Lead your kingdom through dark times and earn the respect of your people. Restore the honor of kings, forge alliances, unite the realm, and rise as the legendary ruler Kingland needs.
Conquer Darkness & Dark Magic:
Embark on epic quests, conquer dungeons, and challenge other players in intense combat. Prove your worth as the ultimate champion and lead Kingland to peace and prosperity.
Ready to rise against darkness and become the hero Kingland deserves? Download now and embark on an epic journey of conquest and redemption!
Your journey will be filled with magical discoveries and fierce battles as you command your kingdom and fight for the new rise of kingdoms. Will you rise and bring honor to kings in this epic saga of Kingland - Castle Adventure, or will the shadows of darkness overtake you?
Get ready to build, craft, and conquer in Kinglan - Castle Adventure. Your adventure awaits!

Learn times tables multiplication effectively

** These are restricted versions of the Desmos Calculators that comply with exam requirements. To prepare for specific state or national assessments, select the corresponding test from the menu in the app. Find out whether Desmos is used for your test at www.desmos.com/testing. 
If you’d like to use full, unrestricted versions of the calculators, download the Scientific or Graphing Calculator apps or visit www.desmos.com. **
At Desmos, we imagine a world of universal math literacy where math is accessible and enjoyable for all students. To that end, we’ve built simple yet powerful calculators. They’re intuitive, beautiful, and completely free.
- - -
Graphing Calculator Features:
Graphing: Plot polar, Cartesian, and parametric graphs. There’s no limit to how many expressions you can graph at one time—and you don’t even need to enter expressions in y= form!
Sliders: Adjust values interactively to build intuition, or animate any parameter to visualize its effect on the graph.
Tables: Input and plot data, or create an input-output table for any function.
Statistics: Use regressions to find the lines (or other curves!) that best fit your data.
Zooming: Scale the axes independently or at the same time with the pinch of two fingers, or edit the window size manually to get the perfect view of your graph.
Points of Interest: Touch a curve to show its maximum and minimum values, intercepts, and points of intersection with other curves. Tap any of these points of interest to see their coordinates. Hold and drag along a curve to see the coordinates change under your finger as you trace.
- - -
Scientific Calculator Features:
Variables: Assign values to variables that you can use in other expressions. Since all of your work is held in the expressions list, you can compute a value once and use it in many places simultaneously. Take advantage of the “ans” key, which always stores the value of the previous expression.
Arithmetic: Beyond the four basic operations, the scientific calculator also supports exponentiation, radicals, absolute value, logarithms, rounding, and percentages.
Trigonometry: Evaluate the fundamental trigonometric functions and their inverses using either radians or degrees for angle measure.
Statistics: Compute the mean and standard deviation (sample or population) of a list of data.
Combinatorics: Count combinations and permutations and calculate factorials.
- - -
Four-Function Calculator Features:
Simple and Beautiful: Just the basics done right. Add, subtract, multiply, divide, and take square roots.
Multiple Expressions: Unlike many four-function calculators, all of your previous work remains visible on the screen. The special “ans” key always holds the value of the previous computation (and updates automatically!), so you never have to remember or copy a result.

bluejetty:00184763:ios.summary: No ads, no tracking, no subscriptions. Spades is a trick-taking card game that can be played with 3 players solo, 4 players solo, or 4 players with partners (2 teams of 2). A standard 52-card deck is dealt, then players bid the number of tr
bluejetty:00184763:ios.description:
No ads, no tracking, no subscriptions. Spades is a trick-taking card game that can be played with 3 players solo, 4 players solo, or 4 players with partners (2 teams of 2). A standard 52-card deck is dealt, then players bid the number of tricks they can take. The goal is to take as many tricks as were bid. When playing with partners, North/South is one team, West/East is the other, and teammates' bids and tricks are combined, so one player's underbid can compensate for his teammate's overbid.
This app allows you to configure number of players and teams, the appearance of the table and cards, rules about nil bids and when spades can be lead. There are instructions included in the app, as well as a setting to make your robot opponents less aggressive or more aggressive.
Spades Gold edition has no advertising and no in-app purchases. It includes several card back and tabletop options that are not available in the ad-supported edition.

Tablå
bluejetty:00086990:ios.description:
Tv.nu - Din guide till all streaming & TV
Film, sport, serier, tablå
tv.nu är Sveriges största guide till TV och streaming. Mer än två miljoner användare hittar varje vecka rätt i djungeln av innehåll att titta på med hjälp av tv.nu. 
Tablå
På startsidan får du direkt koll på vad som går på TV och vad som är nytt på streaming. Du anpassar din tablå enkelt inne på Min sida. Där kan du lägga till och ta bort kanaler eller byta ordningen de visas i. Vi har alla de populäraste streamingkanalerna så som t ex Netflix, SVT Play, Viaplay, Viafree, HBO Nordic, Dplay och Itunes och fler än 200 TV-kanaler att välja bland. 
Streaming
Under Streaming kan du utforska innehållet hos streamingkanalerna, hitta inspiration med samlingar och tips från tv.nu:s redaktörer. Du kan filtrera på olika genrer och se vad som är populärast och högst betygsatt på dina streamingkanaler.
Sök
Med sökfunktionen kan du hitta program, serier, filmer, skådespelare eller regissörer oavsett om det gäller TV eller streaming.
Streama med ett klick
För varje titel visar vi var den kan streamas, eller när den kan ses. Från titlar på streaming kan du använda direktlänkar och se programmet i mobilen eller t.ex. på din TV med Chromecast eller Airplay.
Skapa konto / Logga in
Genom att skapa konto och logga in kan du på Min sida spara dina kanalval och få din egna anpassade tablå oavsett vilket plattform du använder tv.nu på. Som inloggad kan du också sätta återkommande påminnelser och spara favoriter. 
Har du konto på tv.nu kan du få tv.nu:s nyhetsbrev med de bästa TV- och streamingtipsen från våra redaktörer. 
Favoriter 
Du sparar ett program till dina Favoriter genom att trycka på hjärtat inne på programmet. Med favoriter håller du koll på när programmet visas på TV och kan sätta återkommande påminnelser.
Påminnelser
Genom att sätta påminnelser blir du påmind när programmet startar, alternativt vid en tidpunkt innan programstart. 
Har du önskemål om hur appen kan bli ännu bättre så kontakta oss gärna här: https://kundo.se/org/tvnu/
För dig som användare är det gratis att använda vår guide till streaming och TV. Tv.nu tjänar pengar dels genom effektiva annonslösningar till våra annonsörer, och dels genom att genom att teckna avtal med streamingtjänster och ta betalt av dem varje gång du klickar dig fram till dem. Oavsett vill vi alltid ha dig som användare i fokus och visa upp alla alternativ som finns att se programmet för att guida dig rätt.

bluejetty:00146250:ios.description:

Compete in diverse racing challenges:
Time trials against the clock
Overtake missions with endless traffic
1v1 car duels
High-speed police chase
Star collection runs
Diamond bonus mode
Death race survival

Addictive one-touch control system
Fast-paced traffic racing action
Multiple game modes to test your skills
Scenic countryside and desert racing environments
Realistic physics and crash damage
Unlock and upgrade a wide variety of cars
If you are searching for a thrilling car overtaking game with endless challenges, this is the perfect choice. Play now and prove yourself as the ultimate traffic racing master on two-lane desert highways!

bluejetty:00017408:ios.description:
Catch up with your favorite OWN shows anytime, anywhere with the all-new Watch OWN app - and now get access to up to 14 additional networks including TLC, HGTV, ID and more - all in one app. It’s FREE with your pay TV subscription. 
Link your pay TV provider (cable, satellite, telco, live TV streaming service) to access OWN favorites like Ready to Love, Love & Marriage: Huntsville, The Haves and the Have Nots, Queen Sugar, Put a Ring On It and many more - plus top shows from other networks including Flip or Flop (HGTV), 90 Day Fiancé: Happily Ever After? (TLC), Evil Lives Here (ID), Naked and Afraid (Discovery) and more. New episodes are available the same day as they premiere on TV. 
With Watch OWN You Can:
• Stream OWN and more networks LIVE anytime, anywhere on all your favorite devices
• Find shows to watch with the live schedule guide
• Access thousands of episodes on demand - from current hits to classic favorites
• See new episodes of shows on the app the same day and time they premiere on TV
• Binge your favorite OWN series and specials including Ready to Love, Love & Marriage: Huntsville, The Haves and the Have Nots, Queen Sugar, Put a Ring On It - and many more! 
• Get unlimited access to everything the Discovery family of networks has to offer - free with your pay TV subscription
Features:
• Stream live TV when you log in with your pay TV provider
• Watch select episodes and entire seasons of your favorite shows from up to 15 networks!
• Browse by genre - from Natural History, Science and Tech to Food, Home and more - to find your favorite shows and discover new ones
• Continue watching episodes where you left off across all of your devices
• Save shows and episodes to watch later with My List
• Compatible with tvOS and Chromecast
• Closed-captioning support
Requirements:
• Available in the U.S. only
• Wi-Fi connection recommended
• iOS 12 or higher

bluejetty:00034394:ios.description:
Sharlotte receives a mysterious box - is it from her archenemy?
Solve puzzles and riddles in this mysterious game! Find the hidden objects!
________________________________________________________________________
Will you manage to uncover the mystery of Ms. Holmes: Letter M? Test yourself in solving engaging puzzles, explore unusual locations and learn all secrets of the mysterious parcel. You have a great opportunity to learn what surprise was prepared for Sharlotte by her nemesis.
Note that this is a free trial version of the hidden objects game. 
You can get the full version by means of an in-app purchase.
Sharlotte receives a mysterious box. All signs indicate that it might be from her nemesis, Moriarty - Adler, Sharlotte’s friend, finds evidence of that. Meanwhile, Oscar Watson receives a patient with an incredible story - an engineer with a severed finger who barely survived after fixing a submarine with the same symbol as on the box - the letter M made of crossed sabers. Are these two signs connected? What will the submarine be used for? Help Sharlotte prevent the crime of the century!
FIND OUT HOW THE BOX AND THE SUBMARINE ARE CONNECTED
Is the box and the engineer at Oscar’s doorstep just a tease from Moriarty who wants to play another series of mind games? 
WHAT DANGERS AWAIT US IN THIS INVESTIGATION? 
Solve engaging puzzles and complete fun mini-games to find out why strange events take place and who is in fact the perpetrator.
HELP SHARLOTTE MAKE IT OUT ALIVE
Complete engaging HO scenes and feel the thrill caused by the unexpected plot twists.
FIND OUT WHAT HAPPENED TO OSCAR IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
Play as Oscar Watson to prevent a threat looming over Sharlotte and enjoy the bonuses of Collector’s Edition! Earn a variety of unique achievements! Tons of collectibles and puzzle pieces to find!
Enjoy replayable HOPs and mini-games, exclusive wallpapers, soundtrack, concept art, and more!
Zoom in on the scenes to help find all hidden objects, and use clues if you get stuck.

Core Gameplay
Become a legendary renovator! Discover hidden structures deep within the mines and use your trusty tools to revitalize them with vibrant hues. Master strategic coloring techniques, outsmart mining challenges, and rise to become the ultimate underground artisan!

Live Mining Showdowns
Face off against top renovators worldwide in real-time battles! Race against the clock—and your rivals—to complete coloring tasks with flawless speed and accuracy!

Climb the ranks from Rookie → Pro → Specialist → Expert → Master Miner in high-stakes limited-time stages. Battle

Renovation Trials
Master ever-changing structure layouts and coloring techniques to prove your mastery of the underground!

Strategic Tool Collection – Discover and upgrade unique mining implements that enhance your coloring abilities!
Underground Challenges – No two structures are the same in these ever-evolving mines!
Prestigious Rewards – Unlock exclusive titles and rare tools!
Pet Companions – Feed coins to your mining companions to evolve them and unlock special abilities!
Gear up—the mines are waiting for your creative touch!
Special Notes:
Pet System: Nurture your mining pets by feeding them coins. Watch them grow and evolve, providing unique advantages in your renovation projects!
Join the underground renovation revolution today!

Similar and Other Video Cleanup: AI Cleaner identifies and cleans similar or space-consuming video files, helping you efficiently manage your phone's storage.

Flikshop is the easiest way to send real photo postcards to anyone in jail or prison. Built by Marcus Bullock, a returning citizen who served 8 years and knows what these photos mean.
Snap a photo. Add a message. We print and mail it. Deli
bluejetty:00089541:ios.description:
Flikshop is the easiest way to send real photo postcards to anyone in jail or prison. Built by Marcus Bullock, a returning citizen who served 8 years and knows what these photos mean.
Snap a photo. Add a message. We print and mail it. Delivered in 5-7 days from $1.29.
WHY FAMILIES CHOOSE FLIKSHOP
• Real photos, not pixelated email scans. Your loved one tapes them to the wall.
• Approved by 30+ state DOC mail systems including Utah, Texas, California, Florida, Ohio, Illinois, Georgia, Kentucky, South Carolina, Michigan, Arizona, and Pennsylvania.
• Postcards from $1.29. Photo books and letters available.
• 4.8 stars from 951 families on iOS.
• Built by people who lived this story. Marcus served 8 years. His mom Sylvia kept his photos taped to her wall the whole time. That's why we built Flikshop.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose a photo from your phone.
2. Add a personal message.
3. We print on real cardstock and mail to the facility.
4. Your loved one holds it within a week.
FOR FAMILIES, BY FAMILY
Flikshop exists because we know what it feels like to count days, to write letters that take weeks, to send photos that get rejected at the mailroom. We've spent 13 years getting approved at facility after facility so your card actually arrives.
When your mom, your partner, your son, your father is far away, a photo on the wall is the difference between a hard week and a brutal one. We don't take that lightly.
QUESTIONS? CHANGES? PROBLEMS?
Email info@flikshop.com - we respond within 24 hours. If something doesn't arrive, we re-send it free.
Download Flikshop and send your first photo today.

bluejetty:00134335:ios.description:
Sync Google Health (formerly Fitbit) to Apple Health with Syncfit
Syncfit makes it easy to transfer your health and fitness data from your Google Health (formerly Fitbit) account to Apple Health.
You can sync the following data:
Active Energy
Blood Oxygen
Body Fat Percentage
Body Mass Index
Cardio Fitness Score
Cycling Distance
Cycling Speed
Dietary Energy
Flights Climbed
Heart Rate
Lean Body Mass
Respiratory Rate
Resting Energy
Resting Heart Rate
Running Speed
Sleep
Steps
Swimming Distance
Walking + Running Distance
Walking Speed
Water
Weight
Workouts
Getting started is simple. Download Syncfit, connect your Google Health account, grant the required permissions, connect Apple Health, and tap Sync. You can sync your latest data or import your historical health records into Apple Health.
## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What does Syncfit do?
A: Syncfit transfers your health and fitness data from Google Health to Apple Health, making it easy to keep your Apple Health records up to date.
Q: Why should I sync Google Health with Apple Health?
A: Apple Health becomes a single place to view your health data alongside information from your other health and fitness apps.
Q: Is Syncfit easy to use?
A: Yes. Simply connect your Google Health account, authorize Apple Health, and tap Sync.
Q: Can I import my historical data?
A: Yes. Syncfit can transfer both recent and historical health data from your Google Health account.
Q: Is my data secure?
A: Yes. Syncfit transfers your data securely and does not sell your personal health information.
Q: Can I choose what to sync?
A: Yes. You decide which health categories to transfer, including steps, sleep, workouts, heart rate, weight, and more.
Q: Will Syncfit overwrite my existing Apple Health data?
A: No. Syncfit adds compatible records to Apple Health without deleting your existing data.
Q: How accurate is the transferred data?
A: Syncfit transfers the data provided by Google Health without modification.
Q: Is Syncfit free?
A: Steps are available for free. A subscription unlocks all supported health and fitness data types.
Subscription:
A subscription unlocks all supported health and fitness data categories.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
- Promotional subscriptions do not include a free trial.
- A 3-day free trial is available where offered. After the trial ends, your Apple Account will be charged unless the subscription is canceled.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal at any time in your Apple Account Settings.
- Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Privacy Policy: http://mprapps.com/privacy.html
Terms of Service: http://mprapps.com/syncfit_tos.html

bluejetty:00041654:ios.description:
The official Melbourne Airport app is your travel companion, from the moment you leave home to the moment you board. Track your flight, follow a trip plan, book parking, get help and find your way around the terminals, all in one place.
Stay on top of your flight
• Search departures and arrivals by flight number, airline or destination

• Save another flight and keep every trip in one place
Getting here

• Explore other ways to get here, including public transport, taxis, rideshare and pick-up and drop-off

• Find airport lounges and plan some downtime before you fly
Find your way
• Use interactive terminal maps to find your gate, shops and services
• Tap a terminal to jump straight to it on the map
Travel with confidence
• Trip plans that favour step-free routes using lifts and escalators
• Prompts that show where mobility assistance is available
• Information on accessibility resources and services across the airport
Help when you need it
• Find airport services, travel assistance and support in one place
• Ask our virtual assistant for answers to your airport questions
Whether you're flying out, picking someone up or heading home, the Melbourne Airport app helps your day run smoothly.

bluejetty:00044515:ios.description:
Take Ten! brings the classic pen-and-paper number puzzle to your iPhone. Match equal numbers or pairs that add up to 10, remove them from the board and think through your next move.
How to play
Find two equal numbers, such as 7 and 7, or a pair that adds up to 10, such as 4 and 6. Remove valid pairs and work toward an empty board.
When no pairs are available, add the remaining numbers to the end of the board and look again.
Simple rules, thoughtful moves
You do not need complex calculations. The challenge is spotting a pair and choosing which one to remove first. Each move changes the board, so keep looking for new possibilities.
Hints and undo
Need help finding your next pair? Use a hint. Want to try a different move? Undo lets you take a step back.
A familiar puzzle for a break
Rediscover the number game you played on paper, or try this style of logic puzzle for the first time. Start with a single pair and see how much of the board you can clear.
Find your next pair. Aim for a clear board

bluejetty:00040933:ios.description:
Discover, stream, and enjoy your favorite music videos anytime, anywhere — for FREE.
With 9Tube, you will enjoy moments of ultimate relaxation and entertainment. We believe that every moment of your video experience is valuable and deserves the best care.
Experience video enjoyment with three exclusive viewing modes:
● Infinity Mode: Perfect for when you want to relax, unwind, or simply decorate your workspace with beautiful and continuously playing videos.
● Driving Mode: Focuses on your music experience while driving, without disrupting your concentration.
● Cinema Mode: Provides a realistic and vivid movie-watching experience, as if you were in a high-class cinema.
Key Features:
• Unlimited Music
Access an extensive library of songs from popular artists. Stream without limits and discover new favorites every day.
• CarPlay
Supports connecting to your car's entertainment system, providing a safe and convenient video viewing experience while driving.
• AirPlay
Easily stream videos from 9Tube to other Apple devices like Apple TV, offering a large-screen video experience.
• Picture-in-Picture (PiP)
Allows you to continue watching videos in a small window while performing other tasks on your device.
• Video suggestions and auto-play
9Tube intelligently suggests the next videos based on your preferences and auto-plays them, ensuring you never miss captivating content.
• Dynamic background effects
Creates a unique and beautiful video viewing space, enhancing your visual experience.
• Auto video playback
Each time you open the app, videos automatically play from where you left off, without any additional actions.
• Independent volume control
Adjust the video volume independently of the system volume, providing an optimal audio experience.
• In-app brightness adjustment
Easily adjust the screen brightness within the app, suitable for all lighting conditions.
• Optimized content download
9Tube is optimized to save data when using 3G/4G/LTE/5G networks, allowing you to watch videos without worrying about data costs.
• Music sleep timer
This feature allows you to set a timer to turn off the music after a certain period, ideal for when you want to listen to music before sleeping.
• Create personal playlists
Easily create and manage your own playlists.
Why Choose 9Tube?
- Unlimited access to over 100 million songs and videos
- High-quality streaming (320 kbps AAC)
- Create unlimited playlists and build your perfect library
- Share your playlists with friends
- Powerful search: Songs, Albums, Artists, Playlists
- Smart auto-recommendations tailored to your taste
- Sleep timer for relaxing music sessions
- Real-time lyrics support
- Full queue management for seamless playback
9Tube Premium (optional):
Upgrade to Premium to unlock all premium features, available as a monthly, 6-month, or yearly subscription, or as a one-time Lifetime purchase.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

FEATURES 
- Vie
bluejetty:00090364:ios.description:
The DiverLog+ for mobile app is the premier full-featured dive log application. DiverLog+ is the Official App for Bluetooth Smart dive computers made by the following manufacturers: AQUALUNG, APEKS, HUISH/OCEANIC, SHERWOOD.
FEATURES 
- View, edit, and manage your DC dive detail data 
- Search dives based on location, dive type, buddies, many more 
- View, edit and manage your favorite dive spots and locations 
- View, edit and manage your dive gear, buddies 
- Keep track of personal data including medical and certification information 
- Upload slates, MY INFO, GPS Location to Dive Computer (DSX only)
- Add photos, Youtube video links to dives, and remember those fun times 
- Social sharing features 
- Synchronize with DiverLog application for desktop, laptop, and mobiles devices
- Download dive data from Dive Computer, upload your desired settings to Dive Computer, update firmware to Dive Computer using Bluetooth Smart (currently supports BEACON, CALM-ACT, DSX, i200C, i300C, i330R, i330R Console, i470TC, i550C, i750TC, i770R, GEO 4.0, GEO AIR, PROPLUS 4.0, PROPLUS X, SAGE, VEO 4.0, WISDOM 4.0)
- Much more ... 
SUMMARY 
DiverLog+ allows you to view, edit, and manage your dives easily. 
The dive detail section gives you all the information you need, including dive data, location and dive site information, tank and buddy information, gear bag, and more. Add your diving buddies and keep your personal certification and medical information on hand at all times. View your dive profile in full screen view. Add and manage your gear with easy entry forms. DiverLog+ offers you simple search methods to find your dives .. search by location, dive site, and even which computer you used! ...See all your dives on the world map, a unique feature we call your dive activity map! You can even keep track of your personal information, including medical and certification info. You can now sync your dives with the DiveCloud online dive data backup system so you never lose your dives, and always have them available, wherever you are! Connect with our developers by posting in the forum, or contact by email at the support website: https://ediverlog.com

bluejetty:00019522:ios.description:
De Berichtenbox app is alleen te gebruiken in combinatie met de DigiD app. De DigiD app moet op het zelfde apparaat staan en u gebruikt de pincode van de DigD app om de Berichtenbox app te openen. 
Met de app heeft u toegang tot de inbox, archief en prullenbak van uw Berichtenbox op MijnOverheid. U kunt berichten lezen en verplaatsen naar het archief of prullenbak. Als een bericht een bijlage heeft kunt u deze doorsturen, opslaan of openen in een andere app. In de app ziet u welke nieuwe organisaties van de Berichtenbox gebruik zijn gaan maken en u kunt aangeven of deze organisaties post digitaal naar u mogen versturen. Momenteel is het nog niet mogelijk om uw voorkeuren aan te passen voor organisaties die al aangesloten zijn. U kunt hiervoor inloggen op de website van mijn.overheid.nl. 
GEGEVENSVERWERKING & PRIVACY
Als u de Berichtenbox app van MijnOverheid gebruikt worden er bepaalde persoonsgegevens verwerkt. Tijdens het inloggen wordt uw BSN via DigiD naar MijnOverheid verstuurd. Om de gegevens vanuit uw MijnOverheid-account in de Berichtenbox app te tonen wordt een notificatietoken, een gebruikerstoken en een versleuteltoken gebruikt.
Door de Berichtenbox app te gebruiken gaat u akkoord met deze verwerking, waar ook de onderstaande bepalingen voor gelden.
• De persoonsgegevens van de gebruiker worden verwerkt conform de Algemene Verordening Gegevensbescherming en de privacyverklaring op de website van MijnOverheid (mijn.overheid.nl/privacy). Regels over de verwerking van persoonsgegevens door MijnOverheid zijn opgenomen in het Besluit 
verwerking persoonsgegevens generieke digitale infrastructuur. Regels over de werking, beveiliging en betrouwbaarheid van MijnOverheid zijn 
opgenomen in de Regeling voorzieningen GDI (mijn.overheid.nl/wet-en-regelgeving).
• MijnOverheid (onderdeel van Logius) heeft passende technische en organisatorische beveiligingsmaatregelen getroffen tegen verlies of onrechtmatige 
verwerking van de persoonsgegevens van de gebruiker.
• De Berichtenbox app voldoet aan beveiligingsmaatregelen die vergelijkbaar zijn met de beveiligingsmaatregelen van de website van MijnOverheid. 
Ook maakt de Berichtenbox app gebruik van de veiligheidsmechanismen van het besturingssysteem.
• De gebruiker is zelf verantwoordelijk voor de beveiliging van zijn mobiele apparaat.
• Voor de Berichtenbox app kunnen zo nu en dan updates via de app-store worden gedownload en geïnstalleerd. Deze updates zijn bedoeld om de 
Berichtenbox app te verbeteren, uit te breiden of verder te ontwikkelen en kunnen bestaan uit oplossingen voor programmafouten, geavanceerde functies, 
nieuwe softwaremodules of volledige nieuwe versies. Zonder deze updates is het mogelijk dat de Berichtenbox app niet of niet behoorlijk functioneert.
• MijnOverheid (onderdeel van Logius) behoudt zich het recht voor zonder opgaaf van redenen het aanbieden van de Berichtenbox app in de app-store of de werking van de Berichtenbox app (tijdelijk) stop te zetten.

bluejetty:00093755:ios.description:
Think of WRTA Rider as a whole new way to get around Worcester County — a ridesharing service that’s smart, easy, and affordable.
 With a few taps, book an on-demand ride in the app, and our technology will pair you with other people headed your way. No detours, no delays.
How it works:
- Book a ride on your phone.
- Get picked up on a nearby corner.
- Share your ride with others.
- Save cash and reduce carbon emissions.
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our corner-to-corner algorithm matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
AFFORDABLE.
Aggregating people into one vehicle brings down prices. Enough said.
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make Worcester County a little bit greener and cleaner every time you ride.
Questions? Reach out at support-worcester@ridewithvia.com. 
Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating.

bluejetty:00046656:ios.description:
Looking for a reliable taxi in Montreal or Quebec? IMOOVE is your go-to taxi app for fast, affordable, and professional rides. Whether you need a ride on-demand or want to pre-schedule your taxi, we offer the most convenient solution for your travels.
Why Choose IMOOVE?
- Reliable and Professional Drivers: Whether you're booking a taxi in Montreal or Quebec, you can count on IMOOVE's skilled drivers to get you where you need to go safely and on time.
- Fast and Easy Booking : With IMOOVE, booking your next ride is quick and simple. Use our taxi app to easily reserve a taxi in Montreal or schedule your ride in advance with just a few taps.
- Real-Time Tracking: Stay informed with live updates on your driver's location and ETA.
- Affordable & Transparent Pricing : Get the best value for your rides with transparent pricing. No hidden fees—just fair rates for your Montreal taxi booking or Quebec taxi service.
- Airport Transfers Made Easy : Going to or from the airport? IMOOVE offers airport taxi Montreal services, ensuring a comfortable and stress-free journey every time.
- Convenient Ride-Sharing & VTC Services : Enjoy the flexibility of ride-hailing Montreal or ride-sharing Montreal services through our easy-to-use app. It's the smart way to travel across the city or for long-distance trips.
- 24/7 Availability : Need a ride at any time? IMOOVE is available around the clock, offering on-demand rides and pre-scheduled taxis to fit your schedule, whether you're traveling for business or leisure.
- Secure Payments: Pay effortlessly through the app with your favorite payment method.
Available Features:
- Reserve Your Ride in Advance
Take advantage of our reserve taxi Quebec feature and book your ride up to 90 days in advance—no booking fee! Ensure your Quebec taxi or taxi Montreal is ready when you need it.
- Live Ride Tracking
Track your taxi Montreal or Quebec taxi service in real-time with live updates. Stay informed about your driver’s arrival for a smooth, on-time experience.
Save Frequent Destinations
Save your frequent destinations for quicker access. Whether it’s your home, office, or a favorite spot in Montreal or Quebec, get to your destinations faster with IMOOVE.
- Rate Your Ride
Help us improve our service by rating your ride after each trip. Your feedback ensures that we maintain the best taxi service Montreal and provide top-quality experiences.
Whether it's a business meeting, a leisure outing, or a quick trip around town, IMOOVE delivers professional and efficient ride-sharing in Montreal and throughout Quebec.
Currently available in Montreal, Quebec City, Rive Sud, and Rive Nord.
Download IMOOVE today to enjoy the best of Quebec’s taxi and city ride services!

Ember's Credit Union is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Ember's Credit Union:
 -Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
 -Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
 -Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
 -Transfer money between your accounts
 -Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
 -Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
 -View and save your monthly statements
 -Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Ember's Credit Union app, you must be enrolled as a Ember's Credit Union Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00120184:ios.description:
**Over 5,000,000 Users Worldwide!!**
HiNative is a global Q&A community for language learners and people that are curious about the world.
Ask questions, get answers, and connect with native speakers from over 170 different countries!
FEATURES
Audio Uploads - Want to check your pronunciation? Curious about a certain region's accent? Need some handy phrases for your upcoming trip? Just record your questions and ask: let the world hear you!
Correction Function - Have your writing corrected by native speakers!When you post in your target language, native speakers will show you natural ways to say what you want to say.
You can receive corrections to your messages with friends, work emails, journal entries, speeches, etc.
Pictures - Not sure how to write something? No problem! It's easier to ask some questions by posting a picture: signs, menus, labels, and even that rad Chinese character you're considering getting a tattoo of--just snap a picture and ask away.
Unlike a dictionary or web search, HiNative gives you customized example sentences, responses to your follow-up questions, and tips to improve your pronunciation. With HiNative, you also get access to the best resource for language learning: native speakers. And as a native speaker yourself, you can help out too!
HiNative supports over 110 languages, bringing the entire world to your fingertips. It's never been this easy to connect, help, and learn. 
------
HiNative is run by the creators of Lang-8, one of the most successful and popular language learning websites around, with over a million users worldwide.
------
HiNative PREMIUM
Premium features include the following.
1: Play every voice answer, even those posted in response to other users' questions.　This gives you even more opportunity to hear native speakers pronounce the language you're learning.
2: Use bookmarks to gather your favorite questions and answers into a simple, searchable list. Never lose track of important questions.
3: Receive 10 Premium tickets per month to help your questions stand out. Questions asked with a ticket stick to the top of the question feed, get highlighted, and receive more answers on average.
4: Search. Everything's better with search. Search your old questions and bookmarks to find the information you want, faster.
5: Follow any question that you're interested in. You'll receive notifications when anyone responds to a question you follow. This makes it easier to stay up-to-date with the questions you really care about.
6: If a feature you want isn't listed above, email us at support@hinative.com, and we'll see what we can do :)
Payment information:
Premium Subscriptions cost $11.40 USD per month.
- Payment will be charged to a user's iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription will renew automatically unless Auto-Renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
- A user's account will be charged for the following month if their subscription is not cancelled 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and Auto-Renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- Subscriptions for the current month cannot be canceled.

bluejetty:00024527:ios.name: AirBeam Video Surveillance
bluejetty:00024527:ios.summary: AirBeam turns your iDevices into a realtime audio and video surveillance system. AirBeam streams live video and audio from the cameras and microphones of iPhones, iPods, iPads. You can watch the stream on any other iDevice, Mac, Web browser
bluejetty:00024527:ios.description:
AirBeam turns your iDevices into a realtime audio and video surveillance system. AirBeam streams live video and audio from the cameras and microphones of iPhones, iPods, iPads. You can watch the stream on any other iDevice, Mac, Web browser or AppleTV - even on multiple screens simultaneously.
Use your iDevices as luxury babyphones, for serious surveillance, to keep an eye on your pets, a FPV cam in your remote controlled toys…there are hundreds of useful and not so useful things you can do with it. Even if you have just a single device AirBeam is an awesome tool for motion controlled video recording.
AirBeams features in detail:
* High Quality Realtime: Watch video and hear audio on your remote device in amazing quality with resolution up to Full-HD 1080p, 30 frames per second and CD quality audio. Watch and hear in realtime thanks to AirBeam's low latency encoding and transmission technology.
* Zero Configuration: No need to manually configure device addresses. AirBeam automatically discovers all AirBeam cams on your network and you can instantly watch them.
* Multi Camera, Multi Monitor: Launch as many camera devices as you want and monitor them simultaneously. Or follow a single camera on multiple screens at the same time. On an iPad you can watch up to four cameras at a time.
* Recording: Seeing or hearing something on AirBeam you want to remember? Just press the record button and the video and audio will be recorded. You can also capture still images.
* Motion and audio detection: Trigger alarms or recordings when something happens in front of the camera to create a single track of events that happened during a day.
* Dropbox integration (requires iOS>=9): Uploads recordings directly to your Dropbox account.
* Web interface: Use a browser to watch (no audio in a browser) the live video, download your recordings or adjust the camera settings.
* Two-way audio: Audio streaming works both ways so that you can also talk through the camera device.
* Full remote control: Adjust all camera settings and access to your photo and video library remotely from the monitor device.
* Virtual reality mode: Render the video stream in stereo for watching with a virtual reality headset such as the FreeFlyVR orCardboard.
* Motrr Galileo supported: Remotely pan and tilt your iPhone camera when mounted in a Galileo robotic motion platform.
* AND COMPLETELY FOR FREE: AirBeam viewer app for Mac and AppleTV available in the Mac and AppleTV AppStore.
Important notes
=============
* Best video quality is achieved when AirBeam is used within a local WiFi network. With port forwarding configured in your WiFi router it is also possible to monitor AirBeam cameras on your WiFi at home from anywhere in the Internet. Do do this you need to configure a port forwarding for port 8123 in your WiFi router - see the FAQ pages on our homepage for more details. And check your data plan, live video over cellular consumes quite some bandwidth...
* Please consider regulations for video surveillance in your country.

bluejetty:00178049:ios.name: Bird Bed & Breakfast
bluejetty:00178049:ios.summary:

Get crafting, design your bed and breakfast tree, grow food in your garden, care for cute guests and earn 5 star ratings. As your rating goes up, you un
bluejetty:00178049:ios.description:
Welcome to BirdBnB! Care for cute birds as they visit your very own Bed and Breakfast!
Get crafting, design your bed and breakfast tree, grow food in your garden, care for cute guests and earn 5 star ratings. As your rating goes up, you unlock more rooms and attract more cute birds from all over the world. For some extra fun, switch into AR mode (Augmented Reality) and see your virtual pet friends appear in and around your own home!
Bird BnB is the only game where the birds are more than just virtual pets...every one is based on a real species, with accurate wing patterns and bird songs!
If you love bird games, cute games, caring for virtual pets or playing in AR / Augmented Reality, you will love Bird BnB.
Highlights!
● Build your own Bed and Breakfast in a peaceful tree environment. Choose from all kinds of theming and colours for your tree and garden - change the leaves and bark between seasons and themes!
● Grow a garden around your tree to make breakfast for your guests and use your design skills to decorate your tree with what they need - working your way towards that elusive 5 star rating.
● Practice your garden design by choosing which plants to grow around your tree - purple berries? White fairy mushrooms? You’ll want your tree and garden to look it’s best, but you also need to grow the right garden food to feed your guests!
● The higher your rating, the more types of birds will fly in for you to care for and collect in your hotel visitors book! Collect visitor book entries from Lovebirds, Parrots, Robins and more.
● Play fun mini bird games in between caring for bird guests! The mini-games are full of cute games like cleaning nests and other garden games.
● Meet V.I.B.s (very important birds) with unique names and funny backstories. People who love cute animal games will love the backstories of these characters!
● If you want to experience a magical moment in augmented reality / AR with your friends, switch to AR and see your birds hopping around right in front of you, wherever you may be! Can you take a photo of your virtual pet with one of your real-life pets?
Bird BnB is FREE TO PLAY, with optional in-game items for purchase. You can turn off the payment feature by disabling in-app purchases in your device’s settings. Bird BnB will prompt you to allow access to your photos, media, and files. This is to use the in-game snapshot feature to save virtual pet images to your device, or share them with your friends if they like bird games too!
The Runaway Play team sincerely hope that you will love this game as much as we do. If you run into any issues while playing or you have any suggestions, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at support@runaway.zendesk.com.

bluejetty:00143759:ios.description:
Slyder is a lightweight keyboard built around gestures — slide anywhere to move the cursor, drag the delete key to erase and undo, and keep the tools you actually use one tap above the keys.
TYPE IN 38 LANGUAGES
Japanese かな 12-key flick and ローマ字 with kana→kanji conversion. Chinese 简体拼音 and 注音. Arabic, Hebrew, Persian and Urdu with full right-to-left layouts. Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Thai, Greek, Korean, English and many more — every one with the same gestures.
GESTURES THAT SAVE TAPS
- Slide anywhere on the keys to move the cursor, letter by letter
- Drag the space bar to move word by word
- Drag delete left to erase, right to bring it back
- Swipe down to dismiss, swipe up for the number row
MAKE IT YOURS
- Themes matched to your iPhone color, or a gradient you build yourself
- Choose the font your keys are drawn in
- An extra row of favorites — buttons, phrases, links, folders
- Adjustable keyboard height
TOOLS BUILT IN
- Clipboard history and a one-tap paste button
- Emoji and emoticon suggestions that learn as you type
- Cool Fonts and Fun Text
- Generative AI with web search
- Insights into how you type
iCLOUD BACKUP
Settings, folders, colors, clipboard, emoji and stats back up to your own iCloud and restore onto a new iPhone in one tap.
ON iPAD
A native iPad layout with a full number row and Apple-parity key sizing.

bluejetty:00023342:ios.description:
This is it. I guess it's the end of your life. Did you achieve everything you wanted? What would you do if you had another chance?
I can't bring you back... but what if I could bring you to an isekai, a medieval land full of powerful heroes and dominating factions competing for supremacy? Will you assemble your allies and climb the ranks with your keen tactics? The riches and beauty await, will you answer the call of the isekai?
[Every Lord Starts Somewhere]
In a world governed by superstition and fear, build a stronghold utilizing your advanced scientific knowledge and strategic insight to conquer ignorance and opposition. Assemble your team to help manage the operations on the home front and enjoy the rewards of a productive economy with just one click!
[Oaths of the Sword]
Might isn't always right, win the heart and loyalty of your followers with your charisma and intellect. Level up your heroes and train your troops automatically so that you may overcome all opposition and conquer the world! 
[Destined Encounters]
Elves, beastians, fairies, demons, and even goddesses... What kind of sparks will you encounter on your journey? Create your own fantasy stories with different consorts and discover the joy of parenthood surrounded by your offspring.
[The Enemy of My Enemy]
Build alliance with like-minded travelers and fight against your common enemy. Establish closer ties with your allies through an intricate web of marriages between your heirs/heiress and theirs, which will bring you a great bonus! You don't have to fight your enemies all alone by yourself!
Enjoy your personal fantasia in another world full of original, gripping stories with wild imagination!
Follow our Facebook for updates: https://www.facebook.com/refantasia.game
 Join our Discord to communicate with other travelers:
 https://discord.gg/qkhndHdtZJ
 If you have any questions in Refantasia, please contact us:
 rf-service@nata-sky.com

bluejetty:00078185:ios.description:
Welcome to Perfect Body, your personalized, flexible weight loss and wellness app. Achieve your goals confidently with custom meal plans, adaptive workouts, daily challenges, and real-time progress tracking tailored just for you. Embrace healthy habits and see sustainable results with support every step of the way.
PERSONALIZED MEAL PLANS
Select the diet that fits your lifestyle best, with options like vegetarian, Mediterranean, keto, low-carb, balanced, and more. Perfect Body provides a meal plan that evolves with your progress to ensure you're getting the nutrients you need for safe, effective weight loss.
DELICIOUS, EASY RECIPES
Explore over 1,000 nutritious, easy-to-make recipes designed to keep you satisfied and energized. Every recipe is created around your chosen meal plan and dietary preferences, so healthy eating feels enjoyable and sustainable.
ADAPTIVE WORKOUTS AT HOME (Paid Feature)
Additionally, to accelerate your metabolism and boost your results, you'll be able to add a personalized workout plan that offers simple, yet very effective exercise routines. These routines won't require additional equipment, so you can easily complete them at the comfort of your home.
DAILY CHALLENGES FOR HABIT-BUILDING
Enhance your wellness journey with daily challenges that support mindful eating, exercise, and healthy habits. These challenges are crafted to make it easier to build long-lasting, positive changes for a healthier lifestyle.
PROGRESS TRACKING & MINDFUL HABITS
Track your mood, sleep, water intake, and more with confidence-building tools that help you set goals and follow your journey to a healthier self.
24/7 SUPPORT & MOTIVATION
Perfect Body offers 24/7 guidance, keeping you motivated whether you're just starting or fine-tuning your routine.
HEALTHKIT INTEGRATION
Sync with HealthKit to track steps and calories burned, giving you a complete picture of your health progress.
HOW IT WORKS?
> Subscribe to Perfect Body to unlock your personalized weight loss program..
> Set your goals and select your ideal diet style to receive a custom meal plan.
> Follow easy recipes and complete daily wellness challenges to build healthy habits.
> Monitor your journey with progress tracking tools and HealthKit integration.
> Boost results with at-home workout routines and round-the-clock motivation support.
Take control of your wellness journey with Perfect Body. Download today and start building a healthier, more confident you!
Terms and Conditions: https://perfectbody.me/general-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://perfectbody.me/privacy-policy
Disclaimer: Perfect Body does not provide medical advices, diagnoses, or treatment. Always consult your doctor or healthcare provider before starting making changes to your diet, or making any medical decisions.

bluejetty:00079430:ios.name: AI Baby Cry Analyzer
bluejetty:00079430:ios.summary:
Small moments make a big picture. Keep your baby’s care together, from a late-night feed to the things that helped them settle.
LISTEN WITH CARE
Record 3 to 12 seconds and choose whether to upload. AI suggests likely everyday reasons, such
bluejetty:00079430:ios.description:
Small moments make a big picture. Keep your baby’s care together, from a late-night feed to the things that helped them settle.
LISTEN WITH CARE
Record 3 to 12 seconds and choose whether to upload. AI suggests likely everyday reasons, such as hunger, tiredness, discomfort or wanting comfort, with a plain-language likelihood and a practical care step. These are uncertain possibilities, not measured probabilities or a diagnosis. Check your baby’s cues and seek medical help for urgent warning signs; never wait for an analysis.
REMEMBER THE DAY
Track feeds, sleep, diapers, pumping, medicine, growth and milestones. Use timers, search your notes, correct entries and keep separate profiles for each baby. Turn a quick spoken or written note into suggested entries, then review and save each one yourself.
CARE TOGETHER
Share a journal with invited caregivers, review recorded patterns and export a handoff as PDF, CSV or JSON. Keep measurements and milestones together, with optional WHO or CDC growth references.
MAKE ROOM FOR REST
Play offline settling sounds with a stop timer and create daily care reminders. The journal, timers, sounds, profiles and safety guidance remain useful without a subscription.
YOUR CHOICES MATTER
AI uploads require your consent. Manage sharing, export your data or request deletion in the app. Analytics and crash reporting are optional and off by default. AI and shared sync need an internet connection.
Care Plus is an optional auto-renewing subscription for additional AI use. Limits apply; prices and terms appear before purchase. Manage or cancel your subscription in your store account.
This app supports everyday record keeping. It is not a medical device or a substitute for professional care. If you are worried about your baby, seek medical advice.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://baby-cry-analyzer-flutter-z2sp.hasan552529.workers.dev/p/baby-cry-analyzer-flutter/privacy

“You are the butter to my bread, and the breath to my life.”
The name “ButterCam” is inspired by a line from the movie “Julie & Julia.” Just like butter on bread, it isn't merely for filling the stomach. The Butter Camera app aims to provide creators with the same sense of aesthetic in the process of creation, so beauty isn't just in the result：It is hovering in the air, in every breath of every second in the life.
1. A new 'camera' function for better shots!
With a plethora of analogue cameras, equipped with simulated effects inspired by cameras and films such as Kodak, Fuji, CCD, and others, this camera allows you to experience the joy of shooting while also capturing excellent colour and texture.
2. Avast array of templates is available, making one-click photo editing incredibly convenient. 
ButterCam comes with a vast collection of templates for posters, portraits, food,scenery, festivals, cute pets, babies... With just one click, you can apply them and eliminate the hassle of design and layout.
3. Exclusive font library and signature text templates like no other.
Original fonts such as “Huangyou Tangxin Font” and “Huangyou Shisan Font ” are only available on ButterCam. With over a hundred licensed fonts ranging from cute to minimalist style, covering Chinese,English,Japanese, and Korean. Each font is carefully selected by professional designers . There are also various text templates styles suitable for different Vlog and Plog scenarios.
4. A wealth of sticker and filter.
Whether original stickers or hit IP—whatever style you desire. It's here, with new arrivals waiting for you every week. Various practical and fun filter are also provided and catered to make all your photo editing wishes come true!

أصدر بطاقة ماستر كارد الافتراضية وتحويل الأموال إلى المحافظ الإلكترونية والبنوك المحلية، كل ذلك عبر واجهة بسيطة وآمنة. احصل على إشعارات فورية لكل حركة في حسابك واستمتع بمرونة إدارة حساباتك أينما كنت.

مميزات التطبيق:
- شراء وبيع وتحويل الذهب.
- تحويل الأموال بين حساباتك البنكية.
- سداد الفواتير وشحن رصيد الهاتف.
- متابعة الرصيد والمعاملات المصرفية بسهولة.
- معرفة أسعار صرف العملات الأجنبية مقابل الريال اليمني.
- معرفة أسعار الذهب في السوق اليمني أول بأول.
- أرسل واستلم حوالة واصل لكل المحافظ الإلكترونية في اليمن (محفظة فلوسك، محفظة جوالي،  محفظة ون كاش)
- حماية وأمان عالٍ.

قم بتنزيل "بنكي" الآن وافتح حسابك مجاناً ومن مكانك واستمتع بأفضل خدمة بنكية لإدارة حساباتك

bluejetty:00160313:ios.name: Reverse Image Search – RIMG
bluejetty:00160313:ios.summary: RIMG lets you perform reverse image search for free. Simply upload or select an image to discover useful information, similar images, original sources, products, people, and more across popular reverse image search engines, including Google
bluejetty:00160313:ios.description:
RIMG lets you perform reverse image search for free. Simply upload or select an image to discover useful information, similar images, original sources, products, people, and more across popular reverse image search engines, including Google, Bing, Yandex, and Lenso.ai. Use it to spot potential catfishes, identify plants, jewelry, coins, and products, find original artists and image sources, discover better deals, verify photos, and explore anything you see online. With fast and convenient image search, finding answers from a picture has never been easier.
Some features:
– Search using images instead of keywords
– View and compare results from multiple search engines
– Fast, lightweight, and privacy-friendly
To begin your search, you can select an image in multiple ways—you can choose one from your photo gallery, import it from a URL, or paste it from your clipboard. You can also take a picture directly within the app and perform a reverse search.
By using RIMG, you can identify various objects, including people’s faces, clothing items, monuments, plants, and more. A handy feature in the app allows you to take a picture of what’s right in front of you and find relevant information based on the image. When using this feature for the first time, the app will request access to your camera. The camera is accessed only when you need to take a picture for a reverse image search and is not used for any other purpose.
On the results page, you can switch between search engines to find the most relevant results. The accuracy of any reverse image search service may vary depending on the image you input and the search engine you use. With multiple search engines integrated into one app, you can explore their results and dig deeper into the information they retrieve from across the web.
Try RIMG today and discover more information about that picture you’re curious about. If you find the app useful, please share it with your friends and family.
By downloading and using this app, you acknowledge that you have read and accepted the terms and privacy policy as outlined on the following pages.
Terms of service: https://rimg.us/docs/terms.html
Privacy policy: https://rimg.us/docs/privacy.html

bluejetty:00087864:ios.description:
Run in the real world. Become a hero in another.
Zombies, Run! is the world’s most popular smartphone fitness game — over 10 million runners, a 4.8-star rating, and 500+ missions across 11 seasons and counting, co-created by award-winning novelist Naomi Alderman.
Every run becomes a mission. You’re Runner 5, and through your headphones the story unfolds: rescue survivors, gather supplies, outrun the horde, and uncover the truth about the zombie apocalypse. It’s so much fun you’ll forget you’re working out.

• Your music, your soundtrack. The story weaves between tracks from your own playlists.

Try Zombies, Run! for free, or subscribe to unlock every mission.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed in your App Store account settings.

bluejetty:00186065:ios.description:
Recognized as a 2025 Pick by NYT Wirecutter
Featured as a 2026 pick for the App Store “App of the Day”
Thousands worldwide call Waking Up life changing. Whether you want better sleep, more clarity, or deeper meditation, Waking Up is your complete guide.
Testimonials
“Waking Up has led to my most consistent meditation practice. Family and staff also use it because it’s such a powerful tool.” —Andrew Huberman, neuroscientist
“Waking Up is a critical part of my daily practice. It’s my go-to for presence, peace, and well-being.” —Rich Roll, athlete & author
“If you’ve had trouble getting into meditation, this app is your answer!” —Susan Cain, best-selling author
What’s Inside
- Introductory Course—a transformative 28-day program, for both beginners and experienced meditators
- Daily Meditations—regular guided sessions with Sam Harris
- Daily Quotes—a spark of insight each day
- Daily Wisdom—brief lessons that shift perspective
- Moment—short reflections when you need them most
- Sleep—talks and meditations to help you rest
- Meditation Timer—customize your own sessions
- A vast library of meditations, theory sessions, life courses, conversations, and Q&As
- Community—connect with members to discuss meditation, philosophy, psychedelics, and more
- CarPlay—listen to select sessions and conversations while you drive.
Why Waking Up Stands Out
Unlike conventional meditation apps, Waking Up blends practice with theory—so you not only learn to meditate but also understand how it transforms your mind. It’s meditation, science, and timeless wisdom in one place.
Topics & Techniques
Our library combines contemplative traditions with modern science, offering tools for both practice and understanding. Techniques include mindfulness (Vipassana), Loving-Kindness, body scans, yoga nidra, and nondual awareness practices from Dzogchen, Zen, and Advaita Vedanta. Topics span neuroscience, psychology, Stoicism, ethics, psychedelics, productivity, and happiness.
Content & Teachers
Created by neuroscientist and best-selling author Sam Harris, Waking Up features leading voices in meditation, philosophy, and psychology. 
- Practice—Vipassana, Zen, Dzogchen, Advaita Vedanta (Joseph Goldstein, Diana Winston, Adyashanti, Henry Shukman, Richard Lang)
- Theory—the philosophy and science of consciousness, ethics, and well-being (Alan Watts, Charlotte Joko Beck, Joan Tollifson, James Low, Douglas Harding)
- Life—mindfulness in relationships, productivity, Stoicism, and more (David Whyte, Oliver Burkeman, Matthew Walker, Amanda Knox, Donald Robertson, Bob Waldinger)
- Conversations—Sam Harris with Yuval Noah Harari, Michael Pollan, Morgan Housel, Roland Griffiths, Cal Newport, Shinzen Young
- Q&As—Sam Harris with Joseph Goldstein, Adyashanti, Henry Shukman, Jack Kornfield, Loch Kelly
And many more subjects and teachers.
Created by Sam Harris
Neuroscientist and best-selling author Sam Harris built Waking Up as the resource he wished he’d had when he began meditating 30 years ago. Every practice, course, and teacher is chosen for its power to change lives.
Free for Anyone Who Can’t Afford It
We never want money to be the reason someone can’t benefit from our app. To learn about our scholarship program, reach out to support@wakingup.com.
Subscriptions renew unless auto-renew is disabled 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage in Apple account settings. Payment charged to your Apple account.
Terms: https://wakingup.com/terms-of-service/
Privacy: https://wakingup.com/privacy-policy/
Satisfaction guarantee: Email support@wakingup.com for a full refund.

bluejetty:00182515:ios.description:
Met de aangifte-app kunt u vanaf 1 maart uw aangifte inkomstenbelasting 2025 doen. 
U haalt met uw DigiD uw gegevens op. Daarna controleert u ze. Klopt alles? Dan kunt u uw aangifte meteen ondertekenen en verzenden.
De Aangifte app is alleen te gebruiken in combinatie met de DigiD app. De DigiD app moet op hetzelfde apparaat staan en u gebruikt de pincode van de DigD app om de Aangifte app te openen.
Doet u aangifte met een fiscale partner? Dan heeft uw partner ook de DigiD app nodig op zijn of haar eigen apparaat.
Kijk eerst of u wel aangifte kunt doen met de app. 
Die kans is groot als u vorig jaar niets hoefde te wijzigen of aan te vullen, en als uw situatie niet is veranderd. 
U kunt de aangifte-app niet gebruiken als u:
- niet het hele jaar dezelfde fiscale partner had
- uw woning hebt gekocht of verkocht en daardoor aftrekbare kosten had
- een restschuld voor een vroegere eigen woning had
- uw woning tijdelijk verhuurde, bijvoorbeeld via Airbnb
- een onderneming had
- aandeel in een onverdeelde erfenis had
- inkomsten uit overig werk had
- in het buitenland woonde
- een buitenlandse bankrekening had (bijvoorbeeld omdat u in cryptovaluta handelde)
- inkomsten uit het buitenland had
- bezittingen in het buitenland had
- co-ouder was, en uw minderjarige kind niet op uw adres ingeschreven stond 
- aftrekposten had, zoals giften, zorgkosten of studiekosten
Let op! 
Als u inkomen in box 3 had kunt u met deze app niet uw werkelijk rendement doorgeven. De app houdt alleen rekening met het fictief rendement.
Kunt u de app niet gebruiken? Vul dan onze online aangifte in. Kijk voor meer informatie of om direct aangifte te doen op belastingdienst.nl/aangifte.

bluejetty:00024528:ios.name: DroneXR - FPV for DJI drones
bluejetty:00024528:ios.summary: With DroneXR (former DroneVR ;-) you can take a seat in your drone and fly like a bird. DroneXR connects your phone with the drone and renders the live video stream in stereo with high-quality lens distortion correction, so that it can be v
bluejetty:00024528:ios.description:
With DroneXR (former DroneVR ;-) you can take a seat in your drone and fly like a bird. DroneXR connects your phone with the drone and renders the live video stream in stereo with high-quality lens distortion correction, so that it can be viewed with a virtual reality headset.
Important: The free version of DroneXR supports the Ryze Tello drone. Support for DJI drones can be activated via in-app purchase. See below for a list of supported drones.
DroneXR's features:
==============
* Beautiful, configurable user interface supporting dark and light mode.
* Two different head-up displays to overlay telemetry data such as heading, speed and altitude onto the camera view in real time.
* Comprehensive head-up menu to control all drone and camera settings while flying.
* Phone camera view and mini-map to see what's happening around you and stay oriented.
* Head tracking to control the orientation of the drone camera by moving your head! With the DJI Mavic/Phantom/Spark series, head tracking controls the camera pitch. With the DJI Inspire 1/Mavic 2/Mavic Air 2, head tracking works across all three axes.
* Detailed flight logging of flight path, telemetry data and events. Flight logs can be synchronized with your Mac via iCloud or file sharing.
* Spectator mode to link multiple phones and fly together with friends.
* Mono or stereo rendering of the drone video. Stereo rendering uses advanced lens distortion correction for high image quality.
* Highly adjustable to different VR headsets.
* High-definition video: 720p at 30 frames per second with Spark/Phantom 3/Phantom 4/Inspire 1, and up to 1080p with Mavic Pro/Mavic 2.
* Voice control for hands-free operation.
* Supported drones: Ryze Tello (free); via in-app purchase: Mavic Pro, Mavic 2 Pro/Zoom, DJI Mini/Mini 2/Mini SE, Mavic Air/Air 2/Air 2S, Spark, Phantom 4/4 Pro/4 Advanced, Phantom 3 Professional/Advanced/Standard/4K, Inspire 1.
Important notes:
============
* To use DroneXR you need one of the drones listed above.
* To control the Ryze Tello drone you need to connect a gamepad to your phone.
* To use DroneXR in stereo mode you need a virtual reality headset that holds your iPhone (e.g. Homido, FreeFly VR, Zeiss VR One, Cardboard). A high-resolution iPhone with a screen size of at least 5.5 inches is recommended. More information about recommended headsets can be found on our website: https://dronexr.de
