Tools combine top-level evidence and expert opinion from world-renowned psychiatrists with primary care expertise from one of the nation’s premier family medicine training programs.
This resource is ideal for primary care clinicians, including physicians, nurse practitioners, and physician assistants, as well as integrated behavioral health providers. 
The tools succinctly reflect standard and advanced primary care mental health practices and psychopharmacology for:
• Adult
• Pediatric & Adolescent
• Geriatric
• Perinatal and Women’s Mental Health
• Substance Use Disorders
Special Population considerations offering individually tailored pharmacotherapy recommendations include:
• Obesity
• Cardiac Impairment
• Renal Impairment
• Hepatic Impairment
• Geriatric
Why use The Waco Guide?
• High-yield, evidence-based psychopharmacology
• In office usability at the point-of-care to enhance medical decision making
• Common language and framework for integrated and collaborative care practices
• Tools account for cost and medication availability
• Titration schedules, monitoring recommendations, and a list of side effects accompany each tool

bluejetty:00151422:android.description:
Play together with your friends and other players from your PC or Mobile. Choose a profession and craft epic items starting at level 10, fight raid bosses in global server events that occurs 4x a day. Fight other players in a fast paced action PVP combat and explore a beautiful fantasy open-world.
🖥 CROSS-PLATFORM
- Eternal Quest is a cross-platform MMO and you can play on mobile or PC using the same account on the same server as everyone.
🏴CREATE OR JOIN GUILDS
- You can create your own guild to make the game even more fun and play together then.
⚔️TVT (TEAM VS TEAM)
- Eternal Quest has a competitive event every 3 hours and players are separated in 2 teams (red and blue) to fight and get rewards.
👾RAID BOSSES
- A random boss will respawn 4x every day and everyone online can join the battle against it.
🏹 TRAINING AND ATTRIBUTES
- You can choose between three training modes: EXP Focused, Balanced and AXP Focused
- If you want to evolve your base level, you can focus only in EXP, that means 100% of monsters EXP will be used directly on your character's level
- If you want to evolve your attributes, you can focus only in AXP (Attribute XP), that means 100% of monsters EXP will be used on your character's attributes, like Power, Toughness, Agility, Precision and Vitality
- And If you want to evolve both, you can choose the balanced mode, where 50% of monsters EXP will be used on your base level and the other 50% will be used on attributes
⚔️ PVP AND PK
- Fight other players starting at level 25. The game have different area types, some are PVE and other are PVP that allows players to start a fight between theirselves.
- Any unjustified kill, the player will get a "PK" status and will need to reduce some karma points by killing monsters in order to remove it.
- After 7 unjustified kills, the player will get a "Outlaw" status and will need to do a redemption quest in order to remove it.
🛡 CRAFT AND PROFESSIONS
- At level 10 you can choose a profession to start your crafting journey.
- The profession are: Blacksmith, Armorsmith and Alchemist
- Blacksmith can forge weapons, shields and ammunitions 
- Armorsmith can create all armor pieces for all classes
- Alchemist can create magic items and scrolls, normally used to upgrade items and enchant skills
🌪 LEARN AND ENCHANT SKILLS
- Learn new skills p

bluejetty:00024868:ios.summary:
Have you ever faced a difficult decision? Whether you're thinking about changing jobs, choosing your next vacation destination, or tackling a major life choice, the rule is simple: don't rush. Take your time and evaluate each option.
Pros-
bluejetty:00024868:ios.description:
Have you ever faced a difficult decision? Whether you're thinking about changing jobs, choosing your next vacation destination, or tackling a major life choice, the rule is simple: don't rush. Take your time and evaluate each option.
Pros-Cons is the ultimate app to help you navigate life's dilemmas. It won't make decisions for you, but it will give you the tools to always make the best choice.
What you can do:
• Create classic pros and cons lists to analyze a single choice, or compare two options (e.g., Sicily vs. Sardinia) to see which one wins.
• Assign a weight to each point to reflect its true importance and get a weighted result.
• Invite friends or colleagues to contribute their viewpoints for a 360-degree perspective.
• Custom Colors: In comparison mode, personalize each option with its own color for a clearer and more visual overview of your choices.
DISCOVER YOUR PERSONAL AI ADVISOR
With version 6.0, Pros-Cons evolves. Our artificial intelligence becomes your strategic ally:
• Intelligent Analysis: Don't settle for a simple percentage. Our AI analyzes your points and provides you with in-depth and "human" textual feedback, suggesting new perspectives you hadn't considered.
• Never Blocked Again: Writer's block? The AI assistant can generate a list of consistent pros and cons for you to unlock your crisis and give you a solid starting point, which you can modify as you wish.
• Create from Text: Simply describe your dilemma in your own words — like "I can't decide whether to buy a bigger house now that I earn more" — and the app will create a structured decision for you automatically.
• Create with Siri: With an AI plan, you can create a new decision directly through Siri — describe your dilemma out loud and let the app do the rest, without even opening it. The app is now also fully compatible with Apple Shortcuts.
GROW YOUR DECISION-MAKING SKILLS
• Daily Tips: A new Tips section explores cognitive biases and daily decision-making insights to help you make smarter choices. A new tip unlocks every day — a great reason to open the app daily. Each tip can be easily shared on social media or sent to friends and colleagues.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO DECIDE
• Centralize Everything: Add files, images, and links directly to your decisions. Perfect for complex choices requiring documents and research, to be managed alone or as a team.
• Export and Share: Save your complete analyses in PDF or Excel format to share, print, or simply archive them.
• Intuitive Design: Simple, efficient, and easy to use, so you can focus on what matters: your decision.
DECIDE ALONE OR WITH OTHERS
• Shared Decisions: You're not alone in your choices. Invite friends, colleagues, or your partner to collaborate on a decision via a simple link or QR code.
• Teamwork: Collaborators can add and modify pros and cons, view existing files and upload new ones, making Pros-Cons the perfect tool for group decisions, both personal and professional.
Make your next smart choice. Download Pros-Cons and take control of your decisions, powered by artificial intelligence!

bluejetty:00123893:ios.summary: Gin Rummy is two-player card game created in 1909. It is played with standard 52-card deck. Each player takes turns drawing from either the deck or discard pile, then discarding one card from their hand. A player's cards are grouped in two
bluejetty:00123893:ios.description:
Gin Rummy is two-player card game created in 1909. It is played with standard 52-card deck. Each player takes turns drawing from either the deck or discard pile, then discarding one card from their hand. A player's cards are grouped in two categories: melds and deadwood. Melds are combinations of three or more cards consisting of a straight (3 cards in a sequence of the same suit) of 3 or 4 of a kind (eg: 3 Aces). Any card in a player's hand that is not a part of a meld counted as deadwood. Your Deadwood count is determined by the sum of the face values of your deadwood (J/Q/K are all 10 points). 
Each player takes turns picking up and discarding cards until one player "knocks". A player can only knock when their Deadwood count is below 10 (for Regular Gin Rummy). Then both player's cards are revealed for the layoff. Points are awarded to the player with the least Deadwood. Bonus points are awarded for having a deadwood of 0 (Gin). 
The Deal
- The dealer alternates between players from hand to hand. The first dealer is picked at random at the start of the game. The dealer deals 10 cards to each player, then reveals the 21st card and moves it to the top of the discard pile. 
- The non-dealing player has the first option of taking the first discard. If the player doesn't want the card, he can choose to Pass, giving the dealer a change to take it. 
Game Play
- Each turn involves players drawing then discarding a card. The player must first draw a card from either the discard pile or the deck. The player will then either go Gin or discard one of his card to the discard pile. 
- Player takes turn until one of the player either goes gin or knock
Knocking
- A player can knock once his deadwood count is less than or equal to 10 after the discard. The option to knock must be selected before discarding the card and will only be made available if a knock is possible. A player may also go Gin. A Gin is hand which contains only melds, no deadwood. A Big Gin is and 11-card Gin Determines the deadwood needed to knock. The card is an Ace, the players must go Gin to end the hand. In Straight mode, all hands are played to either Gin of Big Gin.
Layoffs
- If a player knocks and does not go Gin, The opposing player gets a chance to remove some of their deadwood before scores are counted. Cards that can be added to the knocking player's melds are not counted as deadwood. 
Scoring
- The winner of the hand is the player with the lowest deadwood count after Layoffs. That player earns the difference between the two deadwoods. Bonuses can also be earned for going Gin and for an Undercut. In Oklahoma, if the upturn card is a Spade, the hands points and bonuses count as double.
- Aces are worth 1 point, figures (J, Q, K) are worth 10, and other cards are worth their numerical value. In Oklahoma, if the upturn card is a Spade, the hand's points and bonus count as double. 
Undercut
- An undercut occurs when the knocking player loses the hand. If the opponent has a lower deadwood count, before or after layoffs, that player wins the hand and earns an undercut bonus of 25 points.
- An undercut occurs when the defending player has a deadwood count lower that or equal to the knocking player.
Features:
- Multi-language: Supports Hindi, English and Gujarati languages.
- Beautiful UI and amazing sound effects, to provide you an extraordinary experience.
- Automatic card arranging, which gives your more freedom to think.
- Smart drag and drop.
Disclaimer: Gin Rummy Offline is an offline card game

The option to knock must be selected before discarding the card and will only be made available if a knock is possible. A player may also go Gin. A Gin is hand which contains only melds, no deadwood. A Big Gin is and 11-card Gin Determines the deadwood needed to knock. The card is an Ace, the players must go Gin to end the hand. In Straight mode, all hands are played to either Gin of Big Gin.

Layoffs
- If a player knocks and does not go Gin, The opposing player gets a chance to remove some of their deadwood before scores are counted. Cards that can be added to the knocking player's melds are not counted as deadwood. 

Scoring
- The winner of the hand is the player with the lowest deadwood count after Layoffs. That player earns the difference between the two deadwoods. Bonuses can also be earned for going Gin and for an Undercut. In Oklahoma, if the upturn card is a Spade, the hands points and bonuses count as double.
- Aces are worth 1 point, figures (J, Q, K) are worth 10, and other cards are worth their numerical value. In Oklahoma, if the upturn card is a Spade, the hand's points and bonus count as double. 

Undercut
- An undercut occurs when the knocking player loses the hand. If the opponent has a lower deadwood count, before or after layoffs, that player wins the hand and earns an undercut bonus of 25 points.
- An undercut occurs when the defending player has a deadwood count lower that or equal to the knocking player.

Features:
- Multi-language: Supports Hindi, English and Gujarati languages.
- Beautiful UI and amazing sound effects, to provide you an extraordinary experience.
- Automatic card arranging, which gives your more freedom to think.
- Smart drag and drop.

Disclaimer: Gin Rummy Offline is an offline card game

bluejetty:00142603:ios.description:
Delivering Grocery, Fruits & Vegetables, Milk every day morning at your doorstep by 7AM.
Trusted by 10mn+ people across Mumbai, Delhi, NCR, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, and now delivering to all the major cities, our products are an integral part of families looking to cut out preservatives and adulterants from their every day grocery.
Our Preservatives-Free Cow and Buffalo Milk continue to be the most ordered and most recommended products since we started in 2015. Loved for their purity, consistency, and delightful aroma, our milk products are enjoyed by even kids and grandparents! 
Another one of our most ordered products, Country Coconut Water, is a trimmed-top tender coconut sourced from Pollachi. These Pollachi sourced ‘nuts bring you approximately 300ml water every time, and assured sweet, nutty flavour.
We also offer other delightful grocery items like Taaza Paneer, Ghar Jaisa Dahi, Mishti Doi, Taaza Pudina Chaach. Added to that, we are now delivering Fresh Fruits and Vegetables in selected cities. 
Like our flagship Milk and Desi Danedar Ghee, these products too are free of any middlemen intervention, chemical washing, and are delivered through an extensively monitored, advanced cold-chain system.
How does Country Delight deliver direct from the farm?
We engage directly with dairy farmers within 100kms radius of your city to procure fresh Cow and Buffalo milk twice every day. We don’t recombine or overprocess our milk or any other grocery items in our range. After checking its quality over 72 parameters, including synthetic hormones, antibiotics, and naturally occuring toxins, we pasteurise all Milk for safety, and we are delivering it to your homes within just 18-24 hours of collection. Our direct-from-farm and in-house delivery partners help us make your life easier. 
How to receive my order daily?
You can place or modify your order till 12 midnight for Milk and other dairy items. For Grocery fresh fruits and vegetables delivery, the daily cut-off ranges from 10pm to 12pm depending on your location. Our excellent delivery team will place your order at your doorstep. Just open your door to Fresh Milk, Milk Products, Fruits and vegetables anytime after 7 AM. 
It is also easy to get our Milk or fruits and vegetables every day by creating a subscription plan for these essential groceries. Our customizable subscription plan makes life easier in more ways than one. It empowers you to get fresh milk every day while also giving you a transparent view of your monthly spends on groceries. This regular flow of farm-sourced essentials, combined with the flexibility to modify or add more products till midnight, will make consuming clean, healthy, tasty products every day very easy. 
How much time does Country Delight take to deliver?
We take less than 12 hours to deliver fresh, adulteration-tested, FSSAI certified products to your doorstep. To receive Country Delight Milk, place your order anytime till 12 midnight and get assured doorstep delivery by 7AM next morning. We also deliver our newly launched fruits and vegetables range early morning before you start your day. 
Experience the goodness of farm-fresh, chemical-free grocery delivered every day. 
To know more about our products, download our app. Claim your Rs. 100 Cashback and give our products a try.

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/CountryDelightNatural/

bluejetty:00161802:ios.description:
ỨNG DỤNG ÔN THI 600 CÂU HỎI MỚI NHẤT 2026 CỦA CỤC CSGT
[Update mới nhất 2026]
Sử dụng ôn thi lý thuyết GPLX tất cả các hạng Ô TÔ VÀ XE MÁY (MÔ TÔ)
* Ứng dụng Ôn thi lý thuyết GPLX cập nhật đầy đủ 600 câu hỏi và cấu trúc đề thi sử dụng cho đào tạo, sát hạch phần thi lý thuyết GPLX cho 15 hạng GPLX ô tô và xe máy (otomoto)
* Sử dụng ôn thi lý thuyết cho tất cả 15 hạng bằng GPLX:
 - Xe máy A1, A, B1
 - Các hạng GPLX ô tô: B, C1, C, D1, D2, D 
 - Các hạng BE, C1E, CE, D1E, D2E, DE
* Hỗ trợ ôn thi giấy phép lái xe - bằng lái xe, ô tô xe máy với tất cả các hạng GPLX:
- 600 câu hỏi lý thuyết GPLX hạng B, C1, C, D1, D2, D, BE, C1E, CE, D1E, D2E, DE (trong đó có 60 câu điểm liệt)
- 250 câu hỏi lý thuyết GPLX hạng A1 và hạng A (trong đó có 10 câu điểm liệt)
- 300 câu hỏi lý thuyết GPLX hạng B1 (trong đó có 20 câu điểm liệt)
* Bộ 600 câu hỏi được chia thành 6 chương: 
 - Chương 1: Gồm 180 câu về Quy định chung và quy tắc giao thông đường bộ (từ câu số 1 đến câu số 180).
 - Chương 2: Gồm 25 câu về Văn hóa giao thông, đạo đức người lái xe, kỹ năng phòng cháy, chữa cháy và cứu hộ, cứu nạn (từ câu số 181 đến câu số 205).
 - Chương 3: Gồm 58 câu về Kỹ thuật lái xe (từ câu 206 đến câu 263).
 - Chương 4: Gồm 37 câu về Cấu tạo và sửa chữa (từ câu 264 đến câu 300).
 - Chương 5: Gồm 185 câu về Báo hiệu đường bộ (từ số 301 đến câu số 485).
 - Chương 6: Gồm 115 câu về Giải thế sa hình và kỹ năng xử lý tình huống giao thông (từ số 486 đến câu số 600).
 (Trong bộ 600 câu hỏi có 60 câu điểm liệt)
* Phần mềm được cung cấp hoàn toàn miễn phí và cung cấp nhiều tiện ích giúp học hiểu lý thuyết và ôn thi.
* Các chức năng chính của ứng dụng "Ôn thi lý thuyết GPLX 2026"
- Ôn tập bộ 600 câu hỏi mới nhất 2026 do Cục CSGT ban hành (áp dụng thi GPLX từ 1.6.2025 - cập nhật mới nhất 6/2026)
- Ôn tập theo các chủ đề: câu hỏi điểm liệt; Quy định chung và quy tắc giao thông đường bộ; Văn hóa giao thông, đạo đức người lái xe, PCCC; kỹ thuật lái xe; cấu tạo và sửa chữa; báo hiệu đường bộ; sa hình.
- Thi thử lý thuyết với bộ đề mẫu có sẵn hoặc được tạo ngẫu nhiên theo đúng cấu trúc chuẩn cho từng loại giấy phép lái xe: xe máy A1, A, B1; và ô tô B, C1, C, D1, D2, D, BE, C1E, CE, D1E, D2E, DE
- Danh sách các câu hỏi điểm liệt - tình huống vi phạm luật giao thông nghiêm trọng.

listings.description:
ỨNG DỤNG ÔN THI 600 CÂU HỎI MỚI NHẤT 2026 CỦA CỤC CSGT
[Update mới nhất 2026]
Sử dụng ôn thi lý thuyết GPLX tất cả các hạng Ô TÔ VÀ XE MÁY (MÔ TÔ)
* Ứng dụng Ôn thi lý thuyết GPLX cập nhật đầy đủ 600 câu hỏi và cấu trúc đề thi sử dụng cho đào tạo, sát hạch phần thi lý thuyết GPLX cho 15 hạng GPLX ô tô và xe máy (otomoto)
* Sử dụng ôn thi lý thuyết cho tất cả 15 hạng bằng GPLX:
 - Xe máy A1, A, B1
 - Các hạng GPLX ô tô: B, C1, C, D1, D2, D 
 - Các hạng BE, C1E, CE, D1E, D2E, DE
* Hỗ trợ ôn thi giấy phép lái xe - bằng lái xe, ô tô xe máy với tất cả các hạng GPLX:
- 600 câu hỏi lý thuyết GPLX hạng B, C1, C, D1, D2, D, BE, C1E, CE, D1E, D2E, DE (trong đó có 60 câu điểm liệt)
- 250 câu hỏi lý thuyết GPLX hạng A1 và hạng A (trong đó có 10 câu điểm liệt)
- 300 câu hỏi lý thuyết GPLX hạng B1 (trong đó có 20 câu điểm liệt)
* Bộ 600 câu hỏi được chia thành 6 chương: 
  - Chương 1: Gồm 180 câu về Quy định chung và quy tắc giao thông đường bộ (từ câu số 1 đến câu số 180).
  - Chương 2: Gồm 25 câu về Văn hóa giao thông, đạo đức người lái xe, kỹ năng phòng cháy, chữa cháy và cứu hộ, cứu nạn (từ câu số 181 đến câu số 205).
  - Chương 3: Gồm 58 câu về Kỹ thuật lái xe (từ câu 206 đến câu 263).
  - Chương 4: Gồm 37 câu về Cấu tạo và sửa chữa (từ câu 264 đến câu 300).
  - Chương 5: Gồm 185 câu về Báo hiệu đường bộ (từ số 301 đến câu số 485).
  - Chương 6: Gồm 115 câu về Giải thế sa hình và kỹ năng xử lý tình huống giao thông (từ số 486 đến câu số 600).
  (Trong bộ 600 câu hỏi có 60 câu điểm liệt)

- Ôn tập bộ 600 câu hỏi mới nhất 2026 do Cục CSGT ban hành (áp dụng thi GPLX từ 1.6.2025 - cập nhật mới nhất 6/2026)
- Ôn tập theo các chủ đề: câu hỏi điểm liệt; Quy định chung và quy tắc giao thông đường bộ; Văn hóa giao thông, đạo đức người lái xe, PCCC; kỹ thuật lái xe; cấu tạo và sửa chữa; báo hiệu đường bộ; sa hình.

bluejetty:00186738:ios.description:
Unlock the knowledge of human body with the ultimate 3D anatomy atlas! 
Dive deep into the fascinating world of human anatomy with our interactive 3D atlas – the most comprehensive and immersive learning experience available. Whether you're a medical student preparing for exams, a healthcare professional seeking a powerful reference tool, or simply a curious mind eager to understand the wonders of the human body, this app is your gateway to anatomical mastery. 
Experience Anatomy Like Never Before: 
Forget static textbooks and confusing diagrams. Our app brings anatomy to life with stunningly realistic, interactive 3D models of every organ and system – from the intricate skeletal structure to the delicate nervous network, and everything in between. Explore the human body layer by layer, rotate models 360 degrees, zoom in for incredible detail or even place them in your room via AR mode. 
Key Features Designed for Success: 
Complete Anatomical Coverage: Explore meticulously crafted 3D models of every organ and system, ensuring no detail is overlooked.
Realistic Visuals: Immerse yourself in high-resolution models that accurately depict the intricacies of human anatomy.
Interactive Experience: Virtually view structures layer by layer to understand their precise location and how they are related.
Comprehensive Reference Library: Access over 500 encyclopedic articles with clear definitions, precise Latin nomenclature, and in-depth explanations.
AI-Powered Search: Instantly locate specific anatomical structures using simple voice commands, saving you valuable time and effort.
Multilingual Support: Learn in your preferred language with support for English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Russian, Chinese, and Japanese.
Augmented Reality (AR) Mode: Bring anatomy to life by visualizing structures in your own space, creating a truly immersive learning experience.
Interface-Free Mode: Eliminate distractions and focus solely on the anatomy, maximizing your learning potential.
Offline Access: Learn anytime, anywhere, even without an internet connection – perfect for studying on the go.
Interactive Links: Expand your knowledge with direct links to detailed information on each anatomical element.
More Than Just an App – It's Your Anatomical Companion: 
Our app isn’t just a digital textbook; it's a powerful learning tool designed to enhance your understanding of the human body. Whether you’re preparing for an important exam, seeking a reliable reference for your practice, or simply driven by a thirst for knowledge, this app will inspire you to explore the wonders of human anatomy like never before. 
Join thousands of satisfied users who are already experiencing the benefits of our 3D anatomy atlas! 
What Users Are Saying: “It’s free and it has the most needed information! 3D body is so helpful!” – VaZ333

bluejetty:00149039:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00149039:ios.description:
Everbreed is the easiest way to keep track of your rabbit records. All your rabbitry information is now available in your hands, and accessible on your phone, tablet, or computer.
*** MAIN FEATURES ***
SCHEDULE BREED PLANS
Create chains of events in your Everbreed schedule to reflect your rabbitry’s procedure for breeding, palpating, nest boxes, and more!
REPORT BIRTHS
When a doe kindles, you can report that birth in Everbreed to create the Litter, and schedule Litter events. If the doe doesn’t kindle, report the birth as missed to track doe and buck misses in Reports.
TRACK WEIGHTS
Enter weights for kits and track their performance as they grow. Track which breeders have the best kits.
CREATE AND SHARE PEDIGREES
Offer your customers customized printed or online pedigrees. Easily share them online with a verifiable link.
REMINDERS AND NOTIFICATIONS
Never miss a kindle date again! Everbreed keeps track of your important events and notifies you on your phone or email of upcoming tasks in your rabbitry.
RABBIT SALES AND TRANSFERS
Easily Sell or Transfer rabbits to other users.
PRINT CAGE CARDS
Design and print Cage Cards for all of your rabbits. Scan them with your phone to access records right at the cage.
FINANCIAL LEDGER
Record income and expenses for your rabbitry to make sure no money slips through the cracks.
OVER A DOZEN REPORTS
See reports on breeder performance, litter weights, meat production, and much more!
YOUR DATA IS SECURE
No more worrying about computer crashes or a broken or stolen phone. Your data is stored securely and backed up in the cloud for you to access at any time from anywhere.
USE ON MULTIPLE DEVICES
Everbreed automatically syncs with your calendar, desktop browser, and other devices.
NO WIFI? NO PROBLEM. With the Everbreed app, access your rabbit records even when you’re offline or away of from wifi, after you’ve synced your data (currently read-only).
FANTASTIC CUSTOMER SUPPORT - Our Support team is ready to help you make the most of Everbreed.
“I absolutely LOVE Everbreed! I want a clear record of everything I do, but I’m horrible at record-keeping. Everbreed has been a life-saver for me. I can record breedings or report births in a few clicks, and keep track of everything with minimal effort. Everbreed also has the BEST customer support I’ve ever encountered. They are always updating with new features, as requested by customers. 10/10 would recommend to ANYONE trying to breed rabbits!” - Megan Berry
“I’ve raised meat rabbits for the past 60 years and have tried many record keeping systems over the years. They went from note books to spread sheets and everything in the middle. My needs are for an uncomplicated system that is handy, quick entries and good support. Three things that really make me happy are: 1. The ability to have all my rabbitry information on my phone and all my devices. 2. The ability of Everbreed to send the rabbit schedule to my calendar. I’m able to stay on top of everything. 3. Support. It’s second to none and they stay with you until things are right. Needless to say I am very happy with this program.” -- Robbie Mabry
Focus on your rabbits, Everbreed will handle the rest.
For questions, email us at support@everbreed.com.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00072908:ios.description:
Create mind-blowing artwork using the power of AI.
AI Generated Art Maker is a unique image generator to create art. It helps you easily create high-quality artwork in seconds!
Use your imagination to create unrealistic dreams, animals in different shapes, portraits, digital characters, celebrity icons, or photorealistic images. 
Features:
▶ No Watermark
▶ No Ads!
▶ Save in High Resolution
▶ Dozens of Art Styles
▶ Portrait or Square Output
▶ Bank of Text Ideas
▶ Prompt History
▶ High-Quality Export
▶ Share to Social Media
◆ How to use it? 
1. Enter a text prompt to describe what you want to create. Go nuts with your ideas.
2. Pick an AI Art style, or it will make an assumption about which style might be more appropriate.
3. Click the Create Art button at the bottom of the screen, and watch the power of AI turn your words into artwork.
4. Save & Share your creations.

◆ Subscriptions & Terms
The total use of the AI Generated Art Maker app requires a valid subscription plan.
• The payment will be charged to your iTunes Account when you confirm the purchase.
• The subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period depending on the selected plan (monthly, half-annual or annual) unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• You can disable the automatic renewal function anytime by adjusting your account settings.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://glowvideo.io/aiart/pp.pdf
Terms of Use: https://glowvideo.io/aiart/tos.pdf
Enjoy AI Generated Art Maker! :)

Kivra is a place where you can collect your important stuff. Letters, invoices, receipts and more – things that you otherwise would keep in binders, trousers or piles of paper. You no longer have to look for insurance letters, warranty receipts or the dog’s vaccination certificate. Instead you can gather everything in the same place to make it available at all times, wherever you are.
Kivra is a sustainable alternative to postal mail and receipts. And for each document that is being sent or received in Kivra we take one step in the right direction for the environment. Furthermore, with our upload service you can choose and upload what is important to you, everything stored safely behind Mobile BankID.
Today, tens of thousands of private companies send letters and invoices digitally using Kivra. And several of Sweden’s regions and authorities are connected, ready to send tax returns, vaccination certificates, annual statements and other important stuff to you. You can also receive digital receipts from some of the country’s most popular store chains. 
We continuously develop Kivra, with new functionalities and more connected companies, so that you can collect everything in the same place.
Kivra – a better place for your important stuff.
Kivra's terms and privacy notice can be found here: https://kivra.se/en/about-us/about-kivra/terms

bluejetty:00123964:ios.description:
Welcome to your idle adventure to become a Billionaire! The incremental idle game where you start from clearing streets and investing your hard earned money into a lemonade stand, ending with constructing the New World Order. But first, find a way to upgrade your lemonade stand into the big idle factory. Get rich by hiring managers and advance in your career that should impress Illuminati organization
Cool Features:
Advance in your career
 • make more money with a more profitable job.
 • collect passive bonuses to your idle businesses
 • infiltrate Illuminati organization to increase your cash income
Upgrade your businesses
 • level up your idle businesses to evolve them into factories or cash inc.
 • tap on business for info about next idle bonuses, that multiply your revenue
 • check the upgrade tab and look for upgrades to your favourite investments
Tap, tap to make more cash
 • click or tap to work faster, get more money per second
 • boost your idle business income multiplier
 • work hard to be a billionaire
Engage in evil business
 • get rich using a shady business, become an evil billionaire
 • forget about the lemonade stand, quick cash is more fun
 • use war conflicts and pile up your fortune
Genetic Improvements
 • collect Illuminati Tokens, become a modified capitalist
 • choose the best skills for your idle business
 • change yourself into the money factory
Earn Prestige Points
 • collect prestige and become a capitalist tycoon
 • choose where you want to spend your prestige
 • your idle city become your capitalistic kingdom
Make money with a lemonade stand, invest your cash and become a billionaire. Discover more capitalist secrets to make more money. Rise your prestige, advance in career, become a wealthy capitalist tycoon with a big fortune and someday, Illuminati will give you a chance to join them. 
Illuminati Adventure is an idle incremental game with clicker mechanic, idle game that shows the cruelty of the capitalistic world and shows how billionaires minds are exposed on corruption. If you like that, share this idle game within your friends.
Enjoy this incremental game created by 2 clickers enthusiasts

bluejetty:00062686:ios.name: Toddler Learning Games: Kidify
bluejetty:00062686:ios.summary:
Kidify is a collection of fun educational games for toddlers and preschool kids ages 1–6, played by families around the world.
Kids explore colors, shapes, animals, puzzles, and simple logic challenges through playful activities that never
bluejetty:00062686:ios.description:
Kidify is a collection of fun educational games for toddlers and preschool kids ages 1–6, played by families around the world.
Kids explore colors, shapes, animals, puzzles, and simple logic challenges through playful activities that never feel like lessons. All games are fully voiced, so children hear the names of colors, animals, objects, and actions while they play. This allows kids to explore and learn even on their own.
The games are designed for curious little explorers — whether your child is a 2-year-old discovering shapes or a 5-year-old solving puzzles and simple logic challenges. Children tap, drag, sort, and match objects while discovering how things work. They simply play — and before you notice it, they start recognizing patterns, remembering more, and solving little challenges with confidence.
The interface is simple and intuitive, designed for small hands and curious minds, so kids can easily play independently without constant help from parents.
WHAT KIDS LEARN
• fine motor skills through tapping, dragging, and interacting with objects
• logic and focus through playful challenges
• memory through matching and discovery games
• colors, shapes, animals, and the world around them
• early counting skills through simple game activities
WHAT’S INSIDE THE APP
The app includes 21 mini-games designed for early learning. These include memory games, sorting activities, animal discovery, shape and color games, puzzles, connect-the-dots activities, and many other playful experiences that help children grow through play. There is also a Solar System game where kids discover planets and some of their moons. Children place planets or moons in the correct position based on color and shape while hearing their names spoken aloud. Another activity uses augmented reality, where little explorers sort toys that appear right in their room as if by magic.
THE KIDIFY COLLECTION
This app is part of the Kidify educational collection. The Kidify library also includes games based on popular children’s brands such as Kid-E-Cats, The Fixies, Kikoriki, Little Tiaras, and Sheepy Stories.
With a Kidify subscription, families get access to the full collection:
• 23 educational apps for kids
• more than 400 coloring pages with regular drawing contests
• over 100 puzzles
• dozens of educational mini-games
• math learning apps that help children build early counting and math skills from age 1 until school
Download Kidify and let your child explore, play, and learn through fun educational games.
The app offers optional auto-renewable subscriptions that provide access to the full Kidify collection. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions can be canceled anytime in your device settings.
Privacy Policy: https://kidify.games/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://kidify.games/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00062362:ios.summary:
Earn and Track Your CLE Credits Seamlessly with Lawline’s Award-Winning Mobile App
Elevate Your Professional Development

bluejetty:00062362:ios.description:
Earn and Track Your CLE Credits Seamlessly with Lawline’s Award-Winning Mobile App
Elevate Your Professional Development
Lawline’s mobile app makes earning Continuing Legal Education (CLE) credits more convenient than ever. Access courses tailored to your interests and lifestyle by watching or listening to programs on the go. Traveling? Download your preferred courses for offline access and continue learning anytime, anywhere. Plus, unfinished programs save automatically across devices, allowing you to switch effortlessly without losing your progress.
A Trusted Leader in Online CLE
As the nation’s most experienced CLE platform for attorneys, Lawline provides trusted education approved in over 40 states. With a catalog of over 2,000 online courses spanning 50+ practice areas, Lawline supports attorneys at every stage of their careers. More than 160,000 attorneys have completed over 5 million credits through Lawline, relying on its authoritative resources for CLE compliance and professional growth.
Key Features of the Lawline App
 - Access 2,000+ on-demand CLE courses across diverse practice areas.
 - Instantly claim CLE credit and certificates upon course completion.
 - Track CLE progress for any state, including credits earned outside Lawline, with the Universal Credit Tracker.
 - Download course materials directly to your device.
 - View slides that sync automatically with any course.
 - Download courses for offline access—perfect for travel or remote work.
 - Seamlessly switch between devices with automatic progress saving.
 - Add SmartNotes: timestamped notes that let you revisit specific points in a course instantly.
Start an Unlimited CLE Subscription with Lawline for just $299/year and gain full access to our comprehensive catalog, including on-demand courses and live webcasts.
 - Payment is charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase.
 - Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions and auto-renewal settings through Account Settings after purchase.
Additional Information
 - Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited upon subscription purchase.
 - For assistance or feedback, contact us at support@lawline.com.
View Lawline’s terms of use here: https://www.lawline.com/info/terms-and-conditions
View Lawline’s Privacy Policy here: https://www.lawline.com/info/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00089325:ios.description:
OneMail is an IMAP multi accounts email app that groups beautifully your emails into one Inbox.
With Tag colored accounts you can easily know each email to which account it belongs to.
OneMail groups your emails by date so you can easily peek at the received time without the need to enter to the email.
With Dark mode you can experience a beautiful new design and eyes comfort in low light environment.
OneMail is designed to optimize the synchronization time between your inbox and you email provider.
With OneMail you can:
- Switch between your accounts and you unified inbox easily.
- Send emails with HTML formatted signatures.
- Open and send email attachments.
- Open and browse compressed files and send uncompressed files individually.
- Unsubscribe with a tap.
- Easily manage your Inbox by creating, renaming and removing folders.
- Easy filter you inbox by categories like Unread, Newsletters, emails with attachments...
- Search and select contacts from your phone contacts.
- Customize Swipe Actions.
- Undo Actions like send, delete, archive...
- Snooze Emails
- Make OneMail your default email app.
With OneMail Plus! you can: 
- Add unlimited number of mail accounts.
- Receive push notifications from all IMAP providers.
OneMail is built over the respect of user privacy and do not store any informations from your emails.
All your emails data and headers are stored locally on your device.
We will keep improving OneMail so your feedback will be appreciated.
You can contact us at support@nouvelware.com

bluejetty:00040976:ios.description:
The Impress App is designed to simplify the lives of our patients undergoing clear aligner orthodontic treatment and allow our medical team to better monitor their progress and maximize the efficiency of their treatment. 
Straightening your teeth has never been easier, quicker or more convenient!
Make the most of your invisible aligners treatment with the Impress App:
- Take photos of your smile when the app prompts you to and share it with your orthodontist
- Get guidance through every step of the treatment process 
- Receive reminders and recommendations from your designated orthodontist
- Get notifications when it’s time to change your aligners
- Chat directly with your orthodontist, anytime, from any place
- Save time and avoid in-clinics visit (unless you prefer to)
Important:
The Impress App is intended for use under the supervision of your Impress orthodontist experts. Our Patient Care team will provide you access to the app as soon as you start your treatment. Our goal is to provide an app which meets your needs. Remember that to achieve the final result you must follow your orthodontist's instructions on the correct use of your aligners.

Visit our website: https://smile2impress.com/uk
Enjoy our blog articles on: https://smile2impress.com/uk/blog
Our goal is to provide an app which meets your needs and makes your treatment process easier and more engaging.

bluejetty:00130960:ios.name: LEGO® Bricktales
bluejetty:00130960:ios.summary: In LEGO® Bricktales, discover an innovative brick-by-brick building mechanic to design puzzle solutions from your own imagination. See your creations brought to life in a beautiful LEGO world where every problem has a constructive resolutio
bluejetty:00130960:ios.description:
In LEGO® Bricktales, discover an innovative brick-by-brick building mechanic to design puzzle solutions from your own imagination. See your creations brought to life in a beautiful LEGO world where every problem has a constructive resolution. 
Embark on an epic adventure across a world of beautiful LEGO diorama biomes crafted brick by brick as you search for inspiration to help your grandfather reinvigorate his rundown amusement park with your little robot buddy in tow. Your journey will take you to the deepest jungle, sun-drenched deserts, a bustling city corner, a towering medieval castle, and tropical Caribbean islands. Help the minifigures of these worlds by solving puzzles and unlock new skills throughout the story to further explore these worlds and uncover the many secrets and mysteries they contain. 
From purely aesthetic creations, such as a market stand or music box, up to functional physics-based puzzles like building a crane or gyrocopter - each diorama offers a variety of construction spots with the freedom of intuitive brick-by-brick building. In each spot you are given a set of bricks and it’s up to you to figure out a unique build that will work. On top of specific puzzles and quests, there are additional builds in the amusement park so you can customize the rides to make them your own! 
The Story 
Your grandfather, a genius inventor, has called you for help! His beloved amusement park is about to close as the mayor is threatening to shut everything down and seize the land if the necessary repairs aren’t made to bring it up to code. With the help of your powerful little robot buddy, you can restore it using a mysterious device based on alien technology. As a source of power, the device needs happiness crystals, which you can harvest by making people happy and solving their problems. With the aid of a portal, travel to different locations all around the world to help people and collect their happiness crystals. Strap in for the ultimate building adventure and save your grandfather’s amusement park! 
Features 
- A globetrotting LEGO adventure: Experience a whimsical and epic adventure around the world, packed with charming dialogue and fun secrets to unravel. 
- Beautiful diorama worlds: Explore five varied story world biomes and the amusement park hub, all fully built out of LEGO bricks. 
- Build like never before: Discover the most intuitive brick-by-brick building in a LEGO video game, as you see your creations come to life in a three-dimensional world. 
- Test your skills with varied puzzles: Different types of puzzles will test your building skills. Use your engineering brain in functional physics-based puzzles to build a bridge for a digger to get across a river, put your designer hat on to build a stunning new throne for the King, or customize the rides in the amusement park. 
- Master your builds in Sandbox Mode: Unlock the Sandbox Mode upon completing a construction spot, then you go back in and improve your build with a huge selection of additional bricks from different themes. 
- Heaps of items to collect and unlock: Find collectables in the different dioramas and use them to buy cool new items for your wardrobe or new brick color sets for the sandbox mode. 
- Build your unique character: Create your own minifigure character from a huge selection of parts and unlock more options inspired by the worlds you visit as you progress through the story.

亲爱的火星新居民：
你好呀！
当你点开这封信的时候，我们知道，你已经踏上了这片特别的星球 —— 这里的每一寸角落，都为那些你放在心上的人而存在。没有冰冷的社交距离，只有让心与心靠得更近的魔法。
或许你会好奇，火星到底是个怎样的地方？其实，我们做过很多尝试 —— 想让你和最在意的人，聊天时少一点等待，多一点 “正在输入” 的雀跃；想让你们的秘密永远是秘密，不用担心截屏留下痕迹；想让手机桌面也变成你们的小天地，彼此的消息像小惊喜一样跳出来；甚至想让你们就算隔着千里，也能像握着对讲机那样，随时喊出一句 “我想你啦”。
这些念头攒在一起，就有了现在的火星。我们不想做一个让你认识更多人的工具，而是希望成为你和 “重要的人” 之间的黏合剂。毕竟，生活里最珍贵的，从来不是泛泛之交的点赞，而是深夜里和闺蜜的一起追剧，是和恋人共享位置时的安心，是和家人经营火星小家时的琐碎牵挂，是和好友合养宠物时的默契互动，是闲暇时一起打场游戏的轻松欢愉。
所以，不如现在就把你心里惦记的那些人，带到火星来？
你可以试试用亲密聊天和TA对话，看着彼此的文字一点点冒出来，就像坐在同一张桌子前对话；可以一起设置 “禁止截屏”，让那些撒娇、吐槽、甚至有点傻的话，只属于你们两个人；也可以偷偷往TA 的桌面传个小纸条，让你的存在变成 TA 每天看到的第一个小确幸。
在这里，每一个功能都在说：“去和 TA 更亲密一点吧。”
火星很小，小到只能装下你最在乎的人；火星也很大，大到能装下你们所有的喜怒哀乐。
我们在这儿等你，也等你们一起，在这片星球上酿出独属于你们的温暖。
—— 守护亲密时光的火星团队

bluejetty:00141252:ios.description:
What will make you love Tile Zen: Triple Match Puzzle?
Unlike classic puzzle - zen match & tile master puzzle, Tile Zen: Triple Match Puzzle is not only an addictive matching puzzle game but also help to release your stress with tons of happy color 3D objects, candy crush, cute animals; cool toys, yummy fruits and etc,...
HOW TO PLAY
Simply tap to place the 3D tiles into the box. Three same tiles will be collected. Collect all the tiles as fast as possible to make the combo.
- When all tiles are collected, you win!
- When reach the tiles limit on the boxes, you fail!
- Each level has time milestone. Try to finish the game within the given time to earn more stars.
- Each object board is different and varies from one to the next, giving the game a different difficulty for every level you play.
FEATURES:
- Unlimited play
- Easy to play with simple rules, addictive gameplay, suitable for all ages.
- A lot of style of cute tiles. More than 500+ tiles are waiting for you to explore, more and more new tiles will be updated soon.
- Challenging levels, collect more stars and unlock more rewards
- Use helpful boosters to help you beat levels
- Play FREE anytime, anywhere
Join and challenge how far you can go in Tile Zen: Triple Match Puzzle
About Skylink Studio:
Tile Zen: Triple Match Puzzle is produced by Skylink Studio. Skylink is a top game studio of Puzzle Games and Casual Games. Skylink Studio published many top games: Merge Master - Elden Warrior, Merge Tower Defense 3D, Color Fill - Water Sort Puzzle, Final Giant Rush, Jewels Mix, Tangle Bridge Puzzle 3D, Pour Water - Sort Puzzle 3D, Ball Sort Puzzle, Toy Master 3D- Matching Triple and many more.

bluejetty:00121777:ios.description:
Play all your videos directly without having to convert them! OPlayer supports almost every format for video/audio playback. It gives you the flexibility to be able to download your files to your device, or browse a SAMBA/FTP/UPnP/DLNA share over the network.
"Best video player on the App Store"
OPlayer has been rated as "iPhone Apps Plus Best"!
OPlayer has been around for 12 years, continuous improvement in video playback and feature enhancements, has made it the first choice for millions of the users. With positive endorsements and feedback from our users we endeavor to make it even better with each upgrade.
========================================
 Support Dolby Digital Audio (AC3)
 Official AVI/DivX license (In App Purchase)
 Official DTS license (In App Purchase)
========================================
【Supported Formats】
- Video: mkv, wmv, avi, divx, xvid, rmvb, rm, flv, mp4, 4k, mov, 3gp, m4v, blu-ray, ts, m2ts, swf, asf, vob, h265 (hevc), webm...almost all movie file formats.
- Audio: mp3, wma, wav, dts, ac3, eac3, aac, flac, ape, cue, amr, ogg vorbis, lossless music...almost all audio file formats.
- Subtitle: srt, ass, smi, sub...almost all subtitle file formats.
- Stream: http, ftp, samba, rtp, rtsp, mms...
- Widely devices support: Optimized for all iPhones running iOS 6.0 and later, including iPhone 6s (Plus).
【Key features】
• Adjust playback speed: 0.1x ~ 4.0x
• A-B repeat: play from start point (A) to end point (B) repeatedly
• Background play: continue playing videos when app enters background
• Landscape play: useful when iPhone turned on 'Portrait Orientation Lock'
- SAMBA/FTP/HTTP/UPnP/DLNA client
- Multiple transfer ways: 1. USB transfer (support folder) 2. Wi-Fi transfer
- Play files in PC remotely without downloading
 Share folders on PC, then you can stream files by OPlayer.
- Privacy protect: support password for app and folders, hide password-protected folders, Touch ID
- Excellent performance: support 1080P HD video on iPhone 5 and newer devices
- Less battery consumption: hardware decoding mp4/mp3 files by default
- Single hand mode: you can control playback with one hand
【Basic functions】
- File Manager: new folder/rename/move/delete/search/sort/open in with
- Built in web browser
- Support NAS, Router, Dropbox...network storage
- Support text file: TXT, WORD, EXCEL, PPT, PDF...
- Compress/Decompress (In App Purchase): support zip, rar, 7z (with password)
- Playlist: enjoy music by our powerful playlist functions
- Gesture: seek (forward, backward), brightness, volume, pause/resume, subtitle position and size
- Repeat/Loop mode: repeat all, repeat once, shuffle...
- Remember playback time: resume from last played position
- Render on TV (TV Out): support AirPlay, mirror, HDMI wire...
- Lock playing window: avoid unintended touch when watching movies
- Timing off: stop playing after the specified time
- Adjust aspect ratio: you can set any aspect ratio, for example 16:9
- Play 3d movies in 2d mode
- Deinterlace
- Flip horizontal and vertical
- Use headphones to control playback
- Audio boost
- Photo viewer (In App Purchase): 1. Support gif animation，png，jpg，bmp... 2. Slide show photos 3. Import from Photos
【Audio Features】
- Support left and right channel switch
- Audio tracks switch and save your settings
- Adjust audio delay
【Subtitle Features】
- Support embedded subtitles in movies
- Auto load the subtitle whose name is the same with the movie
- Select subtitle files manually
- Auto detect the encode of subtitle files
- Gesture: single touch and move to adjust position, pinch to adjust size
- Customizable subtitle font, colors
- Adjust subtitle delay
【Support】
- We will check reviews on App Store frequently
- Skype: oplayer_help@outlook.com
- Mail: olimsoft@gmail.com
- Twitter: @OLIMSOFT
- Website: www.edavs.com

bluejetty:00114281:ios.summary:
Welcome to Hungry Hours – Where Every Minute Feels Like Mealtime Magic!
Step into your warm and bustling restaurant, where the grill is always sizzling, the kitchen is perfectly organized, and the sound of burgers and pizza cooking creates
bluejetty:00114281:ios.description:
Welcome to Hungry Hours – Where Every Minute Feels Like Mealtime Magic!
Step into your warm and bustling restaurant, where the grill is always sizzling, the kitchen is perfectly organized, and the sound of burgers and pizza cooking creates a relaxing ASMR vibe. Hungry Hours is one of those good cooking games that instantly makes you smile. You’re not just cooking — you’re running the coziest fast-food spot in town, serving hungry customers and spreading joy, one juicy burger at a time.
This isn’t just another simulation game. It’s a comfort-food playground made for every foodie out there — especially players who love perfect tidy gameplay and oddly satisfying ASMR cooking. From towering cheeseburgers dripping with melty cheese to crispy fried chicken, golden fries lined up neatly, stretchy cheesy nachos, creamy milkshakes, and hot pizza slices — every action feels clean, smooth, and satisfying.
WHAT MAKE HUNGRY HOURS SO DELICIOUSLY FUN 
- Burger Bliss – Flip, stack, and serve mouth-watering burgers with perfect precision
- Pizza Party – Slice, bake, and serve pizza like a true pizza maker 
- Beyond the Bun – Fries, hot dogs, nuggets, desserts, and more
- Speed & Skill – Cook fast, stay tidy, and earn big tips
- Kitchen Upgrades – Unlock new tools, toppings, and cozy, perfect tidy décor
- Charming Customers – Quirky guests with funny reactions and personalities
- Endless Challenges – Improve timing, memory, and multitasking
HOW TO PLAY
- Take the order – Listen carefully and enjoy the calm, focused flow
- Prepare the meal – Grill, fry, bake pizza, and arrange everything neatly
- Serve it hot – Deliver clean, perfect orders before time runs out
- Earn rewards – Collect coins, unlock ingredients, and expand your menu
WHY YOU'LL LOVE HUNGRY HOURS
Whether you’re into relaxing pizza games, casual burger cooking, cozy pizza simulation, or soothing ASMR gameplay, Hungry Hours is made for you. Easy to learn, deeply satisfying to play, and perfect for short chill sessions or long, stress-free cooking time.
Feel the gentle rush of lunch hours, enjoy the satisfying sounds of cooking, experiment with fun burger and pizza combos, and watch your small shop grow into a beloved fast-food empire.
It’s Hungry Hours — all day, every day.
Put on your apron, cook with love, keep everything perfectly tidy, and prove you can run the happiest restaurant in town.

bluejetty:00146076:ios.description:
**Pass the Phlebotomy Exam Without Drawing a Blank**
You’ve practiced the sticks, mastered the tubes, and maybe even survived your first fainting patient. Now it’s time to pass your phlebotomy certification exam and make it official. No pressure. Just veins, vacutainers, and a mountain of test questions.
EZ Prep’s Phlebotomy Study App is the fastest, smartest, and least painful way to prep for your phlebotomy certification exam. Whether you’re studying at home, offline at work, or hiding in the break room between draws, this app goes where you go and helps you focus on what actually matters.
Created by certified phlebotomy professionals and aligned with the latest national exam objectives, the app includes dynamic questions that adjust to your performance, clear explanations, and tools to make studying suck less.
Try it free and get a feel for the app before committing. When you're ready, upgrade to unlock full-length exams, missed question review, bookmarks, and more.
**Topics covered inside the app:**
• Anatomy and Physiology
• Blood Collection Procedures
• Specimen Handling and Processing
• Safety and Compliance
• Patient Interaction and Communication
• Medical Terminology
• Quality Control and Assurance
• Infection Control
• Equipment and Supplies
Whether you’re prepping for NHA’s CPT, AMCA, NCCT, or any of the other certification bodies that alphabet soup their exams, this app has you covered.
**Features include:**
• Personalized onboarding to set daily study goals and question difficulty
• Adaptive learning that gets more challenging as you improve
• Streaks and achievements to keep you motivated on long shifts
• Instant feedback with explanations that don’t sound like they were written in 1996
• Timed exam simulator so you can practice under pressure
• Progress tracking and performance stats so you know what’s working
We’re so confident in the content that we offer a pass guarantee. If you don’t pass, we’ll refund your money and keep your subscription active until you do. Check the terms if you love fine print, but yes, we mean it.
EZ Prep was built by real professionals for future phlebotomists who don’t have time for outdated books or shady apps with sketchy reviews.

Privacy Policy: https://www.eztestprep.com/privacy-policy
Contact us at: support@eztestprep.com

bluejetty:00147151:ios.description:
Status combines pseudonymous privacy-focused messenger and secure crypto wallet into one powerful communication tool. Chat with friends and growing communities. Buy, store, and exchange digital assets.
Status is your Ethereum operating system.
SECURE ETHEREUM WALLET
The Status crypto wallet allows you to securely send, store, and exchange Ethereum assets such as ETH, SNT, stable coins such as DAI, as well as collectibles. Confidently take control of your cryptocurrency and digital assets with our multichain Ethereum wallet app, supporting Ethereum Mainnet, Base, Arbitrum, and Optimism. The Status blockchain wallet currently only supports ETH, ERC-20, ERC-721, and ERC-1155 assets; it does not support Bitcoin.
PRIVATE MESSENGER
Send private 1:1 and private group chats without anyone snooping on your communications. Status is a messenger app that eliminates centralised message relays for greater privacy and secure messaging. All messages are encrypted with end-to-end encryption. Additionally, no message exposes who the author or the intended recipient is, so nobody, not even Status, knows who is talking to who or what was said.
EARN WITH DEFI
Put your crypto to work with the latest decentralised finance apps and decentralised exchanges (DEX) such as Maker, Aave, Uniswap, Synthetix, PoolTogether, Zerion, Kyber, and more.
CONNECT WITH YOUR COMMUNITY
Explore, connect, and chat with your favourite communities and friends. Whether it is a small group of friends, an artist collective, crypto traders, or the next big organization - text and communicate with Status communities.
PRIVATE ACCOUNT CREATION
Stay private with pseudo-anonymous account creation. When creating your free account, you will NEVER have to enter a phone number, email address, or bank account. Your wallet private keys are locally generated and securely stored to ensure only you have access to your funds and financial transactions.

bluejetty:00018787:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00018787:ios.description:
In a world where traffic, wait times, and long lines make everyday tasks feel like a massive hassle, we’re here to help you skip to the good part.
Skip is Canada’s homegrown delivery app—trusted by 5+ million customers and 50,000+ retailers nationwide. We’re available in more than 450 cities and towns across Canada. Order from anywhere and get whatever you need delivered right to your house, condo, apartment, workplace, hotel…you get the idea.
Skip makes it easy to order delivery from your favourite restaurants and stores, from the AM into the PM. Enjoy delivery for morning coffee, late-night sweet treats, sushi dinners, burger cravings, groceries, pharmaceuticals, alcohol, personal items, flowers, pet supplies, and so much more.
Download our app and start skipping to the good part.
JOIN SKIP+
Unlock a whole new world of unlimited $0 delivery fee, lower service fees, bonus Points, members-only access to VIP experiences and more with Skip+. Your first 3 months are FREE!
$0 DELIVERY FEE (with a min. order)
Skip the extra fees when you want to. Sort restaurants and stores by Delivery Fee to see places near you that offer $0 delivery with a minimum order.
TRACK YOUR ORDER
Get real-time update notifications and live GPS tracking, so you know exactly where your order is every step of the way.
EASY PAYMENT
Skip the card number memorization. Pay quickly when you save your debit or credit card in the app.
RESTAURANTS
All your cravings are at your fingertips. Enjoy delivery from your longtime fave places or discover new go-tos in your neighbourhood. Craving Chinese, Italian, Indian, or Mexican? From healthy to hearty, pizza to salad, fish and chips to falafel, burgers to pad thai, burritos to sushi, and sandwiches to ice cream—order food delivery for every mood, occasion, and taste.
GROCERIES
Whether you need milk for your cereal, coffee for your morning, bread for lunch, or batteries in a pinch, we’ve got you covered with convenience store and grocery delivery.
REORDER
Want to enjoy your favourite deliveries again and again? Reorder your most-loved dishes in your order history with our ‘Reorder’ button.
RESTAURANT SELECTION
Order delivery from hundreds of local restaurants that deliver near you or pick from popular national favourites like McDonald’s, Tim Hortons, Wendy’s, 7-Eleven, KFC, Boston Pizza, Burger King, Pizza Pizza, Harvey’s, Booster Juice, Mr. Sub, St-Hubert, Papa John’s Pizza, and many more.
CONVENIENCE
With a few taps, your next meal is on its way, delivered where you want it, whether you’re at home, work, or chilling with friends. Pro tip: plan ahead with preorder.
PICKUP
Craving something ASAP? Grab, go, and enjoy with Pickup. Choose ‘Pickup’ for that need-it-now takeout on the way home or last-minute lunchtime fuel.
STAY IN THE KNOW
When creating your account, subscribe to our emails to be among the first to know about great offers near you.
SHARE YOUR FEEDBACK
Great delivery calls for great feedback. Easily review restaurants, stores, and couriers with just a few taps.
WE’RE HERE FOR YOU
Have questions? Get help with live chat in the app.

bluejetty:00028851:ios.description:
Key West Rides makes it easier than ever to move around Key West — with a few taps, book a ride using the app and we’ll pair you with others headed your way. 
How does Key West Rides work?
- Key West Rides is an on-demand travel concept that takes multiple passengers heading in the same direction and books them into a shared bus. Using the app, input your address and we’ll match you with a vehicle going your way. We’ll pick you up on a nearby corner and drop you off within a short walk of your chosen destination. Now for the clever bit; our algorithms provide journey times that are comparable to a taxi and much more convenient than other modes of travel, making on-demand transportation easier than ever before!
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our tech matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
AFFORDABLE.
Rides are priced comparable to public transport and you can add people to your bookings for even less.
Questions? Reach out to kwdot@cityofkewyest-fl.gov.
Loving your experience so far? Give us a 5-star rating. You’ll have our eternal gratitude.

bluejetty:00026635:ios.description:
USING METROPOLIS IS EASY
With Metropolis, paying for parking is as easy as driving in and driving out. Just open the app and sign up by adding your license plate and payment method.
JUST DRIVE IN AND PARK
Just drive in to any Metropolis location to start your visit. You'll receive a notification that you've arrived.
TRANSPARENT PRICING
With Metropolis, parking rates and price estimates are available before you park. Once your visit starts, you can extend your stay or change your payment method remotely.
JUST DRIVE OUT TO PAY
When you've finished parking, just drive out to pay automatically. We'll send you a receipt after every visit, and you can access your complete parking history at any time.
FIND FREE OR DISCOUNTED PARKING
Look for a Metropolis sign at participating retailers near your parking location. From your visit page, simply scan the QR code to apply the discount. You'll see your parking price adjust right away in the app.
EASY TO NAVIGATE
You can use Metropolis when traveling and renting a car. Just add the rental to your account, assign an end date, and we'll automatically remove it when you're done.
FIND METROPOLIS IN YOUR CITY
Nashville, Houston, Los Angeles, Detroit, Austin, Roanoke, Knoxville, Denver, St. Louis, Kansas City, Memphis, Salt Lake City, Miami, San Francisco, Washington DC, Charlotte, Dallas, Cleveland, New York, Chattanooga, Seattle, Sacramento, Louisville, and more.
Not all features available in all markets.

Contact help@metropolis.io or visit help.metropolis.io

Vinyl Value is a scanner that allows yo
bluejetty:00096804:ios.description:
What is the true market price of that rare record you just found? Are you selling a Near Mint gem or a VG+ pressing? Knowing the precise Condition Grade is the critical factor for accurate valuation.
Vinyl Value is a scanner that allows you to snap a photo of your vinyl and instantly receive detailed identification, expert grading suggestions, and a dynamic Reference Market Price. This price is dynamically adjusted based on the specific Media and Sleeve Condition you or the app determines, ensuring you always get a fair deal.
The definitive identifier for Collectors, Resellers, and serious Music Enthusiasts.
Why VinylValue is the Pro Choice for Grading and Valuation
Precision Condition Analysis (M-P Grading): Get AI-powered suggestions for Media and Sleeve condition based on your photo. Crucially, you can manually adjust these grades, and the Reference Price instantly updates to reflect the true market value of your specific record. This is vital for any serious reseller or collector.
Dynamic Reference Pricing: We use live market and Discogs data to calculate the optimal market price for quick, fair sales or purchases. This price is accurately calculated relative to the chosen condition grade—a feature unparalleled in record valuation apps.
Instant Pressing Identification: Scan the label to unlock pressing details, release year, distributor, and the essential A/B Side Tracklist with song durations. Our reliable identifier leverages massive music databases.
Digital Vinyl Shelf for Collectors: Organize and save every record you scan in your digital archive. Track your entire Vinyl Collection's total worth over time, noting purchase details and personal grading notes.
Artist Context & Info: Access concise artist biographies and insights into the record’s historical importance.
Download VinylValue Today and uncover the precise market value and history behind every record in your library! 
Subscription Information
Choose between a 1 Week Subscription ($3.99) or Annual ($29.99) subscription for scanning vinyls.
Cancel anytime!
Subscriptions will automatically renew unless cancelled at least one day before the renewal date within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase.
You can manage and cancel your subscription by going to your account settings in the App Store

Terms and Conditions: https://www.mafusto.com/privacy-policy.html
EULA: https://www.mafusto.com/eula.html

Crocodile Dentist, also known as Crocodile Roulette, is a simple but very enjoyable game by GameVui Dev. We hope this game can make your friends and family have so much fun.
🐊 HOW TO PLAY CROCODILE DENTIST:
- Set the number of TEETH as the number of players.
- Set the number of PENALTY as the number of people who will be eliminated.
- In turns, each player chooses a tooth.
- If Croc's jaw stays still, you're safe, and the next player takes their turn.
- If Croc's jaw snaps closed, BAMMM!, you're chomped on and out of the game.
- The last ones standing will be the winners!
🐊 EXCITING FEATURES:
- 100% free and no Internet connection is needed.
- Suitable for all ages.
- Small file size and low battery usage.
- Realistic interface, professional design, and fun music.

- Other animal versions: Bulldog and Shark.

Download Crocodile Dentist and have a fun time with your friends now!

bluejetty:00078554:ios.description:

Roamingo offers optional VPN access through a one-time in-app purchase. The purchase price and included VPN features are displayed in the app before purchase.

Download Roamingo and get ready for your next journey.

bluejetty:00119071:ios.name: Brachot
bluejetty:00119071:ios.summary: BERACHOT - Life in the modern world proceeds at a very rapid pace. Everyone has to get to many places on time, to do many things, to meet many people – all in one day. Because of this, the smartphone has become the active person’s most need
bluejetty:00119071:ios.description:
BERACHOT - Life in the modern world proceeds at a very rapid pace. Everyone has to get to many places on time, to do many things, to meet many people – all in one day. Because of this, the smartphone has become the active person’s most needed instrument, to which he is connected day and night. This instrument serves as a combination of many functions: telephone; computer; tablet; camera; diary; music player; radio, and more. In the past, a Jew had to carry many books with him wherever he went: a Siddur; Chumash; Tehillim; Gemara; books on Halacha, etc. The Siddur was especially essential – prayers are recited daily and everywhere – at work, traveling, at the restaurant, on vacation, etc. Today there is no need for that anymore – the smartphone has even replaced the Siddur.
This application is meant for assisting the Jew in navigating confidently through the world of blessings.
How is it unique and different from similar applications?
Here are some of its features:
- The prayers and blessings are displayed in three versions: Askenaz, Edot HaMizrach and Sefarad.
- There are three language options: Hebrew in Hebrew letters, Hebrew in Latin letters (transliteration), and English translation, in addition to short explanations of each blessing.
- Easy and user-friendly interface.
- The presence of four languages: Hebrew, Russian, English, Georgian;
- Everything that one would need on a daily basis – nothing superfluous.
May these blessings bring good health, luck and peace to all those reciting them and to all the people of Israel and to the whole world! Amen!
This Application is published with the authorization of the Chief Rabbis of Israel and Russia, and with their blessings.
Our deepest appreciation to all who participated in this sacred project.
If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to contact us jewapps@gmail.com.

bluejetty:00042204:ios.description:
Time for an oil change? The Valvoline Instant Oil Change app is ready to help you save time and money! Designed to make maintaining your vehicles easy on your schedule and wallet. This is the only app that gives you estimated wait times for your nearby Valvoline Instant Oil Change locations. So, you can plan to arrive when the wait is short with your personalized coupons already conveniently saved in the app. Our friendly staff of professional technicians is here to help with maintenance services that fit your schedule and prices that fit your budget. 
Features: 
See live estimated wait times for your nearby Valvoline Instant Oil Changes locations 
See a list of vehicle services available at each location 
See estimated vehicle service times so you can understand how long your services might take 
Receive special offers and money-saving coupons stored right in the app 
View a map with your nearby locations – or pinch, zoom, and search the map to find other Valvoline Instant Oil Change locations 
Get driving directions to any Valvoline Instant Oil Change with a tap 
Get push notifications with exclusive money-saving offers 
Timely Services That Won't Slow You Down 
We know you're busy. When you visit our service center, we don't waste our time or yours. Our technicians can typically perform a full oil change service in about 15 minutes. Along with your oil, we'll also assess the following: 
Air filter 
Tire pressure 
Windshield wipers and fluid 
Power steering fluid and antifreeze 
Headlights and taillights 
Do you need to squeeze in an oil change on a work break? With our drive-through oil change, you don't have to put off essential maintenance tasks. Drop by on your way to lunch or an appointment, knowing that we'll help you get there on time. 
Technicians Trained on ASE-Accredited Program 
Along with speedy oil changes, Valvoline technicians can perform quick and complete maintenance on your vehicle's air conditioning, radiator and transmission systems. Our techs complete 270 hours of training in an ASE-accredited program and are well-qualified to rotate tires, replace the serpentine belt, battery, air filter and more. 
Service you can see. Experts you can trust.℠

bluejetty:00126626:ios.description:
Enhance your outdoor adventures with Luminos Map: Twilight Nav Tool.
Curious about Sunrise, Sunset, Moonrise, and Moonset times? This app has you covered.
Discover precise Sun and Moon positions, plus upcoming twilight, anywhere globally.
Its stunning time-chart and interactive map make rich data accessible and intuitive.
Explore how sunrise/sunset times shift across seasons with customizable dates.
Access real-time Sun/Moon info for any worldwide location, beyond just your current spot.
Play with the map feature—tap ‘Map’ to navigate globally for detailed celestial data.
Data updates automatically; switch to chart view for location specifics and refresh.
Time zones adjust seamlessly to your chosen location, ensuring accuracy.
Features of Luminos Map: Twilight Nav Tool:
- Real-time Sun/Moon, sunrise/sunset, and moonrise/moonset data
- Rise/set locations for Sun/Moon on any day
- Exact Sun/Moon paths at specific times
- Landscape capture tips (e.g., sunset, milky way)
- Altitude and azimuth details
- Solstice and equinox dates for any year
- Moon phase info (name/days)
- New and full moon dates
- Twilight data (official, civil, nautical, astronomical)
- Select locations via search or manual latitude/longitude input; adjust date/time/zone as needed.
Note: Calculations are offline, but internet is required for updates and searches. Offline mode supports current location data with location services on.
Terms of use: https://mapnitude.com/terms-of-service

"Luminos Map: Twilight Nav Tool" is completely free to use with all features. You can subscribe to this application to remove ads.

Subscriptions may be managed by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase or by clicking the “Purchase / Manage Subscription. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase.
Subscription cannot be cancelled during the active subscription period

bluejetty:00172962:android.summary: Those of you working with Office software may be very aware of Microsoft Word, but do you know many other word processors, such as OpenOffice Writer, LibreOffice Writer, and iWork Pages? Different from DOC or DOCX, some of these programs cr
bluejetty:00172962:android.description:
Those of you working with Office software may be very aware of Microsoft Word, but do you know many other word processors, such as OpenOffice Writer, LibreOffice Writer, and iWork Pages? Different from DOC or DOCX, some of these programs create files in ODT format. When you receive this type of file from others and need to share it in PDF format or Word (Doc, Docx) format, how can you convert ODT to PDF or Word?
On Android phone, you may be need a odt file reader to read it , but you can convert to PDF to read any device!
Now with this ODT File Converter , we can easily convert one file format to another without use any odt file viewer.
What are ODT and an ODT File?
Before diving into how to convert ODT to PDF or file converter odt to word, let’s take a quick look at what ODT and an ODT file are.
ODT is a format of OpenDocument files, which is similar to Doc and Docx and typically created in a word processor like OpenOffice Writer. There are some other formats used for OpenDocument files such as ODS, ODP, and ODG. 
An ODT file may include text, images, and pages like a Word file does and can be opened and saved in Word and some other office suites. 
Why Convert ODT to PDF
Portable Document Format (PDF), as the name suggests, is a format used to conveniently read, share and print files. According to the 2015 PDF Technical Conference, there might be more than 2.5 trillion PDF documents created every year. In the modern era, PDFs have been an indispensable part of virtually every industry and business. Here are 3 main reasons why we need to convert ODT to PDF.
 Whether the ODT or Word files, when you send them across different application software or OS, the formatting and layout may differ, which will never happen to PDF documents.
 After converting ODT to PDF, you or your co-workers can view the file through most platforms and browsers without the need to install a dedicated reader, which contributes a lot to team collaboration. 
 PDFs are more preferred than other types of files inbusiness world. The vast quantity of documents such as resumes, invoices, and contracts are in PDF format.
Convert ODT to PDF with file converter odt to pdf very easily and quickly!
Not only supports ODT, app also supports many Open Office Writer format example : OTT (OpenDocument Text Template), OTH (HTML Document Template), ODM
