bluejetty:00030798:ios.description:
It’s time to let go of your tug-of-war with anxiety and find calm and balance in your life.
Are you struggling with constant anxiety and worry? Do racing thoughts keep you up at night or make it hard to focus during the day? Is lingering tension making it hard to relax, even when you try? Does emotional fatigue leave you feeling drained and disconnected?
Lumière is here to help you get out of that vicious cycle, slow down, reconnect, and gently shift your relationship with anxiety. Through simple daily practices inspired by Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) and self-compassion, Lumière aids you to ease stress, and cultivate gratitude and self-love in minutes.
Do you find you have problems with:
- Stress and anxiety?
- Constant worrying?
- Self-criticism?
- Intrusive thoughts?
- Tension?
- Fatigue and overwhelm?
Everyone encounters difficult emotions. At Lumière, we believe anxiety and joy are not mutually exclusive; instead, we encourage an awareness of both to strengthen emotional health. We invite you to embrace each moment while cultivating self-care, self-love, and self-kindness.
Lumière will help you achieve:
- A calm, centered mind
- Increased focus and clarity
- Inner strength and psychological flexibility
- More joy, gratitude, and presence
- Emotional healing
WHY IT WORKS
Gratitude practices benefit everyone. Whether you are struggling with their mental health or simply looking to deepen their sense of joy, presence, and connection in daily life, gratitude helps you…
- Lower anxiety and depression
- Regulate emotions more effectively
- Improve focus and relationships
- Feel more connected and purposeful
You don’t have to be “fixed” to feel better.
Lumière meets you where you are and helps you gently move forward.
ANXIETY RELIEF
Lumière guides you toward a grounded state, helping you release stress and restore calm. By noticing small moments of joy and gratitude, you begin to soothe your nervous system and reconnect with your inner child.
PSYCHOLOGICAL FLEXIBILITY
Through a unique blend of gratitude and acceptance, Lumière helps you develop psychological flexibility, the ability to stay present, adapt to change, and meet challenges without being overwhelmed.
EMOTIONAL HEALING
Lumière creates space for gentle emotional healing by helping you acknowledge, validate, and process difficult feelings without judgment. Rebuild trust with yourself and move forward with compassion, reconnecting with what truly matters.
HOW IT WORKS
Daily Gratitude Photo: Capture small moments of joy. Build a personal library of gratitude and happiness, and shift your focus toward what’s good, even on difficult days.
Daily Acceptance: Let go of resistance and reconnect with the present. Life isn’t always simple or easy, but through emotional healing and cultivating psychological flexibility, you’ll learn to meet its challenges with strength.
Supported Introspection: Carve out moments of tranquility and reflection. Escape the hustle and bustle of daily life, dedicating just a few minutes each day to centering yourself and reconnecting with what makes life meaningful.
WHO WE ARE
Lumière is brought to you by the creators of Fabulous, an award-winning app featured on Lifehacker, the New York Times, Self, Forbes, GirlBoss, and more. We've empowered millions of people worldwide to change their lives for the better.
HOW IT WORKS
App includes a subscription. Pricing in different countries may vary, and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence. You can always see the exact price in the app. The subscription will automatically renew unless turned off in your App Store Account Settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. When you feel the Premium plan is not what you need, you can cancel your subscription at any time. 
-------
Read our full terms and conditions and our privacy policy at: https://www.thefabulous.co/terms.html

bluejetty:00064505:ios.description:
Starte das Investieren an der Börse oder bleib am Ball:
Richte kostenlos Watchlists oder Musterdepots mit Kursalarm ein. So kannst du ohne echten Geldeinsatz deine ersten Schritte an der Börse machen oder neue Anlagestrategien testen. Du erhältst aktuelle Aktienkurse & Börsen News zu deinen Favoriten und siehst schon vor Börsenstart die DAX Indikationen. Mit onvista hast du die wichtigsten Börsenkurse und Aktien News immer im Blick.
Investment-Chance gefunden? Handle ohne Wechsel zum Broker direkt über unsere Partner-Broker Wertpapiere in der onvista App.
Die onvista Börsen App bringt dich schnell und kompakt ganz nah an die Börse: mit Musterdepot, Watchlist, Kursalarmen und aktuellen Börsennachrichten.
Warum onvista?
Realtime und Xetra® Börsenkurse
Erhalte Realtime Börsenkurse für alle Wertpapiertypen wie Aktie, ETC oder ETN. So handelst du ohne Verzögerung. Echtzeit Kurse vom umsatzstärksten Börsenplatz Xetra® gibt es mit onvista Plus.
Experten-Analysen & Trading-Impulse
Fundierte Unternehmens- und Marktanalysen sowie Investment-Ideen von Börsen-Experten liefern Einordnung und Impulse für deine Handels-Entscheidungen mit Aktien, ETFs, Krypto und Co.
Watchlist
Beobachte Aktien, Anleihen, ETFs, Optionen, Zertifikate, Fonds und Rohstoffe übersichtlich in deinen Watchlists. So behältst du Aktienkurse, Aktien News, Finanzen und Märkte jederzeit im Blick.
Musterdepot
Mit den kostenlosen Musterdepots kannst du den Aktienhandel risikolos ausprobieren, echte Depot-Daten analysieren oder neue Aktien Strategien testen. Alle Finanz Daten werden automatisch zwischen der onvista Börsen App und Website synchronisiert. 
Kursalarm
Push-Benachrichtigungen informieren dich über erreichte Kurslimits, Kurs-Abweichungen von über 5 % in Musterdepots oder Watchlists sowie über relevante Aktiennews. So kannst du auf Kursveränderungen deiner Aktien, ETFs, Derivate & Co. schnell reagieren.
Top ETFs
Entdecke ETFs passend zu deinem Anlageziel und deiner Risikoneigung – z. B. auf MSCI World, DAX oder S&P 500, nach Regionen, Assetklassen oder Anlagethemen.
Sparpläne finden
Sieh direkt beim Wertpapier im Reiter „Sparplan“, ob Sparpläne (z.B. für den ETF MSCI World) verfügbar sind, welche Broker sie anbieten, und starte sofort mit dem Investieren.
Derivate Finder
Unser Derivate Finder ermöglicht dir eine schnelle Auswahl, Filterung und Sortierung von passenden Anlage- und Hebelprodukten (wie z.B. Index Zertifikate, Knock Out Optionen, Optionsscheine auf den DAX).
Handeln-Funktion
Verbinde deinen Broker einfach, sicher und ohne zusätzliche Gebühren. So kannst du ohne Wechsel zum Broker direkt in der onvista App über unsere Partner-Broker comdirect, Consorsbank, flatex, justTRADE, ViTrade und finanzen.net zero Aktien & Co. kaufen und verkaufen.
onvista Plus
Hole das volle Potential aus onvista heraus und schalte mit einem Plus-Abo weitere Funktionen in der App frei. Du erhältst damit Impulse für dein Depot, Echtzeit-Kurse für schnelle Entscheidungen und Zugang zu exklusiven Analysen.
Das Plus für dich:
• Echtzeitkurse für Deutsche Börse-Indizes (DAX®, MDAX®, TecDAX®), Handelsplatz Frankfurt (Frankfurter Parkett), Handelsplatz Xetra®
• Alle Plus-Artikel und Analysen lesen
• Exklusive Trading- und Investmentideen inkl. Experten-Musterdepots
• Experten-Watchlisten von weltbekannten Investoren
onvista Pro
Erhalte mit onvista Pro maximale Transparenz
• alle Börsen Funktionen und Analysen von onvista Plus
• Xetra® Orderbuch mit den 10 aktuellsten Geld- und Briefkursen in Echtzeit
Es handelt sich um kostenpflichtige Abos, die im Monatsabo monatlich gekündigt werden können.

Erhalte Realtime Börsenkurse für alle Wertpapiertypen wie Aktie, ETC oder ETN. So handelst du ohne Verzögerung. Echtzeit Kurse vom umsatzstärksten Börsenplatz Xetra® gibt es mit onvista Plus.

Experten-Analysen & Trading-Impulse
Fundierte Unternehmens- und Marktanalysen sowie Investment-Ideen von Börsen-Experten liefern  Einordnung und Impulse für deine Handels-Entscheidungen mit Aktien, ETFs, Krypto und Co.

Watchlist
Beobachte Aktien, Anleihen, ETFs, Optionen, Zertifikate, Fonds und Rohstoffe übersichtlich in deinen Watchlists. So behältst du Aktienkurse, Aktien News, Finanzen und Märkte jederzeit im Blick.

Musterdepot
Mit den kostenlosen Musterdepots kannst du den Aktienhandel risikolos ausprobieren, echte Depot-Daten analysieren oder neue Aktien Strategien testen. Alle Finanz Daten werden automatisch zwischen der onvista Börsen App und Website synchronisiert. 
Kursalarm
Push-Benachrichtigungen informieren dich über erreichte Kurslimits, Kurs-Abweichungen von über 5 % in Musterdepots oder Watchlists sowie über relevante Aktiennews. So kannst du auf Kursveränderungen deiner Aktien, ETFs, Derivate & Co. schnell reagieren.

Top ETFs
Entdecke ETFs passend zu deinem Anlageziel und deiner Risikoneigung – z. B. auf MSCI World, DAX oder S&P 500, nach Regionen, Assetklassen oder Anlagethemen.

Sparpläne finden
Sieh direkt beim Wertpapier im Reiter „Sparplan“, ob Sparpläne (z.B. für den ETF MSCI World) verfügbar sind, welche Broker sie anbieten, und starte sofort mit dem Investieren.

Derivate Finder
Unser Derivate Finder ermöglicht dir eine schnelle Auswahl, Filterung und Sortierung von passenden Anlage- und Hebelprodukten (wie z.B. Index Zertifikate, Knock Out Optionen, Optionsscheine auf den DAX).

Handeln-Funktion
Verbinde deinen Broker einfach, sicher und ohne zusätzliche Gebühren. So kannst du ohne Wechsel zum Broker direkt in der onvista App über unsere Partner-Broker comdirect, Consorsbank, flatex, justTRADE, ViTrade und finanzen.net zero Aktien & Co. kaufen und verkaufen.

onvista Plus

bluejetty:00138860:ios.summary:
SMARTER TRACKING FOR IMPACTFUL CHANGES

ZOZOFIT gives you a digital toolbox to take control of your fitness with real, measurable data – track body transformati
bluejetty:00138860:ios.description:
SMARTER TRACKING FOR IMPACTFUL CHANGES
Precise body measurements and AI-powered nutrition tracking, all in one place.
ZOZOFIT gives you a digital toolbox to take control of your fitness with real, measurable data – track body transformation, log your diet, and stay accountable with intuitive scanning and easy-to-use features.
YOU ARE MORE THAN JUST A NUMBER ON A SCALE
We know weight is only part of the picture. It doesn’t capture how your body composition evolves over time.
ZOZOFIT’s innovative features provide you with unparalleled access to valuable data and tools, giving you greater control over your body. Our app delivers valuable insights, including precise measurements, body fat percentage calculations, and metrics to help you thrive. See your body change visually through before-and-after comparison views and transformation videos. Plus, easily log your meals and track your nutrition to stay on top of your dietary goals to track everything in one place.
3D BODY SCANNING MADE EASY
In less than 2 minutes, ZOZOFIT scans your body to provide you with detailed body measurements for 16 key locations, as well as informative graphs so that you can track your fitness progress over time. Our data will keep you accountable and focused on your goals. The more you scan, the clearer your progress becomes.
ZOZOFIT FEATURES INCLUDE:
3D Measurements: Get a full-body, 360° view with measurements for 16 key areas.
Side-by-Side: Compare two scans to visualize your body’s transformation.
BodyMorph (NEW!): Turn your scans into a shareable video – bring your progress to life and share your transformation.
ColorMetric: Visualize changes with color gradients – amber for growth, teal for reduction.
Goal Setting: Set measurement goals for specific body areas and track progress.
Goal Simulator: Envision changes by adjusting inches on key areas to see potential results.
HealthKit Integration: Sync Apple Health data for a complete fitness overview.
Booty Mode: Track key glute metrics (lift, fullness, and shape) over time.
Food Journal: Track meals with AI – snap a photo, scan a label, or log manually.
My Body Stats: Access detailed body metrics and download PDF progress reports.
Weekly Recap: Review highlights and achievements across ZOZOFIT and other Apple Health metrics.
Posture Mode: Assess 8 key posture points to track alignment from front and side views.
Tailor Mode: Find your precise clothing size with confidence using accurate body measurements.
Available on select iPhone devices. Recommended iOS 18.6 or later.
Recommended devices include:
• Phone 14 and later models
• iPhone 13 Pro Max
• iPhone 13 Pro
• iPhone 12 Pro Max
• iPhone 12 Pro
Looking for support?
Visit zozofit.com to browse FAQs, troubleshooting tips, or to contact our support team.

bluejetty:00141356:ios.description:

WHAT IS GENSMO?
Gensmo is your AI-powered shopping magic box — filled with smart tools for every fashion moment, making everything easier, more intuitive, and more you.
HOW TO PLAY WITH GENSMO?
• Snap to Shop
See something you love? Upload any photo — Gensmo instantly turns it into shoppable outfits that match your vibe, style, and budget.
• Virtual Try On
Wonder how you or your friends would look in that outfit? Upload a photo to instantly generate a realistic AI avatar and see how any clothing or accessory looks on you.
• Style an Item
Got a piece you love? Gensmo builds full AI outfits around it — tops, shoes, jackets, and accessories that complete the look.
• Animate Your Looks
See how an outfit truly moves on you. Generate a natural walk or full-turn video to get the most realistic preview before you buy.
• Couple Try-On
Curious how you and your partner would look together? Upload two photos to generate photorealistic couple try-on looks for trips, events, holidays, and more.
• Xmas Gift List Planner
Not sure what to get for everyone this season? Gensmo recommends AI-curated gifts based on each person’s style, helps you manage budgets, and keeps your whole holiday gift plan on track in real time.
• Discover & Share Fashion Ideas
Explore a global fashion feed styled by real users. Remix looks you like, try them on instantly, or share your own. Inspiration becomes action.
• Shop by Brands
Browse thousands of brands in one seamless shopping experience. Explore collections, remix styles, and shop full outfits with one tap.
WHY GENSMO?
• Complete outfit solutions — not just product lists.
• Personalized AI styling that fits your body, vibe, and budget.
• Visual in, visual out, powered by fashion-native AI.
Download Gensmo and let your Super Shopping Agent handle the rest!

bluejetty:00044852:ios.description:
San José 311!
San José 311 is a service request system brought to you by the City of San Jose. The application allows you to submit, track and explore a variety of city service requests. These requests are forwarded through to the relevant city service team to accept, review, update and resolve.
You can submit requests anonymously or sign in with an account. We highly recommend creating an account as you will then gain access to enhanced features and experience a more personalized service. 
Service requests can be logged with photos, categorized and placed on a map. You can also search current requests and follow them if you want updates and notifications.
The application contains a detailed Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) section to assist you in navigating through our many city services.
Neighborhood Services provides easy and instant access to your street sweeping, waste collection, neighborhood cleanup and water service provider.
We hope you enjoy using and exploring San José 311 and thank you for your assistance in keeping San Jose great!

bluejetty:00069028:ios.description:
Play Word Lock for 10 minutes a day to sharpen your mind, improve your vocabulary, and relax your brain.
Word Lock is a completely unique logic word game. It mixes the best elements of crosswords, word searches, and anagram puzzles into one beautiful, addictive experience. Instead of a traditional board, you will move and shift columns of letters, just like a combination lock to find the hidden words!
Challenge yourself to find the correct letter combinations and see if you can solve all the word puzzles. The game starts easy but quickly gets more challenging as you progress! Escape stress, train your brain, and never have a boring moment again.
HOW TO PLAY
• Slide the columns up and down to find the correct letter combinations.
• Align the letters in the center to find all the hidden words and complete the level.
• Use hints if you get stuck on a difficult puzzle.
FEATURES
• Unique Gameplay: A fresh mix of crosswords, word connect, and anagrams!
• Thousands of Levels: Endless puzzles to keep your brain active.
• Daily Challenges: Come back every day for new, unique word puzzles!
• Progressive Difficulty: Starts easy, but gets challenging fast.
• Offline Mode: 100% free and can always be played offline without WiFi.
• Beautiful Design: Clean UI and relaxing backgrounds to ease your mind.
LANGUAGES
• English
• Català
• Dansk
• Deutsch
• Español
• Français
• Indonesia
• Italiano
• Nederlands
• Norsk
• Suomi
• Svenska
If you enjoy classic word search games, logic puzzles, or anagrams, you are going to love the completely new mechanics of Word Lock. Download today and start training your brain!

bluejetty:00126155:ios.description:
Build your space empire - your way.
My Colony 2 is a next-generation 3D space colony simulator and city builder. Construct sprawling cities on alien worlds, manage resources, form alliances, and explore new frontiers in a fully moddable sandbox environment.
Whether you're playing solo or online in real-time multiplayer, the future of your colony is in your hands.
- Design and shape massive 3D colonies block-by-block in real time.
- Team up with other players online, collaborate on cities, or compete across worlds.
- Communicate instantly with friends or colony mates without leaving the game.
- Trade resources in a live peer-to-peer marketplace. Build your fortune or fuel your empire.
- Walk around your colony as a citizen, explore your creation up close, and even interact with the world directly.
- Create your own content right in the game. New buildings, maps, vehicles, and mechanics are just a few clicks away.
With no required server setup, easy mod creation, and support for a growing community of creators, My Colony 2 is more than just a game - it's a living platform for creativity, strategy, and discovery.
Download now and start building your future among the stars.

bluejetty:00045737:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00045737:ios.description:
MyCarePlan is a personal self-care app that will help you 
prepare for your appointments with your providers. 
PREPARE FOR YOUR APPOINTMENTS
Fill out forms, sign documents and pay your copay from home. This will speed up your check-in process at the office and save you time.
If you are scheduled for a procedure then you can follow instructions in the app and it will tell you step-by-step what you need to do at home to prepare.
SHARE DATA WITH YOUR DOCTOR
If your doctor wants to know more about how you are doing at home, then you can use the app to share vitals and observations about your health. This gives your doctor better insight in your health and helps you to get the best treatment and advice.
MESSAGE WITH YOUR PROVIDERS
Whether you have a question for your doctor, the nurse or any other staff members you can easily send a secure message to the office using the app.
When you send a message, it is sent in a closed and secure environment to the office and you will be notified instantly when a reply is available.
If your doctor is sending you a message, for instance, with lab results this also appears on the app where you can read it right away.
No more waiting on the phone trying to get through to the office - you can now message securely with your doctor from your phone.
REMEMBER YOUR TO-DOs
It is one thing to have an overview of the tasks that one should complete to stay healthy - it is another to remember them all! 
This is where your personal To-Do list comes into play. This tool shows you what tasks that you have to do as well as when and sends you a notification to remind you when it is time. 
The To-Do list is based on the data in your Care Plan and combines all of your information, such as doctor appointments and medication refills, in one platform to make it convenient and easy to remember the important things about your health. 
Whether it is to remind you to take your medication, exercise or monitor your vitals, an automatic notification will be sent to you ten minutes prior to the hour that the task is due.
SHARE DATA WITH YOUR HEALTH CARD
If you are visiting a new doctor you can share your medical records by showing the doctor your Health Card on the app.
The Health Card can be used by any doctor worldwide and is a secure and easy way for you to bring your medical records with you wherever you go.
WORKS WITH YOUR DOCTOR'S SYSTEMS
MyCarePlan works seamlessly with your doctor's systems and will automatically be updated with data and recommendations from your doctor.
All recommendations from your doctors will automatically appear on the app giving you an overview of when to check in with your health provider, as well as the aspects of your health that you can monitor at home. This includes measuring your blood pressure as well as taking your medication.
When you add data to the app your doctor can access the data making it possible for him to optimize treatment and help you in between office visits

bluejetty:00159859:ios.description:
Need office cleaning service or home cleaning service in your area? Welcome to MaidsApp, which is designed to help you get local cleaning services! Say goodbye to booking advance appointments. Request for professional cleaners near you to arrive within less than 4 hours. Get maid services quicker than you can think of!
MaidsApp is designed to help you find professional maids online and get home cleaning services. We have a list of professional cleaners with reviews given by other customers, which makes it easy for you to choose them for cleaning your apartments. Whether you want home cleaning services or office cleaning services, we’ve extended our services to both residential and office spaces!
Why MaidsApp?
Do you’ve a messy situation in your home and you want professional cleaners? MaidsApp has got you covered! You just have to download it and request a cleaning specialist near you; that’s it!
+ All professional cleaners arrive within 2 hours - 4 hours
+ Cleaning services are extended for both office and residential spaces
+ Any of the maids who enter a customer’s house are screened every time
+ All service professionals go through a screening process for security purposes
+ Upon completion of cleaning service, customers can provide feedback to the service provider
How does MaidsApp work?
+ Install MaidsApp
+ Sign up easily with your email or sign up with Facebook
+ Find out about professional cleaners near you
+ Get on-demand maid services or schedule them 
+ Multiple cleaning options: Quick Clean, Basic Clean, and Deep Clean
+ Let the maid arrive in less than 4 hours. Give her a walk-through of the apartment. Give her the assignment, and once you’re 100% satisfied, she will mark the order complete!
+ You can also leave feedback on the maid profile once she marks the order complete!
So, what are you waiting for? Download MaidsApp now to get the best home cleaning services ever! Find professional cleaners quicker than you can think of!

You’re One Step Closer to Free Costa
Get more of the coffee and treats you love, for free. Collect beans with the official Costa Club UAE app, then exchange them for free barista-made coffees drinks. It’s easy to use. Just scan the app barcode in store to earn beans on your purchases and build up your ‘bean credit’ ‘til you can redeem your beans for rewards. 
What else is new? Well, now you can order and pick up in store. No more queues. Simply click and collect. 
Ready to update? Follow the instructions below. 
Let’s get started:
 1. Download the app, register and you’ll get 2,000 beans after your first transaction (That’s a FREE barista-made drink).
 2. Earn beans on almost everything purchased in-store by scanning the QR code at the till point.
 3. View your earned beans on the home screen - and watch them grow.
 4. Once you earn 2,000 beans, you’ll get a free barista-made drink. 
 5. Happy birthday to you. Now you get 2,000 beans to redeem for a free drink on your big day.
The Costa Club UAE app is only available for use in Costa Coffee stores across the UAE.

Get more of the coffee and treats you love, for free.  Collect beans with the official Costa Club UAE app, then exchange them for free barista-made coffees drinks.  It’s easy to use. Just scan the app barcode in store to earn beans on your purchases and build up your ‘bean credit’ ‘til you can redeem your beans for rewards. 

What else is new? Well, now you can order and pick up in store. No more queues. Simply click and collect. 

Ready to update? Follow the instructions below. 

Let’s get started:
      1. Download the app, register and you’ll get 2,000 beans after your first transaction (That’s a FREE barista-made  drink).
      2. Earn beans on almost everything purchased in-store by scanning the QR code at the till point.
      3. View your earned beans on the home screen - and watch them grow.
      4. Once you earn 2,000 beans, you’ll get a free barista-made  drink. 
      5. Happy birthday to you. Now you get 2,000 beans to redeem for a free drink on your big day.

The Costa Club UAE app is only available for use in Costa Coffee stores across the UAE.

bluejetty:00152106:ios.description:
YOUR LISTS. ALWAYS IN SYNC. EVERYONE UPDATED INSTANTLY.
Listshare is the simplest way to share lists with the people you live with. Groceries, chores, meal plans, events - one list, always current, on every device.
No more "I didn't see your message." No more buying milk twice. No more arguments about whose turn it is to clean.
HOW IT WORKS
Create a list. Invite your family, flatmates, or friends. Start adding items. Changes sync instantly - when someone checks off the bread at the shop, everyone sees it in real time.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
Drag & drop to reorder items and categories. Assign items to specific people so everyone knows who's responsible. Add due dates and priorities when things need to get done by a certain time. Track everything with a full activity history - see who added what, who completed it, and when.
Organise with colour-coded categories. Share lists instantly via QR code, link, or invite code. Works offline and syncs when you're back online.
YOUR DASHBOARD
See activity across all your lists in one place. Know what's been added, completed, or assigned without opening every list individually.
LISTSHARE PLUS
The free version gives you 3 lists and 6 categories - enough to get started. Plus unlocks up to 50 lists, 24 categories per list, and 365 days of detailed history.
PERFECT FOR
Shared grocery and shopping lists. Household chores and cleaning rotas. Meal planning. Holiday and event prep. Moving house. Group trips. Gift ideas. Watchlists for books, films, and places to visit.
THE DETAILS
Real-time push notifications keep everyone in the loop. Clean, modern design with light and dark mode. Available in English and Spanish. Built with accessibility in mind. Your data is protected with enterprise-grade security.
Download Listshare and stop arguing about the shopping.
Migrating from the previous Listshare? Automatic data migration and free Plus benefits for existing premium users.
Payment terms & conditions + privacy policy is available at https://listshareapp.com/legal

bluejetty:00146198:ios.description:
Home is where the really good design is. Since 1962, we’ve been your trusted source for quality-crafted modern classics designed for how you live today. Couples register for the perfect dinnerware for any occasion; families shop for the clean-lined sofa where they’ll all unwind at the end of the day. 
Curated by our team from around the world, our beautiful decor, must-have kitchen tools, handcrafted rugs, favorite bedding and so much are here to complete your home. Plus, we’re leading the way with more responsible materials and sustainable sourcing. 
Fully refreshed with the latest functionality and a stunning new look, the Crate & Barrel and Crate&kids app is the easiest, fastest way to shop our brands. 
What you’ll love about our app. 
-Easy & intuitive shopping as you explore our complete collection of furniture, decor, housewares, bedding, rugs, kids’ items and more. 
-Access to exclusive items you’ll only find here. 
-Create and order custom upholstery with 200+ fabric and finish options.
-The most complete product details and features, including our View In Your Room AR tool, product videos, the ability to find out if an item is displayed at your local store, care information and more.
-Order and pay with a credit or debit card, Apple Pay or your Crate & Barrel Credit Card. You can even redeem Crate gift cards on the app. 
-Sign in or create an account to shop personalized products and recommendations. 
-Create lists of favorites and save them to review later on our app, website or in-store. 
-Save contact and payment information for faster, easier checkout. 
-Find your nearest Crate & Barrel store and get hours and directions, or call directly. 
-Easy curbside or in-store order pickup—including gift orders—at your local Crate & Barrel store. 
-Eligible Wedding Registry and Design Trade Program members can access discount information in your account and see it automatically applied at checkout. 
Your registry on our app. 
-Easily create and edit your wedding registry, gift registry or baby registry. 
-Get real-time alerts when gifts are purchased from your registry. 
-Scan barcodes in-store to easily see product information and options & add to your registry or wishlist.

bluejetty:00068833:ios.description:
The ultimate ABC learning adventure for babies, toddlers, and kids!
Jumpstart your child's language skills with ABC Alphabet Flash Cards Games. This comprehensive app combines alphabet flash cards, engaging games, and phonics to make learning letters and words a blast. With endless alphabet fun and over 18 vocabulary-building categories, your child will be reading in no time!
KEY FEATURES •
# ABC Flashcards: Vibrant flashcards introduce letters, sounds, and pictures.
# ABC Game Variety: Keep learning exciting with matching games, balloon pop, quizzes, shadow puzzles, and - spelling challenges.
# Phonics Focus: Reinforce letter-sound relationships for confident reading.
# 18 Vocabulary Categories: Expand vocabulary with themes like animals, food, shapes, and more.
# Endless Alphabet Fun: New content keeps your child engaged and learning.
# Toddler-Friendly Interface: Simple navigation designed for little hands.
# Offline Play: Learn anytime, anywhere – no Wi-Fi needed!!
# No third-party Advertisements.
THE PERFECT CHOICE FOR PARENT & EDUCATORS:
# Effective ABC Flash Cards: Flashcards designed to captivate young learners and spark their curiosity about letters and words.
# Entertaining ABC Games: Games that seamlessly blend education and fun, making learning a joyful experience for children.
# Comprehensive ABC Learning: A holistic approach to alphabet learning that encompasses letter recognition, phonics, and vocabulary building.
# Alphabet Games for All Ages: Activities suitable for a wide range of ages and abilities, ensuring continued learning and growth.
WHY CHOOSE ABC Alphabet Flash Cards APP?
- Designed for Toddlers: Easy-to-use interface and age-appropriate content.
- Educational & Entertaining: Combines learning with fun to keep toddlers engaged.
- Offline Play: Enjoy learning anywhere, anytime, even without an internet connection.
- Safe & Ad-Free: A worry-free environment for your child's screen time.
- Trusted by Parents: A top choice for early childhood education.

bluejetty:00032412:ios.description:
ShelfPlayer is a powerful iOS app for listening to audiobooks and podcasts, built for people who run their own self-hosted Audiobookshelf libraries. Written in Swift 6 for iOS 18+, it's fast, privacy-respecting, and deeply integrated with the Apple ecosystem.
ShelfPlayer does not include any media content. A running Audiobookshelf instance is required to use the app.
Why Choose ShelfPlayer?
- One app for everything: A single native experience for audiobooks, podcasts, episodes, authors, narrators, series, collections, and playlists
- Connect your own libraries: Works with multiple Audiobookshelf servers and libraries at the same time
- Flexible sign-in: Supports both username/password and OpenID, plus custom HTTP headers for advanced setups
- Find anything fast: Global and per-library search across books, podcasts, people, series, and episodes
- Stay in sync: Listening progress and sessions stay synchronized with your Audiobookshelf server
- Made for Apple devices: Native iPhone and iPad layouts, CarPlay, Siri, Shortcuts, Spotlight, Home Screen widgets, Live Activities, and Dynamic Island
Features at a glance:
- Listen Now to continue and discover content across connected libraries
- Chapter navigation with quick-access controls in playback
- Configurable skip intervals for forward and backward jumps
- AirPlay and native Apple media controls
- Bookmarks with optional notes to save key moments
- Detailed, item-level listening history and daily listening goals
- Offline mode with manual and automatic background downloads
- Built-in tools to create, edit, and organize collections and playlists
- In-app PDF viewer for attached documents
- Customizable tabs, sorting, and filters
Premium features
ShelfPlayer subscription unlocks the following:
- Offline listening: Download audiobooks and episodes and keep listening without a connection
- Custom playback speed: Adjust the rate beyond the default 1×
- Flexible sleep timer: Choose any duration or a chapter-based timer, beyond the default 5 minutes
- Bookmarks: Save and revisit key moments with notes
- Add to queue: Build your own listening order with the main and Up Next queues
- Statistics: Track your listening time, streaks, and finished titles
Download ShelfPlayer today and get the most out of your Audiobookshelf library!
Subscribe to access premium app features; subscription details are the following:
- Length: weekly or yearly
- Free trial: only on selected subscriptions
- Your payment will be charged to your Apple Account as soon as you confirm your purchase
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Account Settings after the purchase
- Your subscription will renew automatically, unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- The cost of renewal will be charged to your account in the 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
- When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription

bluejetty:00128574:ios.description:

bluejetty:00033710:ios.description:
Buyee makes buying from online Japanese stores easier than ever!  With this one app, you can make purchases from Japanese online stores and auction sites.  JDirectItems Shopping and Auction, Rakuten, ZOZOTOWN, and many more famous Japanese shops are supported.  Search, view, buy, pay, and ship all through the app.  You can combine packages, selecting the shipping method, and handle fees as well.
■Check Out Japan's Most Popular Stores!
Through the Buyee app, you can buy goods from more than 30 online stores including JDirectItems Shopping and Auction, Rakuten, and ZOZOTOWN.  You can even combine packages from multiple stores and send them as one!
■Buy Anything from Auction Websites!
Buyee is officially partnered with JDirectItems Auction, ensuring safe and easy purchasing.  Receive notifications about price changes, place sniper bids, and manage your watchlist with special features only available with Buyee.  Whether you're looking for exclusive anime and game merch, unique handmade items, antiques, or high-quality sake, you'll find bargains that are completely unparalleled.  No matter what you want, you'll be able to bid on it thanks to Buyee.
■Never Miss Price Updates!
Buyee's app lets your monitor price changes, bids, package shipping status, and more through helpful push notifications.  Of course, you can turn these off in the settings if you would prefer.
■Buy What You Want Without Worries!
Most credit cards, Paypal, and Alipay are all supported.  Your purchases or bids are handled safely and securely.
■Warranties and Package Inspection
Package inspection, shipping warranties, and other methods to ensure the security of your package are offered.  Chose which options suit your needs!
■Multiple Shipping and Handling Fee Options
EMS, air shipping, economy air, surface shipping, UPS, DHL, and more are part of the many different options available to customers.
*Please note that some options may be limited based on the country to which the package is being shipped.
■Customer Support in Multiple Languages!
Buyee's excellent customer support team can handle cases in English, Chinese (both simplified and traditional), and Japanese.  You can even correspond with our team via chat!

bluejetty:00097859:android.summary: Dive into the world destroyed by nuclear war! Survive, if you can, among the mutants, radiation, hunger and bloodthirsty enemies in post-apocalyptic world. Survival Nuclear Sunset is not so easy. Think first of all about yourself, but do no
bluejetty:00097859:android.description:
Dive into the world destroyed by nuclear war! Survive, if you can, among the mutants, radiation, hunger and bloodthirsty enemies in post-apocalyptic world. Survival Nuclear Sunset is not so easy. Think first of all about yourself, but do not forget about your fellow survivors, who were also unlucky in this apocalypse. Full freedom of action, a lot of quests, as well as a big world full of dangers, hiding places, secrets… A lot of useful things are placed inside abandoned houses.
Common life turned into true survival after nuclear war. Apocalypse destroyed modern civilization, but not humanity. There is a long story about life in destroy. People left cities, because they were polluted by radiation.
You are just another survivor, but you have no community, because you woke up in the forest among deadzone and even didn’t remember your name. Get up and try to stay alive! You can do it even offline.
Nuclear Sunset - survival action game with shooter elements about doom world, where your common target is to survive. There are four locations with very different content. Some of the places were inspired by real radioactive locations in Chernobyl abandoned deadzone. Village is the zone, which is controlled by your fellows, some of which give you quests. Forest - location without people, but full of wolves, that will try to kill everyone. Your duty is to protect your camp from hostile community, which bases on swamp. Also there is a very weak frontier between your camp and forest full of beasts. Night's hostile beasts are attacking the camps, but after dawn enemy hunters try to penetrate the village. 
A lot of survival elements are in this post apocalypse game, although it has much more other interestings things. You will get quests from your community members, when you should make different types of activities - to protect your comrades, find useful things. Some of these quests are connected with a story that sometimes has unpredictable turns. 
Use all that remains after the nuclear war that happened 50 years ago. This survival offline game has a lot of weapons - knives, axes, bows, crossbows, and even firearms. You have an ability to change your way of passing quests: using melee weapons, shooting from handmade guns or sniper manner. But do not think that everything is easy to get. To get really good weapons and armor, you will need to buy them. It’s needed to improve your equipment to survive. Earn local post apocalypse currency - matchboxes, performing tasks, hunting and trading with your fellow tribesmen. Good luck at nuclear battlegrounds.
As it was said before, there are a lot of hiding places, which contain useful things. You can research abandoned houses, vehicles and wastelands to find things that need for survival or you can just sell it. Four big locations, where you will complete your quests, are full of caches in hiding furniture, bags and boxes.
Nuclear Sunset is a survival game in the post-apocalyptic world with numerous dangers such as contagion, killing wild beasts, mad humans and closed radioactive deadzone. It works offline. Your fellows, who outlast in this badlands, left their camp only in daylight. And you must too! You can sleep in the camp. Also you’ll find there tribesmen, with whom you can trade. Story revolves around war between two communities that fight for fertile land and safe buildings.
Apocalypse turned all people into enemies. But there is a chance Nuclear Sunset will change to normal dawn.
Don’t keep the attention to overcome this crucible post apocalypse! Download this survival game! Pull the trigger and try not to die!

bluejetty:00019475:ios.name: Super Mario Run
bluejetty:00019475:ios.summary:
A new kind of Mario game that you can play with one hand.
You control Mario by tapping as he constantly runs forward. You time your taps to pull off stylish jumps, midair spins, and wall jumps to gather coins and reach the goal!
Super Mar
bluejetty:00019475:ios.description:
A new kind of Mario game that you can play with one hand.
You control Mario by tapping as he constantly runs forward. You time your taps to pull off stylish jumps, midair spins, and wall jumps to gather coins and reach the goal!
Super Mario Run can be downloaded for free and after you purchase the game, you will be able to play all the modes with no additional payment required. You can try out all four modes before purchase: World Tour, Toad Rally, Remix 10, and Kingdom Builder.
■World Tour
Run and jump with style to rescue Princess Peach from Bowser’s clutches! 
Travel through plains, caverns, ghost houses, airships, castles, and more.
Clear the 24 exciting courses to rescue Princess Peach from Bowser, waiting in his castle at the end. There are many ways to enjoy the courses, such as collecting the 3 different types of colored coins or by competing for the highest score against your friends. You can try courses 1-1 to 1-4 for free.
After rescuing Princess Peach, a nine-course special world, World Star, will appear.
■Remix 10
Some of the shortest Super Mario Run courses you'll ever play!
This mode is Super Mario Run in bite-sized bursts! You'll play through 10 short courses one after the other, with the courses changing each time you play. Daisy is lost somewhere in Remix 10, so try to clear as many courses as you can to find her!
■Toad Rally
Show off Mario’s stylish moves, compete against your friends, and challenge people from all over the world.
In this challenge mode, the competition differs each time you play.
Compete against the stylish moves of other players for the highest score as you gather coins and get cheered on by a crowd of Toads. Fill the gauge with stylish moves to enter Coin Rush Mode to get more coins. If you win the rally, the cheering Toads will come live in your kingdom, and your kingdom will grow. 
■Kingdom Builder
Gather coins and Toads to build your very own kingdom.
Combine different buildings and decorations to create your own unique kingdom. There are over 100 kinds of items in Kingdom Builder mode. If you get more Toads in Toad Rally, the number of buildings and decorations available will increase. With the help of the friendly Toads you can gradually build up your kingdom.
■What You Can Do After Purchasing All Worlds
・ All courses in World Tour are playable
Why not try out the bigger challenges and thrills available in all courses?
・ Easier to get Rally Tickets
It's easier to get Rally Tickets that are needed to play Remix 10 and Toad Rally. You can collect them in Kingdom Builder through Bonus Game Houses and ? Blocks, by collecting colored coins in World Tour, and more.
・ More playable characters
If you rescue Princess Peach by completing course 6-4 and build homes for Luigi, Yoshi, and Toadette in Kingdom Builder mode, you can get them to join your adventures as playable characters. They play differently than Mario, so why not put their special characteristics to good use in World Tour and Toad Rally?
・ More courses in Toad Rally
The types of courses available in Toad Rally will increase to seven different types of courses, expanding the fun! Along with the new additions, Purple and Yellow Toads may also come to cheer for you.
・ More buildings and decorations in Kingdom Builder
The types of buildings available will increase, so you'll be able to make your kingdom even more lively. You can also place Rainbow Bridges to expand your kingdom.
・ Play Remix 10 without having to wait
You can play Remix 10 continuously, without having to wait between each game.
*Internet connectivity required to play. Data charges may apply. May contain advertisements.

bluejetty:00149390:ios.name: Alert Valley Metro®
bluejetty:00149390:ios.summary:
Alert Valley Metro® (Alert VM®): Free Safety and Security Mobile App for Riders
The Alert Valley Metro® Safety and Security App offers riders a quick and discreet method for reporting safety and security concerns directly to the police. Ap
bluejetty:00149390:ios.description:
Alert Valley Metro® (Alert VM®): Free Safety and Security Mobile App for Riders
The Alert Valley Metro® Safety and Security App offers riders a quick and discreet method for reporting safety and security concerns directly to the police. App users can send photos, six second video, text descriptions, and locations of suspicious people or activities. From the home screen, users have two easy options for contacting the police:
* The “Report an Issue” button allows users to send text or photos directly to the police. To ensure discretion, the camera flash is automatically disabled when photos are taken through the app. When reporting an issue, users can select locations and report categories to assist the police. Riders can also send reports anonymously if they chose.
* The “Call 911” button will connect customers directly the police.
The application is designed for robust operation even under conditions of poor signal strength. If you send a report from an area without cellular/Wi-Fi connectivity, it will be stored and sent when connectivity returns. The system is also designed to send text descriptions before photos so that the police can get information as quickly as possible.
Additional Features:
BOLO (Be On the Look Out) Alerts. BOLO Alerts on Alert Valley Metro may display alerts from the police about specific persons of interest. For example, Alert Valley Metro may display information about a missing person or child, such as where they were last seen. If you see a person from a BOLO, immediately call 9-1-1 and send an app report discreetly.
Help keep Valley Metro safe, "See Something, Say Something"

bluejetty:00070500:ios.summary: Did you enjoy our earlier sorting puzzles? Sort Em All brings you a fresh sequel with a new neon-style look and more engaging, challenging levels.This ball sorting puzzle game is designed to test your logic, focus, and problem-solving skill
bluejetty:00070500:ios.description:
Did you enjoy our earlier sorting puzzles? Sort Em All brings you a fresh sequel with a new neon-style look and more engaging, challenging levels.This ball sorting puzzle game is designed to test your logic, focus, and problem-solving skills. Your goal is simple but tricky: sort balls by color so that each tube contains balls of only one color. As levels progress, puzzles become more complex and require careful planning.
How to Play
 • Tap a tube to move the top ball into another tube
 • Only balls of the same color can be placed together
 • You cannot add balls to a tube once it is full
 • Restart a level anytime or use Undo to retrace your steps
 • Stack all balls of the same color into a single tube
 • Add an extra tube if you get stuck
 • Plan ahead and create your own strategy to solve each puzzle
Game Features
 • Simple one-finger controls
 • No time limits — play at your own pace
 • Unlimited levels to challenge your brain
 • Play offline, no internet required
 • Improves logic, focus, and concentration
 • Easy to learn, hard to master gameplay
 • Free and enjoyable for all ages
 • Perfect game to pass time and sharpen your mind
If you enjoy logic puzzles and color sorting challenges, Sort Em All is made for you. Download now, think smart, sort wisely, and solve every puzzle!
If you enjoy the game, please leave us an honest review and rate us on the App Store — your support means a lot to us.

bluejetty:00146240:ios.summary:
Laveer – Your Self-Discovery Guide
Some days you act against your own values without realizing it. You make decisions you later regret. You misjudge people. You fall for the same patterns. Laveer helps you see why - and change it.
Laveer
bluejetty:00146240:ios.description:
Laveer – Your Self-Discovery Guide
Some days you act against your own values without realizing it. You make decisions you later regret. You misjudge people. You fall for the same patterns. Laveer helps you see why - and change it.
Laveer is a guided self-discovery app that helps you understand who you are, what you actually value, and how to make decisions you're proud of. Not through generic affirmations or mood tracking - but through structured reflection that draws on centuries of human wisdom, made practical for everyday life.
WHAT YOU'LL DISCOVER
Most people go through life reacting. Laveer helps you start choosing - deliberately, clearly, and with real self-awareness.
Uncover your core values - not the ones you think you have, but the ones that actually drive you
Identify your personal virtues and where you're living by them (or not)
Recognize the biases and mental shortcuts that quietly shape every decision you make
Understand the people around you better - their motivations, their fears, their reasoning
Think more clearly by learning to spot manipulation, logical traps, and self-deception before they take hold
Make decisions you can stand behind — even the hard ones
THIS ISN'T THERAPY. IT'S SELF-KNOWLEDGE.
Laveer isn't about feeling better in the moment. It's about becoming someone who handles moments better. Each session is a short, guided conversation - part reflection, part challenge - designed to surface something real about how you think and who you're becoming.
The questions are drawn from the same traditions that shaped the world's most resilient, clear-headed thinkers. Stoics who led empires. Philosophers who rewired how we see reality. Psychologists who mapped the mind. We've made their methods approachable, honest, and surprisingly direct.
WHO IT'S FOR
You don't need a crisis to use Laveer. You need curiosity and a little courage.
You've made the same mistake twice and want to understand why
You feel like you're living someone else's version of your life
You want to make a big decision and trust yourself to get it right
You suspect your thinking has blind spots you can't quite name
You want to understand the people around you - not just tolerate them
YOUR DATA. YOUR SPACE.
Everything is private, encrypted, and deletable.
A subscription unlocks the full experience, with a 7-day free trial on the annual plan.
Terms of Use: https://laveer.ai/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://laveer.ai/privacy-policy
Contact: team@laveer.ai

bluejetty:00062766:ios.description:
◆ Play Like a Real Piano with 88 Keys
Play a full 88-key piano on your smartphone or tablet, just like a grand piano. Simply tap to create beautiful piano sounds - no musical experience required.
Adjust the key size to fit small hands for children or full-size practice for adults. Scroll quickly to access all 88 keys.
◆ Enjoy 128 Different Instruments
Not just piano! Easily switch to your favorite instrument in settings.
[128 Instrument Sounds]
• Piano: Grand Piano, Electric Piano, Harpsichord
• Organ: Church Organ, Rock Organ, Accordion
• Guitar: Acoustic Guitar, Electric Guitar
• Strings: Violin, Cello, String Ensemble
• Brass: Trumpet, Trombone, French Horn
• Percussion: Music Box, Vibraphone, Marimba, Xylophone
• Others: Bass, Harmonica, and more
Find your favorite sound and enjoy your original performance.
◆ Record and Track Your Progress
Record your performances and play them back anytime. Listening to yourself objectively helps you feel your improvement and stay motivated.
Save multiple recordings to track your daily practice progress.
◆ Practice with Metronome & Rhythm
[Metronome]
• Freely set BPM from 20 to 240
• Supports 2/4, 3/4, 4/4, 6/8 time signatures
• Practice with accurate tempo
[8 Rhythm Patterns]
• 8 Beat (Rock)
• 16 Beat (Funk)
• 4 on the Floor (EDM)
• Jazz Swing
• Bossa Nova
• Samba
• Reggae
• Shuffle (Blues)
Play along with drums for a band-like experience! Practice is fun even when you're alone.
◆ 8 Color Themes to Match Your Style
• Classic (standard black & white)
• Matcha
• Sakura
• Chocolate
• Indigo
• Halloween
• Christmas
• Ocean
Change the keyboard colors to match the season or your mood.
◆ Note Labels for Beginners
Display note names on the keys:
• CDEFGAB (Western notation)
• Do Re Mi (Solfège)
• No labels
Even if you struggle reading sheet music, note labels make playing easy.
◆ Perfect For
• Those who want to try before taking piano lessons
• Playing during commute or travel
• Parents teaching children the joy of music
• Songwriting and arrangement ideas
• Stress relief through music
• Anyone looking for a simple keyboard app
◆ Additional Features
• Multi-touch support: Play multiple keys at once (the number of simultaneous touches recognized depends on your device)
• Silent mode support: Play sounds even in silent mode
• 34 languages supported: Available worldwide
• Ad-free option: Watch a video to hide banner ads for 2 days
• Simple, intuitive design: Easy for anyone to use
◆ Easy to Get Started
All essential features are included. Download and start playing right away.
Start your musical journey today!
◆ Contact Us
If you have any feedback or requests, please contact us through the app settings. We look forward to hearing from you.

bluejetty:00060954:ios.name: Bangkok Bank Mobile Banking
bluejetty:00060954:ios.summary:
With the Bangkok Bank Mobile Banking app, your banking transactions are more convenient with these features:
• View all types of deposits, credit cards, mutual funds, government bonds and Bualuang loan accounts
• Request Thai baht and FCD
bluejetty:00060954:ios.description:
With the Bangkok Bank Mobile Banking app, your banking transactions are more convenient with these features:
• View all types of deposits, credit cards, mutual funds, government bonds and Bualuang loan accounts
• Request Thai baht and FCD account statements
• Open an e-Savings account
• Make cardless withdrawals at Bangkok Bank and KBank ATM and Banking Agents (7-Eleven, Thailand Post offices, Sabuy Counter and TermDee kiosk)
• Invest in mutual funds, government bonds and corporate debentures
• Make a Bualuang home loan payment and request the Bank to submit housing loan information to the Revenue Department for a convenient tax deduction claim
• Add a Foreign Currency Deposit Account (FCD) and transfer funds to your own FCD account
• Make an international funds transfer via SWIFT with 18 currencies for 135 countries
• Make an international funds transfer to Singapore via PromptPay International
• Send and receive money to or from more than 200 countries via Western Union
• Buy insurance and check my policies
• Check the balance of and top up your Rabbit LINE Pay and view BTS trip history
• Apply for and manage the following banking services:
- Request and activate a debit card
- Apply for a Bangkok Bank Credit Card – choose the card that fits your lifestyle then upload the relevant documents and check your approval status in the app 
- Request to open a Securities Trading Account with Bualuang Securities
- Register for direct debit service
- Register/edit/deregister with PromptPay
- Suspend debit card/credit card
- Renew debit card
- Request a Bualuang Home Loan
- Request a Credit Bureau Report
- Lock and Unlock accounts to prevent transfers, top ups and payments
• QuickPay – scan to pay merchants without a mobile PIN
• Scan a QR Code for payment with a Widget
• Change your registered mobile number/email
How to apply:
For customers without a Bangkok Bank account
• Open an e-Savings account and apply for mobile banking services in the app
For customers with a Bangkok Bank account
• Download the application and apply with your Bangkok Bank deposit account, debit card or credit card.
• Visit any Bangkok Bank ATM or branch to get a temporary PIN to log in to the application.
For further assistance please call 1333 or (66) 0-2645-5555 or visit www.bangkokbank.com/mobilebanking
Head Office: 333 Silom Road, Silom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500
Disclaimer: The use of this application is for prospective customers and customers of Bangkok Bank only and this application shall not be used for any illegal purpose.

bluejetty:00159689:ios.summary:
BUMP ME ON RADICAL
Radical makes it easy to connect with the people around you!
Based on your network of friends, Radical will show you a list of people at the same place as you and how you're connected. You’ll be able to view their profi
bluejetty:00159689:ios.description:
BUMP ME ON RADICAL
Radical makes it easy to connect with the people around you!
Based on your network of friends, Radical will show you a list of people at the same place as you and how you're connected. You’ll be able to view their profile (photo, first name only, bio), any mutual friends that you share, or other things you might have in common. Send a bump to someone that interests you and if they bump you back, you can start messaging each other. 
The app is free to use and only available on iOS
----
"I was at this bar in LA and opened up the app for the first time. What surprised me was the number of people that shared mutual friends or friends of friends with me. I'm a confident person, but this made the experience of approaching new people a lot more fun/comfortable."
Mia D.
Venice, CA
"I really like the bump feature. I noticed this women at the same event and that she shared some mutual friends. She was with a big group of people and they were in conversation, so the timing felt off to approach her. I bumped her on Radical, a few minutes later she bumped me back, and we started chatting in the app just like that. We ended up connecting after the event for a drinks and talked for hours"
Jake K.
Santa Monica, CA
"I was traveling on break and was bored at the airport. After opening up the app, I saw that the girl next to me shared around 30 mutual friends. I asked her how she knew all these people and we found out that we lived in the same neighborhood growing up, literally 15 houses aways! She ended up being really cool and we're now good friends"
Emily S.
Los Angeles, CA
----
OUR MISSION
Today’s social networks are addicting, weaken our relationships, and hurt our overall mental well-being. We spend more time watching the lives of others versus spending time with the people around us. Our mission at Radical is provide a product that inspires people to go out into the world to connect with friends, and make new ones. 
Social thus far has been a love-hate relationship. With Radical, it's all love.
----
BEAUTIFUL DESIGN
We've created a simple to use and well designed product that highlights what's important - the people around you. 
DISCOVER
Radical will show you a list of people at the same place as you (or nearby). We’ll highlight members that are connected to you in some way (i.e. mutual friends, friends of friends, hometown), towards 
the top of the list. Once you leave that place, the list of people there will disappear and change to other people that are nearby.
BUMPS
Bumps make it easy to get someone's attention. If you bump someone and they bump you back, the ability to message them will unlock.
**Keep in mind that we only notify other members of a bump if it comes from someone that’s within three degrees of friendship i.e. friends of friends, therefore we recommend adding more friends to expand your reach
FRIENDS
Radical organizes your list of friends by how far away they are from you at any given moment, without sharing their direct location with you. We'll notify you and your friend when you're nearby one another, creating a moment of serendipity to meet up. It's by far one of our most loved features! 
COMMUNITIES - Invite only*
This feature represents a group of people that have something in common that's a bit more exclusive. Great for neighborhoods, organizations, social clubs, and more. This feature is currently invite only*
CHAT
Message with friends that are nearby or with new connections made in the Discover or Community section
PICS
Sometimes a photo or video is worth a thousand words. Send a visual message to friends to share what you're doing and where, with the hope that they come meet up.
WE LOVE BATTERIES
A lot of location based apps can drain your juice. We know battery time is sacred! Our app is state of the art and intelligently uses minimal battery power. We use less battery power than most popular social networks

bluejetty:00086731:ios.description:
Conheça o BHBUS+, o seu assistente pessoal para uso do transporte coletivo em Belo Horizonte! 
O BHBUS+ fornece todos os recursos para se locomover utilizando o transporte coletivo em Belo Horizonte de forma inteligente e rápida, com o melhor da mobilidade.
PARADAS PRÓXIMAS
Veja no mapa as paradas mais próximas de sua localização e conheça as linhas que a atendem.
A MELHOR ROTA
Saber chegar em algum endereço não será problema com o BHBUS+. Calcule rotas de transporte público e descubra as formas mais rápidas de se locomover.
NAVEGAÇÃO DETALHADA
Além de calcular sua rota, o BHBUS+ te guia e te leva a qualquer lugar com instruções detalhadas e acompanhamento através da sua localização.
PREVISÃO DE CHEGADA
Utilizamos a localização dos ônibus em tempo real para calcular a previsão de tempo de chegada até a parada.
SALDO DE CARTÕES
É possível adicionar o seu cartão BHBUS Usuário ou BHBUS Usuário Identificado e acompanhar o saldo direto pela tela do seu telefone.
Os valores não são atualizados em tempo real, portanto, após a utilização ou recarga, o saldo será atualizado em até 72 horas. 
RECARGA DE CARTÕES
Faça recargas em seu BHBUS Usuário ou BHBUS Usuário Identificado sem sair de casa, pagando seu pedido por cartão de crédito, boleto e PIX.( Confira na aba recargas os valores disponíveis para cada modalidade). 
QUADRO DE HORÁRIOS
Programe sua saída de acordo com o quadro de horários dos ônibus, assim sempre saberá quando o veículo está a caminho.
CONHEÇA AS LINHAS
Conheça o caminho exato que o seu ônibus faz ao selecioná-lo em uma previsão, e também conheça outras linhas e seus itinerários completos.
ADICIONE FAVORITOS
Se utiliza muito uma linha ou sempre vai para uma parada, pode adicioná-la como favorito e acessar rapidamente sem a necessidade de pesquisa ou procurar no mapa.
ATIVE NOTIFICAÇÕES
Receba notificação quando seu ônibus estiver quase chegando no seu ponto favorito.
FAÇA PARTE
Cadastre-se no BHBUS+ com um toque utilizando Facebook ou seu e-mail, assim seus cartões e informações estarão sempre disponíveis quando precisar.

bluejetty:00015518:ios.description:
Our new My Town : Wedding game has everything your children need to create a dream wedding with all of their friends. With 6 different locations, there is no limit to the stories they will be able to make up as they spend hours exploring new characters and bringing some of the characters they love from other My Town games to join the party! 
There is much to check out in all the locations! Will your favorite My Town character say yes to the dress in our wedding dress store? What flavor of wedding cake will they pick? No wedding is complete without a beautiful floral display and bouquet, so we have a fun flower shop to create a floral masterpiece! Your wedding guests won’t want to come empty handed and our gift shop has all they need to ensure they won’t have to. 
Once the service is over, it’s time to celebrate! There’s a rooftop location on the 100th floor of the venue just waiting for a party!
FEATURES:
*6 different locations including a flower shop, gift store, dress store and many more!
*14 characters to play with including a bride, groom and all your friends that want to come as guests.
*Pure open ended play. There are no time restraints in My Town, nor is there any pressure to compete for the highest score.
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room. 
TELL US WHAT YOU THINK!
 You can easily contact with us on Facebook or Twitter at any time to let us know what you would like changed or added. Maybe you’ve come up with a new My Town game all on your own – let us know! We promise to read all messages and reply. We love to hear YOUR ideas, so please connect with us! 
Facebook – https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
 Twitter – https://twitter.com/mytowngames
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com

The route planner will navigate the correct driving direction for your trip and also help you to find nearby places. Plan a great road trip! GPS route optimizer now brings you the opportunity to track a route with multi-stop route planner capabilities. Find the best route directions for your road trips with this GPS route finder. Record your routes and complete your deliveries faster and get home earlier with a route planner app .

The location tracker app with car navigation is the best tool to find the shortest way on the roads. Search for different places and destinations with the help of the GPS navigator app. This GPS route tracker gives you the ability to find road routes by your destinations A to B with GPS navigation and as well as its unique ability to add multi-stops on your routes.
GPS Router tracker app has a feature of the quickest delivery route planner which provides the shortest routes for deliveries. Add your destination address for deliveries & list of multi stops you need to make, then this GPS navigation app will navigate the routes that avoid heavy traffic jams and give you the best delivery route. bluejetty:00180191:ios.description:
Protect visuals with Custom Watermarks, Digital Signatures, Timestamps, Logo, Stickers & QR Code!
Photographers often rely on a brand watermark app to maintain ownership of their visual content. With eZy Watermark Photos, you can easily add professional watermarks, add text, create signature watermarks, apply digital signatures, add watermark logos, write on photos, add copyright watermarks, camera images, trademarks, stickers, and emojis as watermark stamps - all without losing image resolution or ruining the original aesthetic. It’s quick and simple, mark your content and keep it truly yours.
Manually adding watermarks to multiple photos is time-consuming, and keeping the same style or logo on all of them is almost impossible. We help you batch watermark photos in one go with fast and professional results.
A professional watermark tool designed for photographers, businesses, artists, influencers, and creators. eZy Watermark Photos editor adjusts image resolution, overlays photos with brand logo watermarks, and protects images from unauthorized use.
Perfect for image protection, posters, flyers, and banners with custom watermarking for your business.
FEATURES:
ADD WATERMARK TO PHOTOS:
Protect images online by adding a customized watermark to photos. Personalize to add text on photos, put QR codes, digitally sign your photos, add logos, add watermark picture, date stamp on photo, add label on photos, timestamps, and copyright stamp on a photograph.
SINGLE AND BATCH PROCESSING:
Watermark photo editor processes single images as well as hundreds of images in batch photo editor, all within seconds. You can easily add text to photos in bulk and in single mode. Save time with batch watermarking — batch watermark photos in seconds, perfect for creators on the go.
CUSTOMIZED WATERMARKS:
You can easily adjust opacity, rotation, size, position, and placements of your watermarks. Customize text watermarks with your own fonts, colors, and styles to give them a personal touch and make your photos truly yours.
AI POWERED TEMPLATES:
Powered by AI, eZy Watermark introduces adaptive templates that intelligently adjust watermarks across images, delivering a consistent and refined batch watermarking experience.
CREATE AND SAVE WATERMARK TEMPLATES:
You can create your own watermark templates and save them for later, so you don’t have to start from scratch every time. Just create a template once; your logo, text, style, everything and reuse it whenever you need to add custom watermarks to your photos.
PREVIEW, CROP, AND RESIZE PHOTOS:
You can preview the image before processing watermarks, cropping and resizing photos, adjusting size to different ratios, applying rotation to align the photo, and applying filters on images, and then create a watermark on photo.
TILE WATERMARKS:
Apply your watermark in a repeated pattern across the entire photo for stronger protection and professional-looking results.
SNAP TO GRID:
Easily place your watermark exactly where you want it. Our grid snapping feature helps you align it perfectly, giving your photos a consistent and professional look.
IMPORT & EXPORT WATERMARK PICTURES:
We make it easy to import photos from your camera, library, or capture a new picture directly from camera. Save your edited images with stylish watermarks to your gallery or share them instantly on Instagram, Pinterest, Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, or Google Drive! Whether you are sharing product photos or travel shots, your content stays yours.
MULTI-LANGUAGE SUPPORT:
eZy Watermark Photos is available in many languages, including Chinese, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish, so everyone can use it easily.
Add or create watermark to protect your images and keep your visuals safe from unauthorized use. Download eZy Watermark now!

bluejetty:00176587:ios.description:
The MyAviron Companion app keeps you connected to your Aviron experience and community, wherever you are.
Track Your Progress: Compare your performance across sessions with the Comparison Chart, view detailed workout history, set personal Goals, and visualize your fitness journey.
Explore and Discover Workouts: Browse the full Workout Library, add favorites easily, and check out Popular Workouts, including Les Mills and Coached classes available in the app wherever you are.
Team Challenges and Leaderboards: Track your contribution, and see how you stack up on the leaderboard.
Seamless Third-Party Integrations: Connect with Apple Health, Strava, Fitbit, and Concept2 to synchronize your workout data effortlessly.
Apple Watch Integration: Use your Apple Watch as a heart rate monitor during your workouts.
Stay Connected: Add friends, see who’s online, and share your achievements.
Manage Structured Programs: View, register, and stay on track with your personalized workout programs.
Stay Informed: Enable push notifications for updates on your milestones, Goals, upcoming sessions, and community achievements.
Whether you're tracking progress, setting Goals, or competing in Team Challenges, the MyAviron Companion app provides everything you need to succeed.

bluejetty:00178692:ios.summary:
“If you’re looking for the best mobile motocross game there is, just get Mad Skills Motocross 3.” - Justin Cooper, 2021 West Supercross Champion
“I’ve never met a motocross racer who hasn’t played Mad Skills Motocross. It’s legendary in th
bluejetty:00178692:ios.description:
“If you’re looking for the best mobile motocross game there is, just get Mad Skills Motocross 3.” - Justin Cooper, 2021 West Supercross Champion
“I’ve never met a motocross racer who hasn’t played Mad Skills Motocross. It’s legendary in the sport.” - David Pingree, former pro racer and current host of the Whiskey Throttle Show
“I will destroy David Pingree at Mad Skills Motocross 3.” -- Grant Langston, former world champion and AMA motocross champion
The wait is over. Mad Skills Motocross 3 has finally arrived.
With mind-blowing physics, endless customization, hundreds of tracks and exciting online multiplayer events, Mad Skills Motocross 3 sets the standard for side-scrolling racing games. Its amazing 3D art, realistic bike sounds and energetic original soundtrack help to capture the spirit and aggression of real motocross racing, but its simple controls make it easy to learn for even the most casual players. But understand: It’s called Mad Skills for a reason. This game will challenge you like no other racing game can. After all, motocross is not supposed to be easy.
Mad Skills Motocross 3 includes:
THE BEST MOTORCYCLE PHYSICS OF ANY MOBILE GAME
The bikes in Mad Skills Motocross 3 are a dream to race. This is why real motocross racers across the globe gravitate to this game above all others. You’ll feel the acceleration, the weight of the bike, the torque and the suspension. And for the first time ever in Mad Skills Motocross, you can whip your bike. 
ENDLESS CUSTOMIZATION
Equip your rider with an incredible selection of real-life and fantasy gear brands, creating millions of possible combinations. Collect new bikes and upgrade their parts to fit your riding style. Show off your own personal look in online competitions and against friends.
EXTREMELY DEEP GAMEPLAY
Mad Skills Motocross 3 features hundreds of expertly designed tracks, and new tracks will be added to the game every week, indefinitely. There’s always something new and challenging to conquer, including exciting online multiplayer events.
Universal application. Connect to Facebook, GameCenter, or Sign in with Apple, and your game progress and purchases will sync between devices.
Requires iOS 10 or later.
ADDITIONAL DISCLOSURES
While this app is free to download and play, there are some items in the game that cost real money. You have the option to subscribe to a Mad Skills Pro Pass for $11.99 / month (or local equivalent price). The payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the period ends. Your iTunes Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the amount of $11.99. Auto-renewal can be turned off in your device's settings after purchase. You get all Mad Skills Pro Pass benefits as soon as you subscribe.
Subscription periods are not tied to calendar weeks. They end exactly 1 week after their day of purchase. If you cancel your subscription during your 3 day free trial you will not be charged anything. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Terms of use can be found at www.turborilla.com/termsofuse. If you do not agree to those terms please do not access and/or play our games or use our services.
You will be given the opportunity to participate in special offers, events, and programs from Turborilla AB and its partners.
Use of this application is governed by Turborilla’s Terms of Use, which can be read here: http://www.turborilla.com/termsofuse
Collection and use of personal data are subject to Turborilla’s Privacy Policy, which can be read here: http://www.turborilla.com/privacy

bluejetty:00158326:ios.summary: We want to introduce you to the easiest and simplest way to stay in touch with your family all the time - Look360: Find Friends & Family. Add your loved ones to your circles to always be aware of their location in real time, track their mov
bluejetty:00158326:ios.description:
We want to introduce you to the easiest and simplest way to stay in touch with your family all the time - Look360: Find Friends & Family. Add your loved ones to your circles to always be aware of their location in real time, track their movements and get notifications when they arrive at the right address. 
Our app is made for your comfort and your peace of mind. Now you can use modern technology and improve your convenience. 
What are the main features of Look360: Find Friends & Family? 
- View the exact location of your friends and family on a map. 
- Receive real-time notifications when Circle members arrive at an address. 
- Create and edit different Circles for your parents, kids, friends, colleagues. 
- Share your location with Circle members. 
- Create an unlimited number of circles. 
- Invite as many Circle members as you want. 
- Create your favorite places on the map. 
- Activate incognito mode if you want to remain anonymous. 
- Create routes to other participants on the map. 
Look360: Find Friends & Family app helps you always take care of your family members and friends, keep track of them and make sure they are safe. 
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS : 
- There are 3 premium rate options. 1 Week, 1 Month, 1 Year. Each subscription has a 3 days free trial period. 
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase 
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. 
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. 
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. The cost depends on the selected plan. 
- Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription. 
Privacy Policy: 
https://circlelocatorapp.wixsite.com/circle-locator/privacy-policy 
Terms and Conditions: 
https://circlelocatorapp.wixsite.com/circle-locator/terms-of-use
