bluejetty:00088190:ios.name: Camrote
bluejetty:00088190:ios.summary:
With features tailored to everyone from amateur to Pro photographers Camrote has you covered, making it a fantastic tool for remote control of your Sony Alpha or Cyber-shot camera.
From taking family self-portraits to setting up and captur
bluejetty:00088190:ios.description:
With features tailored to everyone from amateur to Pro photographers Camrote has you covered, making it a fantastic tool for remote control of your Sony Alpha or Cyber-shot camera.
From taking family self-portraits to setting up and capturing complex scenes, Camrote is the tool for your remote control needs!
Features & Benefits
• Easy transfer of full-resolution RAW* files (or JPEG... or both!) from your supported camera.
• Simple connection process via QR, NFC, recently connected devices or manual entry.
• Ability to change shutter settings with the flick of a finger.
• Fantastic compositional tools for any situation.
• Bulb and Continuous shooting modes*.
• Ability to switch between landscape and portrait aspect ratios.
• Simple to use and effective intervalometer mode, including BULB shooting.
• A beautiful default dark theme to help you when working in low-light conditions.
• Intuitive UI for capturing geotagging tracks via GPX for import to Lightroom or other editing software**.
• Easy interface for either batch download or single download of captured images.
• Designed from the ground up to be fast and intuitive on both iPhone and iPad to make capturing photos a breeze.
• Customisable UI: Choose whether to configure shutter settings using a slider or radio buttons.
Coming Soon
• Shooting presets.
Future Functionalities
• Apple Watch support to configure and capture photos from your wrist!
• Auto exposure ramping for intervalometer (pending research to see if an iOS device is powerful enough to do the necessary calculations).
• Support for remote control of other camera manufacturers***
Made with Love
Camrote is made with love in Wales, by an avid Amateur photographer and has the support of a large community of beta testers who are constantly suggesting brilliant new features and ideas! It will only continue to become a better remote control tool with time.
In-App Purchases
Some features require in-app purchases to use, or are extendable via an in-app purchase. These purchases will be charged to your iTunes Account. Terms and Conditions can be found here: http://camrote.app/terms_and_conditions
* Only on supported cameras. See our support page form more info.
** Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
*** Some manufacturers may not be supported where documentation is not available.
Camrote uses the Camera Remote API by Sony via ROCC, and works along side Imaging Edge Mobile and Play Memories.
Sony, α, Alpha, Cyber-shot, NEX, RX are trademarks of Sony Corporation.

bluejetty:00040751:ios.description:
Military Calisthenics
Build real mobility that holds up under training—faster, stronger, and more controlled in just 21 days.
This app is your personal mobility bootcamp: structured drills, clear progress, and repeatable routines that improve range of motion, posture, and daily performance. Whether you’re fighting tight hips, stiff hamstrings, or limited toe-touch range, you’ll follow a simple plan that gets results at home.
Key Features:
21-Day Mobility Bootcamp
Hip, hamstring & lower back mobility drills
Personalized plan based on tightness + movement limits
Daily “warm-up style” routines (short, efficient, repeatable)
Joint-safe progressions for every level
No equipment. No excuses. Just consistent mobility gains—done.
Created by a medical animator and a certified flexibility coach. This app uses a science-based approach to mobility and calisthenics readiness—helping you move better so you can train harder with less risk. It analyzes stiffness patterns and builds a personalized plan to improve flexibility, control, and movement quality.
Whether you’re training calisthenics, lifting, running, or just want your body to feel ready every day, you’ll get targeted mobility drills that support better form and stronger performance. Guided sessions, clear progression, and progress tracking keep you consistent—because consistency is the mission.
Start your 21-day mobility campaign now—and earn better range of motion, better control, and a body that moves like it’s built for the job.

Welcome to Dominoes: Tile Domino game! Take a break and enjoy this relaxing tile-based classic game!
Easy to Play
- Drag and drop to place the domino tile on the board
- Connect domino brick that matches one of the ends of the board
- Match numbers faster and get rid of your tiles before your opponent
- First player to 100 points wins the game
With 2 Relaxing Game Modes
- Draw dominoes: Simple and relaxing. Just play domino tiles on the game board and match the same numbers. If you can't figure out your next move, you can pick an extra domino from the boneyard.
- Block dominoes: Basically the same as Draw Dominoes. The main difference is that you have to pass your turn if you run out of options. There is no boneyard in this mode.
Features
- Completely free tile match game
- No time limit
- Simply fun and relaxation
- Brain challenging and training classic board game
- Suitable for all ages
- Addictive for both starters and masters
- Play to win
This classic tile game is easy to learn, just develop your own strategy to win. Come puzzle your brain now and have endless fun! You can play it anytime and anywhere!

bluejetty:00026581:ios.description:
Protect Your Heart and Live Healthier
HealthBit is your all-in-one, convenient solution for monitoring your body and overall well-being. With HealthBit, tracking your vital signs has never been easier. The app allows you to monitor key health indicators such as pulse, blood sugar, blood pressure, oxygen levels, body temperature, and weight, while providing long-term trend analysis. You can also log your daily calorie intake and consult AI health advisors to enhance your overall health.
For more accurate insights, we recommend taking multiple readings throughout the day—especially upon waking, before bed, and after exercise. HealthBit makes this process simple and its accuracy has been validated through professional testing.
Key Features:
Track daily calorie intake
Monitor your pulse anytime during the day
Keep track of trends in heart rate and other vital signs
Log your blood sugar, blood pressure, oxygen level, weight and body temperature
Export personal health reports to share
Take heart risk assessments and MBTI personality tests
Meditate with guided sessions and get healthy eating advice
How to Use:
HealthBit is easy to use with just your phone. Place your finger on the back camera, remain still, and start measuring your pulse. Wait for the result once the process completes.
Important Information:
HealthBit is intended for fitness purposes only and is not a substitute for medical devices or advice. It provides general health insights but cannot be used for medical diagnosis or treatment. The app does not measure blood pressure, oxygen level, or body temperature. Extended use may cause the camera to overheat.
Subscribe for Full Access:
Subscription options: 1 week, 1 month, or 1 year
Payment is charged to your account upon confirmation of purchase
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off 24 hours before the current period ends
Manage your subscriptions and disable auto-renewal in your account settings after purchase
Privacy Policy: https://www.panadiamedia.com/terms-of-service 
Terms of Service: https://www.panadiamedia.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00085813:ios.description:
Easy to follow guided meditations for mindfulness, sleep and relaxation! Install now and unlock your potential.
Serenity: Guided Meditations allows you to learn a variety of meditation and mindfulness techniques that aims to bring a sense of peace, calm and happiness to your life.
Learn the basics with the free, easy to follow 7 day audio course. Gain the skills required to make mindful meditation a part of the rest of your life.
Foundations: Expand your skills and learn about mindfulness, self awareness, values and goals
Sleep guides: A selection of guided mediations designed to guide you to sleep using relaxation techniques, peaceful music and peaceful sounds
Stress relief: soothe anxiety with relaxation and mindfulness techniques to calm the mind and body
Quick meditations: short sessions to practice your skills or provide a sense of peace and calm from the stresses of your day
Kids meditations - simplified and shorter audio sessions designed specifically for children.
Plus more being added to the app all the time
Other features:
No sign up/log in required - start meditating straight away
Ideal for beginners with over 2 hrs of free audio.
No subscriptions necessary - extra content is available either through one time permanent purchases or unlock everything with a subscription
Easy to follow - ideal for beginners and more experienced mindful meditators alike
Silent mind - learn a technique to quieten the mind of thoughts
Meditation and mindfulness skills - Learn to separate thoughts from feelings to improve your emotional well being
Gratitude - Change your perspective on life by understanding gratitude and gain a new appreciation of the world around you
Plus
Set up daily reminders to stay on track
Stay motivated by completing challenges and unlocking more free sessions as you progress
Monitor your progress with stats and graphs
Apple Health - Serenity works with Apple Health app to track all your meditation session if you require
Airplay - in built support for Airplay to play your sessions through AirPlay speakers
Over 2 hrs of free content:
7 Day beginner course
Basic sessions for regular practice
Plus a different mini meditations each day
See if mindful meditation can improve your life - install now!
****
Serenity: Guided Meditation offers a premium subscription level that unlocks all meditations. Premium subscriptions renew either monthly or 6 monthly. The cost is $7.99 a month or $21.99 for 6 months (or equivalent local currency). Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto renew at any time by going to your iTunes Account settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited if you purchases a subscription.
Privacy policy: https://serenitymeditations.co.uk/privacy
Terms and conditions: https://serenitymeditations.co.uk/eula

bluejetty:00161509:ios.name: Dawood Kids قناة داوود اطفال
bluejetty:00161509:ios.summary:
Dawood Kids: Learn and Memorize the Quran and Arabic Letters Through Play
Dawood Kids is an educational and entertainment world designed to make learning and memorizing the Quran and Arabic letters more fun, engaging, and interactive for c
bluejetty:00161509:ios.description:
Dawood Kids: Learn and Memorize the Quran and Arabic Letters Through Play
Dawood Kids is an educational and entertainment world designed to make learning and memorizing the Quran and Arabic letters more fun, engaging, and interactive for children.
The app is built around gamification, transforming learning and memorization into an experience filled with games, challenges, and interactive activities. Children can learn, repeat, and memorize while playing in a more natural and enjoyable way.
At Dawood Kids, we place great emphasis on the quality of the overall experience, from character and world design to interfaces, animations, games, and interactions. Every element is carefully designed to create an engaging visual experience for children.
App Highlights:
- Easy and enjoyable Quran verse memorization and repetition.
- Educational games combining entertainment, learning, and memorization.
- A variety of games, including car racing, runner games, the Little Ice Cream Seller game, and other interactive activities.
- Arabic letter learning using Augmented Reality (AR).
- Educational songs that help children learn Arabic letters.
- High-quality animations and visual content designed especially for children.
- Engaging characters and visual worlds that make learning more exciting.
- An interactive experience combining digital content with printable learning materials.
Learn and Memorize the Quran
Children can listen to Quran recitations and repeat verses in a simple way that supports memorization and revision.
Quran learning and recitation are also integrated into selected games and interactive activities, helping make memorization part of an enjoyable experience rather than a traditional learning task.
Learning Through Games
Dawood Kids includes a growing collection of carefully designed games, including car racing, runner games, the Little Ice Cream Seller game, and other interactive experiences.
The games are not designed for entertainment alone. They are an important part of the app's gamified learning approach, encouraging children to interact, progress, and continue learning through play.
Learn Arabic Letters with Augmented Reality
The app offers a special Arabic alphabet learning experience using Augmented Reality (AR).
Children can meet Dawood and Dana in an engaging interactive space-themed world, where Arabic letters are introduced through animation, educational songs, and interactive experiences.
This combines visual, audio, and interactive learning to help make Arabic letters easier and more enjoyable for children to discover.
Interactive Arabic Letter Flashcards
Printable PDF flashcards for Arabic letters can be purchased from the official Dawood store and printed at home.
Once printed, children can point the app's camera at the cards to activate the Augmented Reality experience for each letter.
Dawood and Dana then appear within the interactive scene together with animations, educational songs, and content related to the selected letter.
The flashcards also provide access to interactive games and additional content inside the app, connecting physical learning materials with the digital world.
Carefully Designed for Children
Dawood Kids combines education and entertainment through engaging designs, interactive games, animations, educational songs, and visual content created specifically for children.
We continuously develop the app by improving its games, performance, usability, and overall experience while introducing new activities and adventures to the world of Dawood.
Visit the Dawood store:
www.dawoodkids.com/shop
Dawood Kids
A safe and inspiring world where Quran learning, education, and play come together.

apple-itunes:6822248877.name: LaziBook - Listen & read books
apple-itunes:6822248877.description:
Read and listen to your own books in natural voices. Open EPUB, PDF, Kindle, Word files or comics, tap Listen and LaziBook reads to you — speech is generated right on your iPhone or iPad, with no internet and no ads.
LISTEN
• Tap Listen and reading starts from the page you are on; the current sentence is highlighted, each word lights up as it is spoken, and pages turn by themselves. Tap any word to read from there.
• Keeps reading with the screen locked, with controls on the Lock Screen, Dynamic Island and headphones.
• Background sound: 18 music themes, 12 ambient sounds (rain, a stream, campfire…), chapter intro and outro music.
• A separate voice for dialogue, custom pronunciations for any word, and Speak for any selected passage.
• Speed 0.75–2×, sleep timer and an Up Next queue.
• M4B audiobooks: export each chapter as a file, gathered into an album per book; listen in the app, save or share.
VOICES ON YOUR DEVICE
• 30 Vietnamese voices from the North, Centre and South, each in two editions: Turbo, with expressive 48 kHz audio (iPhone 13 / SE 3 and later, iPads with A15 or M1), and Nano, light and battery-friendly on every device. LaziBook switches to the matching Nano voice when Turbo can't keep up.
• 37 English and 6 Chinese voices. LaziBook picks the right voice for the language of each book and each sentence.
• Studio: pauses, emotions, multi-voice scripts, MP3 with cover art.
• Create your own voice from 5–8 seconds of recording — processed on your device, never uploaded.
BOOKS THAT LOOK THE PART
• Book effect with page edges, spine and pages that curl under your finger; two pages on a landscape iPad, or vertical scrolling.
• Cover templates: 6 layouts, 8 styles, 6 palettes each — design a beautiful cover from your own picture; books without a cover get one that suits their genre.
• Vietnamese spelling by context: 3,461 hand-reviewed error spots (two words either side) fix typos and OCR errors; tap a snippet to fix just that spot.
• Clean Up & Convert: rewrite a book as a tidy EPUB 3 laid out like an edited edition — red chapter titles, a large initial, rebuilt contents; turn TXT, Word, Kindle and text PDFs into EPUB 3, or export an A5 PDF.
• Nine themes, three of them paper; highlights in five colours, notes, bookmarks and a Notebook.
LOOK UP AND TRANSLATE
• Look up a word or a whole passage with Lazidi (Vietnamese, English, Chinese, Japanese) or the built-in Dictionary. Pinyin and Sino-Vietnamese readings above Chinese characters.
• Translate books into Vietnamese, English or Chinese on your device, in the style of the story: read side by side or listen to the translation; edit any sentence, keep a names list. One-time 440 MB download.
PDFS AND COMICS
• PDFs keep their original printed layout, with the current sentence highlighted on the page; scanned pages are recognized on your device and read aloud.
• Comics in CBZ, CBR, CB7, CBT and PDF: right-to-left reading for manga, vertical scrolling for webtoons.
LIBRARY
• 15 formats: EPUB, PDF, MOBI, PRC, AZW, AZW3, DOCX, TXT, RTF, Markdown, FB2, CBZ, CBR, CB7, CBT.
• Add books from Files, Google Drive, Dropbox, OPDS servers (Calibre, Komga, Kavita…), or paste a Wikisource, Project Gutenberg or story-site link; Free Books to listen right away.
• Books live in iCloud Drive › LaziBook, shared with your iPad and Mac; progress, highlights, notes, covers and voices sync through iCloud — and, if you turn it on, through Google Drive with e-readers.
• Quick Find, book status, smart shelves, reading and listening statistics with a daily goal; widgets and a Read button for Control Center.
PRIVACY
No ads, no tracking; account optional. Your books, notes and voices stay on your device and in your own iCloud or Google Drive; LaziBook only receives anonymous reading and listening time (no device ID, none of your titles).
Note: DRM-protected books cannot be opened. Requires iOS 16.4; English voices need iOS 18. Translation needs an A13 chip and 4 GB of RAM.

apple-macos:997332884.name: Cut the Rope 3
apple-macos:997332884.description:
Accept the challenge to explore uncharted lands with Om Nom and cute little Nibble Nom! This exciting adventure starts with an old map and a promise of great discoveries — and takes all three of you through amazing locations full of challenging puzzles! Solve them all to find new species of Nommies and become the Ultimate Explorer.
FOR THE LOVERS OF PHYSICS-BASED FUN: Packed with all your favorite signature Cut the Rope mechanics, along with a bunch of new ones that'll have you hooked!
FOR THE LOVERS OF ADVENTURES: Explore the breathtaking locations and unique levels that'll put your brain to the test as you try to snag as many stars as possible!
FOR THE LOVERS OF CUTE MONSTERS: The world's cutest monster Om Nom, a close contestant for that title Nibble Nom, and lots of lovable Nommies for you to collect!
This newest chapter in the global Cut the Rope franchise whisks you away into a vibrant and immersive world. The key to travelling is getting the restless Nibble Nom back to Om Nom, but how to do this? Level objects will help – if you think of a way to use them. Work it out! Start on this exhilarating adventure today!
